izzyondroid:in.hridayan.ashell.name: aShell You
izzyondroid:in.hridayan.ashell.summary: Material Design 3 shell, ADB, and Fastboot utility for Android
izzyondroid:in.hridayan.ashell.description:
aShell You is an advanced shell and device management utility featuring a clean Material Design 3 interface. Execute ADB and shell commands on your local device or manage external devices via Wireless Debugging and USB OTG without requiring a PC.
 Key Features 
 Multi-Target Execution: Run commands locally via Shizuku or root, and remotely over Wi-Fi (pairing code/QR) or USB OTG.
 Fastboot OTG: Flash partitions, switch active slots (A/B), and execute bootloader operations over USB OTG.
 Screen Mirroring: Stream and interact with connected devices in real time with low-latency embedded scrcpy.
 Real-Time Logcat: Inspect system logs with tag search, regex filtering, and color-coded priority markers.
 ADB Sideload: Flash recovery update zip packages directly over USB OTG with live progress verification.
 Port Forwarding: Configure local and remote TCP port forwarding (adb forward/reverse) with active tunnel monitoring.
 Remote File Browser: Browse, push, pull, and manage files on connected targets.
 Command Examples & Bookmarks: Built-in catalog of common Android commands with custom bookmarking.
 Quick Settings Tiles: Launch custom shell scripts or toggle wireless debugging from the notification shade.
 Output Utilities: Continuous command streaming (top, logcat), text search, and text file export/sharing.
 Material Design 3: Dynamic colors, AMOLED dark theme, and interface scaling customization.
 Requirements 
 Local device execution requires Shizuku or root access (or local wireless debugging).
 Managing remote devices via OTG or Wi-Fi does not require root or Shizuku on the host device.
 Basic familiarity with ADB and shell commands is recommended.
 Translations Contribute translations via Crowdin: https://crowdin.com/project/ashellyou

fdroid:com.galaxyrio.sudokusolver.name: Sudoku You

fdroid:com.galaxyrio.sudokusolver.description:
Sudoku You is a free and open-source Sudoku app built for offline play and thoughtful solving. Generate classic 9×9 puzzles on your device, continue automatically saved games, or import a puzzle from text. Generated puzzles have a unique solution and come in Easy, Medium, Hard and Brutal difficulty levels. Imported puzzles are checked for a valid, unique solution.
When you need help, the human-style solver provides a step-by-step logical trace with explanations and board markings. It covers basic techniques as well as advanced subsets, fish, wings, coloring, chains, unique rectangles and forcing chains. Optional checks can point out incorrect values or missing candidates before the solver continues.
Features:
• Pencil marks, automatic candidates, undo/redo and restart
• Advanced annotations: color cells or candidates, highlight bivalue cells, frame cells, and draw solid or dashed links
• Import puzzles and export the original or current grid in Susser, multiline, pencilmark, Sukaku, Excel/TSV, OpenSudoku and HoDoKu formats

• Material 3 interface with system/light/dark modes, dynamic wallpaper colors, custom accents, palette styles, AMOLED black and board highlighting options
• English and Simplified Chinese, selectable independently from the system language
• Local crash history and third-party open-source license information
Privacy:
Sudoku You requests no network permission and includes no ads, accounts, analytics or tracking. Games and preferences are stored locally. Crash reports are retained locally for up to 30 days and are never uploaded automatically; you decide whether to copy or share them.
Sudoku You is licensed under GNU GPL v3.0 or later and requires Android 11 or later.

fdroid:com.samyak.repostore.description:
RepoStore is a native Android app that turns GitHub releases into a clean, Play Store-style experience.
 Key Features: 
• Smart Discovery - Home sections for Trending, Recently Updated, and Featured projects. Only repos with valid APK assets are shown.
• Latest-Release Installs - Fetches the latest release for each repo and shows only assets from the newest release with a single Install action.
• Rich Details Screen - View app name, version, stars, forks, language stats, rendered README content, release notes with markdown formatting, and screenshot gallery.
• Install & Update Tracking - Tracks installations and shows when updates are available. Shows "Open" for installed apps.
• Multi-language Support - Support for English, Hindi, Hinglish, and Marathi with a searchable language selection dialog.
• Material You Design - Material 3 design with dynamic theming support and dark mode.
• GitHub Integration - Optional GitHub sign-in to increase API rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour.
 How it works: 
RepoStore uses GitHub's public API to search for Android repositories. It filters to show only those that have real, downloadable APK files in their releases. When you find an app you like, tap Install to download and install it directly.
 Privacy & Security: 
• No tracking or analytics
• No ads
• Open source (MIT License)
• Downloads come directly from GitHub releases
• HTTPS-only connections
 Requirements: 
• Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher
• Internet connection
RepoStore is free and open source. If you find it helpful, consider starring the GitHub repository!

fdroid:deltazero.amarok.foss.name: Amarok
fdroid:deltazero.amarok.foss.summary: Hide your private Files and APPs with a single click.
fdroid:deltazero.amarok.foss.description:
Amarok is an Android application which enables you to hide your private files & apps with just one click.
 Often, we resort to complex encryptors to secure our files and apps, aiming to shield them from prying eyes. These encryptors, while effective, tend to be slow and resource-intensive, making the encryption of large files such as videos and music a daunting task. Despite their robust security, these methods are often overkill for the average user who simply wish to keep their private files and apps out of unintentional reach.
 Amarok is designed to be a light-weight hider. It disguises file names and headers, causing them to seem "corrupted" and unopenable. Amarok also deactivates applications, rendering them invisible in the launcher and system menu.
 Features 
 User-Friendly : Easily hide files and applications with a single click.
 Rapid and Efficient Large File Hiding : Hides by altering only file name and signature, unaffected by file size.
 Root-Free Application Hiding : Makes apps vanish from the launcher. Compatible with Root, Shizuku, Dhizuku, and DSM modes.
 Panic button : Use a floating button to quickly hide applications and files in urgent scenarios. 
 Quick Settings Tile : A control center toggle for immediate hiding, bypassing the need to launch the app.
 App Lock : Secure Amarok access with a password or fingerprint.
 Pleasant Interface : Clean Material3 design.
 Please be aware that Amarok is not an encryption software , but rather a tool for hiding things. We strongly advise against using Amarok to protect confidential files and applications.
fdroid:deltazero.amarok.foss.category: App Manager, File Encryption & Vault, Security, System

apple-macos:6786366361.name: Rune Secure Notes
apple-macos:6786366361.description:
Rune is a calm, fast notes app for people who don't want to trust an app with their data. Your notes never leave your device, they are encrypted at rest, and the app makes no network connections at all. There is no account, no cloud, and no sign-up.
Privacy by construction, not by promise:
• No telemetry, no analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising, no tracking, none, not "anonymised", not "aggregated".
• No networking code. Put your device in airplane mode and everything still works. If anything ever tries to reach the network, that is a bug.
• No account and no server. There is no "we" that could hold your data.
Real encryption:
• Your passphrase derives a key with Argon2id; notes are sealed with XChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption. Only ciphertext is ever written to disk.
• The passphrase is never stored and is not recoverable. If you forget it, your notes are gone, no reset, no backdoor. That is the price of real privacy.
• A wrong passphrase simply cannot decrypt your notes.
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID unlock: opt in to unlock with biometrics. Even then the passphrase is never stored — only the in-memory key is cached behind the biometric prompt.
What you can do:
• Create, edit, search, and organise plain-text notes with a clean, calm layout.
• Auto-lock on inactivity and lock-on-background; the app starts locked.
• Export an encrypted backup (safe to keep anywhere); plaintext export is gated behind an explicit warning.
• Capture voice notes and transcribe them to text entirely on your device with on-device speech recognition — no audio and no transcript ever leaves your phone.
Free and open source under the GNU GPLv3. The security-critical code is a small, dependency-light core so it can be read and audited. Releases ship with cryptographic provenance and are built reproducibly, so you can verify the binary was built from this source.

flathub:io.github.Loganavter.Improve-Img.name: Improve ImgSLI
flathub:io.github.Loganavter.Improve-Img.description:
Improve ImgSLI is an open-source image comparison tool focused on precise visual inspection, responsive interaction, and advanced canvas rendering workflows. It is designed for artists, photographers, retouchers, AI upscaling workflows, quality control, and anyone who needs to compare images at pixel level without losing context.
 Key features include:
 Compare images with a movable horizontal or vertical split line, including zooming and panning in the main canvas.
 Use one or more synchronized magnifiers with adjustable capture areas, display sizes, freeze mode, combined layouts, internal split, per-instance colors, and keyboard-assisted positioning.
 Load and manage multiple images per side with drag-and-drop, list switching, swapping, and direct filename editing.
 Inspect visual differences with rendering-aware preview controls and selectable interpolation modes.
 Export full-resolution comparison images with overlays, labels, and comparison state preserved.
 Edit recorded comparison sessions in the built-in video editor with timeline selection, trimming, preview playback, and export.
 Use a feature-contract based canvas architecture that keeps overlays, magnifiers, guide lines, settings, and export behavior synchronized.
 Use persistent settings, multilingual interface support, and structured diagnostics for advanced troubleshooting.
 The application is distributed under the MIT License.

flathub:io.github.nostar.DroidStar.name: DroidStar
flathub:io.github.nostar.DroidStar.description:
DroidStar is an application that allows you to use digital modes such as M17, D-Star,
 Fusion and DMR from a computer. It connects to a reflector server and sends and receives
 audio encoded in Codec2 or AMBE. It also displays information about the users and modules
 connected to the reflector.
 Some modes may require an external vocoder plugin that can be downloaded from a URL, which
 will place the vocoder into the correct location for the platform. Add a full http url,
 including the filename, to the Vocoder URL option on the Settings tab, and click
 the Download vocoder button.
 For Android and iOS devices, the vocoder URL download method is the only way to
 load a vocoder plugin. For Linux, a vocoder can also be placed manually.
 To do this, copy the plugin to the system settings file location. On Linux, this is
 ~/.var/app/io.github.nostar.DroidStar/config/dudetronics - it is the same place
 where the host and id files are located (DMRHosts.txt, DMRIDs.data, etc).
 The vocoder plugin filename must be named vocoder_plugin.platform.arch
 where platform should be linux and arch can be x86_64 or arm64 depending
 on your system. The arch for your device is identified on the About tab.
 Vocoder download: http://pizzanbeer.net/droidstar/plugins/

 It has many powerful features including a rich display filter language and the ability to reassemble

flathub:us.acei.AbsoluteInfinity.summary: Explore, trade, and fight in a 2D galaxy.
flathub:us.acei.AbsoluteInfinity.description:
Fly your own ships 
 Pilot a range of vessels, starting in a scrappy shuttle and work your way up to powerful
 capital ships. Purchase or craft upgrades for your ships, and outfit them to suit your
 style of play.
 Craft and trade 
 Systems have markets that shift with supply, demand, and what you do to them. Haul goods
 from star to star and turn a profit by buying low and selling high. Or, mine and source
 ingredients yourself to craft over 50 unique items and sell them for a bigger profit.
 Ship-to-ship combat 
 Hunt pirates, defend your cargo, and fight through anyone between you and the truth.
 Every projectile is simulated, and each hit carries weight. Slug it out in close
 quarters combat, or build a missile boat and blow your enemies out of the sky from a
 distance. The choice is yours.
 Mod Support 
 Absolute Infinity's custom engine was built from the ground up with extensibility in
 mind, and comes with the same tools used to create it. You can extend the game by adding
 new ships, quests, items, and more.

fedora-packages:antlrworks/antlrworks.description: ANTLRWorks is a novel grammar development environment for ANTLR v3 grammars written by Jean Bovet (with suggested use cases from Terence Parr). It combines an excellent grammar-aware editor with an interpreter for rapid prototyping and a language-agnostic debugger for isolating grammar errors. ANTLRWorks helps eliminate grammar nondeterminisms, one of the most difficult problems for beginners and experts alike, by highlighting nondeterministic paths in the syntax diagram associated with a grammar. ANTLRWorks' goal is to make grammars more accessible to the average programmer, improve maintainability and readability of grammars by providing excellent grammar navigation and refactoring tools, and address the most common questions and problems encountered by grammar developers.

It will prompt the user explaining to him the need of the download and asking if it is ok to make an internet connection, after this it will show the license of the to be downloaded files and last it will do the actual download and md5 verification off these files. This whole process can be configured by the packager through a simple configuration file. Notice that Autodownloader while open source itself, may download files which are not permitted to be (re)distributed unlike most files in Fedora.

fedora-packages:ghc-deriving-compat/ghc-.name: ghc-deriving-compat
fedora-packages:ghc-deriving-compat/ghc-.description: 'deriving-compat' provides Template Haskell functions that mimic 'deriving' extensions that were introduced or modified in recent versions of GHC. Currently, the following typeclasses/extensions are covered: * Deriving 'Bounded' * Deriving 'Enum' * Deriving 'Ix' * Deriving 'Eq' * Deriving 'Ord' * Deriving 'Read' * Deriving 'Show' * 'DeriveFoldable' * 'DeriveFunctor' * 'DeriveTraversable' * 'GeneralizedNewtypeDeriving' (with GHC 8.2 or later) * 'DerivingVia' (with GHC 8.2 or later) See the "Data.Deriving" module for a full list of backported changes. In addition, 'deriving-compat' also provides some additional 'deriving' functionality that has not yet been merged into upstream GHC. Aside from the GHC 'deriving' extensions mentioned above, 'deriving-compat' also permits deriving instances of classes in the 'Data.Functor.Classes' module, covering the 'Eq1', 'Eq2', 'Ord1', 'Ord2', 'Read1', 'Read2', 'Show1', and 'Show2' classes. This extra functionality is outside of the main scope of 'deriving-compat', as it does not backport extensions that exist in today's GHC. Nevertheless, the underlying Template Haskell machinery needed to derive 'Eq' and friends extends very naturally to 'Eq1' and friends, so this extra functionality is included in 'deriving-compat' as a convenience. Note that some recent GHC typeclasses/extensions are not covered by this package: * 'DeriveDataTypeable' * 'DeriveGeneric', which was introducted in GHC 7.2 for deriving 'Generic' instances, and modified in GHC 7.6 to allow derivation of 'Generic1' instances. Use 'Generics.Deriving.TH' from '<http://hackage.haskell.org/package/generic-deriving generic-deriving>' to derive 'Generic(1)' using Template Haskell. * 'DeriveLift', which was introduced in GHC 8.0 for deriving 'Lift' instances. Use 'Language.Haskell.TH.Lift' from '<http://hackage.haskell.org/package/th-lift th-lift>' to derive 'Lift' using Template Haskell. * The 'Bifunctor' typeclass, which was introduced in GHC 7.10, as well as the 'Bifoldable' and 'Bitraversable' typeclasses, which were introduced in GHC 8.2. firefox-addons:2990800.description:
Blindspot gives you a simple pause button for your browsing history — no need to open a private window.
Features
 - One-click pause: Click the toolbar icon to stop recording history. Click again to resume. The icon turns red so you always know when you're in a blindspot.
 - Block specific sites: Add domains that should never appear in your history, even when Blindspot isn't paused.
Manage your list in Settings
 Right-click to block: Right-click any page to instantly block or unblock that site.
 Cleans up closed tabs: Blocked sites are also removed from your "Recently Closed Tabs" list.
 Fully local: No data is collected or sent anywhere. Your blocked list is stored locally in your browser.
How is this different from private browsing?
 Private browsing is all-or-nothing and opens a separate window. Blindspot lets you stay in your normal browser session and just pause history for a few minutes, or permanently hide specific sites.

bluejetty:00013821:ios.name: AuctionTime Online Auctions
bluejetty:00013821:ios.summary: Discover AuctionTime, the leading platform for buying and selling equipment on online auctions. Whether you're looking for construction machinery, farm equipment, trucks, trailers, RVs, or any other kind of equipment or tool, AuctionTime co
bluejetty:00013821:ios.description:
Discover AuctionTime, the leading platform for buying and selling equipment on online auctions. Whether you're looking for construction machinery, farm equipment, trucks, trailers, RVs, or any other kind of equipment or tool, AuctionTime connects auctioneers and bidders across North America and makes auctioning and bidding on equipment online fast, easy, and secure.
BID ON THOUSANDS OF EQUIPMENT LISTINGS ONLINE WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse a wide inventory of auction listings for various types of equipment and vehicles across the construction, farming, trucking, livestock, and other industries. Find the perfect machinery to meet your operational needs, and once you’ve won the bid, explore financing and delivery options offered by AuctionTime’s trusted financing and shipping partners, CurrencyFinance and FR8Star.
Use advanced search tools to filter auction listings by category, manufacturer, auction date, and more. Save time with personalized filters to find exactly what you need.
Once you've narrowed your search by the type of equipment, auctioneer, or specific location, participate in live auctions right from your phone, tablet, or computer device. View detailed photos and specifications of your desired items before you commit to bidding. Auctions typically end each Wednesday, with live bidding open 24 hours prior and proxy bidding available 7 days before the auction end time.
EASILY TRACK EQUIPMENT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BIDDING ON
Create a Watch List to track your favorite items. Receive real-time alerts when you've been outbid, ensuring you never miss out on a deal.
AUCTION MANAGEMENT MADE SIMPLE
If you’re an independent auctioneer or a big auction house, AuctionTime helps you reach thousands of qualified buyers actively searching for online equipment auctions.
List your equipment on AuctionTime for a low flat fee and benefit from a user-friendly and convenient platform for online auctions. Click the "My Inventory" button in your AuctionTime app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go-right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE THE AUCTIONTIME APP FOR ALL YOUR ONLINE EQUIPMENT AUCTION NEEDS
Whether you're a buyer looking for your next piece of equipment or an auctioneer seeking to expand your reach, AuctionTime provides the tools and exposure you need. Connect with a vast network of industry professionals and access a wide range of equipment and trucks.
As part of Sandhills Global, AuctionTime links you to a network that includes TractorHouse, Truck Paper, Machinery Trader, Controller, RVUniverse, MotorSportsUniverse, Equipmentfacts, and other trusted platforms. 
GET THE AUCTIONTIME APP NOW 
Thousands of auctioneers and individual sellers and bidders trust AuctionTime to manage their online auction operations. Download the app today to bid on your next piece of heavy machinery, farm equipment, truck, trailer, or other equipment with confidence!

bluejetty:00122529:ios.description:
If you are looking for a smart, full-featured and easy to use App to manage your bills, Bills Monitor is the one.
Use this app to ensure that never late to pay bills.
Bills Monitor - Bill Manager & Reminder is designed to manage all kinds of your bills. Log your bills in this app, you can track or check them from time to time visually and conveniently, also it will remind you to pay your bill after setting its reminding days. Bills Monitor will help to make your schedule easier and every bill in control.
The design and UI face is clear and tidy, which makes you manage the bills very easy and comfortable.
Features:
⁃ Calendar view of bills.
⁃ Identify the state of bills by individual icon on them.
⁃ Add bills with their categories, amount, due date, pay account, recurring or not, recurring end date if available, paid amount, and note.
⁃ Remind when bill due date approaches or bills are over-due. 
⁃ Mark payment to bills in full or in part.
⁃ Add recurring bills with frequency and end date conveniently.
⁃ Show number of unpaid bills on icon.
⁃ Twenty system own categories and you can customize your own.
⁃ Report function to show categories (allocation) of bills by pie chart.

bluejetty:00023641:ios.name: Lingidy ∙ Languages Fast & Fun
bluejetty:00023641:ios.summary:
Learn a language with the world’s highest rated, freshest app for language lovers!
Lingidy is the only app of its kind with fun, effective lessons, and an AI Tutor to give you an immersive chat experience with celebrities, past or present.
bluejetty:00023641:ios.description:
Learn a language with the world’s highest rated, freshest app for language lovers!
Lingidy is the only app of its kind with fun, effective lessons, and an AI Tutor to give you an immersive chat experience with celebrities, past or present.
Master speaking, understanding, reading and writing with modern lessons and fun, sometimes funny exercises. Lingidy offers the shortest path to have a conversation in a new language.
Designed by passionate polyglots and loved by millions of adventurers around the world, Vidalingua apps help you speak and understand Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Swedish, Japanese, Hindi, Ukrainian, Russian and English.
Whether you’re learning a language for a travel adventure, to succeed in class, or to connect at a deeper level with friends & family, you’ll love learning a language with Lingidy.
What people around the world are saying about Lingidy by Vidalingua
"Apps from Vidalingua are hugely popular... they're free and they work offline, handy when you're actually abroad." New York Times
“I tutor students for a living and I appreciate a good learning tool. The new chat feature in Lingidy is a fun way for students to learn with topics they care about. This is the future of language apps.” Harold G.
“I have never found anything like this. You can learn different languages with just one app. This is perfect for me.. very useful for traveling.” Kathryn M.
“Most apps force you to go through completely irrelevant lessons. Lingidy lets you choose what's useful and skip the others.” Lauren W.
Why Lingidy?
* Lingidy immerses you in real-life lessons from the moment you start the app. You learn Greetings, Basic Conversation and Useful Expressions that will have you speaking in a few minutes, instead of wasting time on games designed for dopamine addiction.
* Later lessons step you through situations you’ll encounter on a trip such as Taking a Cab, Asking for Directions, or spending a Day at the Museum. Then things get real with engaging, humorous lessons such as Flirting, Pick-Up Lines and Rejections. And that’s just the start…
* Lingidy uses cutting edge Artificial Intelligence to provide you with endless chat lessons.
Try this… “Hey Lingidy, pretend you are Shakira and teach me Spanish while we are clubbing in Miami.”
Or this, “Hey Lingidy, will you be my Italian boyfriend and teach me romantic phrases in Italian?” 
Or even this… “Hey Lingidy, pretend you are Elon Musk and teach me about space travel in English using some South African slang”.
* Speaking exercises use advanced speech recognition to analyze you voice and help you pronounce phrases correctly.
* Word Order exercises teach you how to construct phrases interactively, providing hints if you get stuck.
* Hear any phrase pronounced by tapping on it. Adjust the speed in Settings and select an accent for some languages such as Spanish (Spain, Latin America) and French (France, Canada).
* Looking for a phrase that’s not in one of our lessons. We’ve got you covered. If your search comes up empty, a Translate link appears. Get the best AI-powered translations available in real-time. No other lesson based language learning app offers that.
* Ask other users questions. Got a question about when to use a word or phrase in a specific context? No worries, post them to our forum and get feedback from native speakers around the world.
* Track your progress and set goals.
* Select favorite phrases to create your own study list.
* Picture Exercises for people who learn best with visual cues.
* Spelling exercises. Tap Check button for Hints.
* Difficulty levels in Settings.
* Lingidy is free forever but you can upgrade if you want to unlock bonus content or support our team of Linguistic Lovers from around the world.
* Our mascot, Dolphy, has a rich and sophisticated vocabulary. Owls only seem to know one word, but Hooo’s counting ;-)
Privacy Policy https://lingidy.com/privacy
Terms of Service https://lingidy.com/terms

bluejetty:00014545:ios.name: Pages: Create Documents
bluejetty:00014545:ios.summary: Pages is now part of Apple Creator Studio, an amazing collection of Apple’s most powerful creative apps designed to help you bring your ideas to life. The suite includes Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, Motion, Compressor, and Main
bluejetty:00014545:ios.description:
Pages is now part of Apple Creator Studio, an amazing collection of Apple’s most powerful creative apps designed to help you bring your ideas to life. The suite includes Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro, Motion, Compressor, and MainStage — plus premium content and intelligence features in Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform, all in one simple plan. Creating, viewing, and editing documents in Pages, as well as collaborating with others in real time, does not require a subscription.
Create beautiful documents with Pages on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Start with an Apple-designed template for a report, resume, poster, or digital book. Easily add images, movies, audio, tables, charts, and shapes. Use comments, change tracking, and highlights to review your work. On iPhone and iPad, Screen View optimizes content for your screen, making it easier to edit.
Get Started Quickly
• Work from iPhone, iPad, Mac, or even a PC with iCloud.com
• Select from a wide variety of Apple-designed templates
• Add from a library of shapes, tables, and charts with pre-defined styles
• Import and edit Microsoft Word and text files
Create Beautiful Documents
• Format your document with gorgeous styles, fonts, and textures
• Make your content more engaging with recorded audio, video, and image galleries
• Create page templates to keep the design consistent across your page layout document
• Use powerful graphics tools including image background removal and masking
• Design interactive EPUB books that can be shared with others or published to Apple Books
• Draw, write or annotate with Apple Pencil on iPad
Advanced Tools
• Use the table of contents view to easily navigate your document or book
• Add comments and join threaded conversations
• Turn on change tracking to mark up a document as you edit it
• Create footnotes and endnotes and view character, word, and paragraph counts
• Add elegant mathematical equations using LaTeX or MathML notation
• Use presenter mode on iPhone and iPad to auto scroll text while giving a speech
• Seamless integration with EndNote for inserting citations on Mac*
Share with Anyone
• Share your document publicly or collaborate with specific people using iCloud or Box
• Make changes from any device and see a list of changes from others in real-time
• Export your document in EPUB, Microsoft Word, RTF, TXT, and PDF format
Apple Intelligence
• Use Writing Tools to proofread, rewrite, summarize, and compose text
• Create your own fun images with Image Playground based on a description
Some features of Apple Creator Studio require an Apple Intelligence–capable device. For full system requirements and usage limits for Apple Creator Studio intelligence features, see Apple Support article 125029.
* EndNote sold separately. EndNote integration requires a plug-in available from Apple Support.

bluejetty:00176489:ios.summary:
Embark on an Epic Journey in Dinosaur Universe: A Jurassic RPG Adventure!
Immerse yourself in the prehistoric wonders of the Jurassic world as you lead your pack of raptors in thrilling battles against formidable foes. Dinosaur Universe c
bluejetty:00176489:ios.description:
Embark on an Epic Journey in Dinosaur Universe: A Jurassic RPG Adventure!
Immerse yourself in the prehistoric wonders of the Jurassic world as you lead your pack of raptors in thrilling battles against formidable foes. Dinosaur Universe combines the excitement of dinosaur encounters with the action of RPG gameplay, delivering an addictive idle gaming experience unlike any other.
As the last remaining raptor leader, it's up to you to fend off the menacing Tyrannosaurus and its minions. Hatch eggs to recruit powerful companions and evolve them into fearsome allies capable of taking on even the fiercest adversaries.
Key Features:
■ Jurassic RPG Battles
Engage in thrilling encounters where every bite and scratch counts. Gather resources, strengthen your pack, and conquer the dino world. Experience the ultimate dinosaur battles in the Jurassic park setting, where every battle enhances your RPG adventure.
■ Egg Hatching and Evolution
Discover hidden eggs scattered throughout the land and unlock a diverse array of dinosaurs to join your squad. Evolve your companions to unleash their full potential in battle. Each dinosaur in your park adds to the strategic depth of your Jurassic RPG battles.
■ Upgrade and Customize
Enhance your raptors' abilities through endless upgrades and evolution paths. Dominate the battlefield with your unstoppable force of genetically modified and mechanical dinosaurs. Upgrading your dinosaurs is crucial to surviving in the competitive world of Jurassic park battles.
■ Idle RPG Mechanics
Enjoy the convenience of automatic battles and idle progression, allowing you to effortlessly expand your territory and strengthen your pack. The idle RPG system ensures your dinosaur team grows stronger easily.
■ Explore Endless Possibilities
Dive into a world teeming with adventure and mystery. Uncover the secrets of the dinosaur world as you encounter various species and face off against formidable enemies. The Jurassic park is full of challenges and rewards for those who explore it fully.
■ Easy and Free to Play
Experience the thrill of dinosaur battles without any barriers. Dinosaur Universe is free to download and play, offering hours of entertainment with no internet connection required. Lead your raptor squad and enjoy the Jurassic RPG adventure anytime, anywhere.
Download Dinosaur Universe now and unleash the power of your raptor squad in the ultimate Jurassic RPG adventure! Explore the dino world, engage in epic battles, and upgrade your park to become the mightiest dinosaur leader!

bluejetty:00178033:ios.description:
The Official 《现代汉语词典》（Modern Chinese Dictionary） app
• Published by The Commercial Press
• Edited by Chinese Academy of Social Sciences 
The《现代汉语词典》（Modern Chinese Dictionary） is China's first state-authorized reference for Mandarin pronunciation, characters, and vocabulary standards since 1949, and is recognized as a milestone in Chinese lexicography.
◆ Expert Editorial Team ◆
• Commissioned by the Chinese State Council, developed by top linguists
• Founded by distinguished linguists, including renowned scholars 吕叔湘 (Lü Shuxiang) and 丁声树 (Ding Shengshu)
• Backed by over 100 years of publishing expertise from The Commercial Press
• Winner of the National Book Award, the China Outstanding Publications Award
◆ Comprehensive Learning Resources ◆
【Core Content】Over 70,000 verified entries from the print edition
【Extended Tools】8 specialized dictionaries for writing, grammar, and usage
【Authentic Pronunciation】Audio guides by CCTV veteran anchor 李瑞英 (Li Ruiying)
【Character Mastery】Animated stroke-order guides combined with common error databases
【Cultural Insights】Historical calligraphy styles and character evolution
◆ Smart Search Features ◆
【Dual Modes】Page-flipping simulation and instant keyword search
【Multi-Channel Lookup】Voice, camera, radicals, or Pinyin input
【Word Connections】Auto-generated synonyms, antonyms, and homophones
◆ Personalized Learning ◆
【Cloud Sync】Custom word lists synced across devices
【Daily Lessons】"Word of the Day" with vocabulary-building games
【Instant Help】Grammar tips, stroke guidance, and usage comparisons
Trusted by millions worldwide, this app delivers:
• Accurate language standards for learners
• Practical tools for daily study
• Cultural context for deeper understanding
Modern Chinese Dictionary App – Your smart companion for mastering Mandarin.

4. Auto-Renewal: Your Apple iTunes account will be charged 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. Payment confirmation extends your subscription by one cycle.
5. Cancellation:
*Open iPhone Settings → iTunes & App Store → Tap your Apple ID → Select View Apple ID → Go to Subscriptions → Choose Hanfen VIP Monthly → Turn off auto-renewal.
*Note: You must cancel at least 24 hours before the subscription period ends to avoid automatic renewal.
6. Membership Terms: https://about.shangdii.cn/autopay_service_terms?f=21004

bluejetty:00024937:ios.description:
Get Ready to Ace the TEAS and HESI A2 and Start Your Nursing Journey with Archer Review
Want to boost your chances of getting into nursing school? Archer Review offers a powerful, affordable prep course for the TEAS and HESI A2 exam that helps you build the skills and confidence you need to succeed.
Our TEAS and HESI A2 prep includes two main tools: a robust question bank and a full library of on-demand video lectures (coming soon for HESI A2).
Question Bank Highlights:
• Over 2000 practice questions covering all TEAS exam subjects and lessons
• Over 1500 practice questions covering all HESI A2 exam subjects and lessons
• Detailed explanations to every question to improve understanding
• Create custom practice tests by selecting specific subjects and lessons
• Choose from different modes: Tutor Mode shows answers instantly and Timed Mode simulates the real test
• Real-time performance dashboard tracks your progress and pinpoints your weak areas
• In-depth analytics by subject and lesson so you know exactly where to focus
On-Demand Video Lectures:
• TEAS - Covers every topic tested led by experienced instructors
• HESI A2 On-Demand is coming soon
• Learn test-taking strategies and expert tips to boost your score
• Includes downloadable notes and practice questions for each lesson
• Use timestamps to jump to specific parts of any video
• Adjust speed, pause, rewind, or skip—study at your own pace
• Search videos to find exactly what you need quickly
• Access all current and future content with a single subscription
TEAS Subjects Covered:
• Math: Numbers & Algebra, Measurement & Data
• Science: Anatomy & Physiology, Biology, Chemistry, Scientific Reasoning
• Reading: Key Ideas and Details, Craft and Structure, Integration of Knowledge and Ideas
• English & Language Usage: Standard English Conventions, Knowledge of Language, Vocabulary Acquisition and Usage in Writing
HESI A2 Subjects Covered:
• Math: Whole Numbers, Decimals, Fractions, Percentages, Ratio, Proportions, Statistics, Algebra, and Conversions
• Reading: Main Idea, Supporting Details, Understanding Words in Context, Author’s Purpose and Tone, Fact vs. Opinion, Making Inferences, and Summarizing
• Vocabulary and Grammar: Key Words, Parts of Speech, Common Grammar Mistakes, Word Pairs, and Tips for Success
• Science: Biology, Chemistry, and A&P
Whether you’re just starting out or brushing up, Archer Review gives you everything you need to prepare effectively and confidently.

HESI® is a registered trademark of Elsevier, which is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or associated with Archer Review.

bluejetty:00151716:ios.summary:
SoulRest is a Bible devotion app designed to help you begin Scripture reading from your current emotional state.
Instead of asking you to follow rigid plans or search endlessly for the “right” passage, SoulRest offers a simple starting poin
bluejetty:00151716:ios.description:
SoulRest is a Bible devotion app designed to help you begin Scripture reading from your current emotional state.
Instead of asking you to follow rigid plans or search endlessly for the “right” passage, SoulRest offers a simple starting point: how you feel right now.
Start with your emotions
When you open SoulRest, you can choose an emotional state such as anxiety, fatigue, anger, or uncertainty. Based on your selection, the app presents carefully prepared Bible verses and devotional reflections that align with that moment.
This allows you to approach Scripture in a more personal and approachable way, especially when your mind feels restless or overwhelmed.
Scripture with guided reflection
Each devotion includes:
A selected Bible verse
A short written reflection
A calm, distraction-free reading experience
The content is thoughtfully curated and fully pre-written, helping you focus on reading and reflection without interruptions.
A quiet space for daily devotion
SoulRest is designed for moments when you:
Feel emotionally unsettled and don’t know where to begin reading
Want a gentle entry into Bible devotion
Need a short pause to reflect and pray
Prefer a calm, simple spiritual tool without complexity
SoulRest does not replace the Bible or personal prayer.
It simply helps you begin — with clarity, structure, and intention.

bluejetty:00026448:ios.description:
This is the only official Blood Type Diet® app released by Dr. Peter D’Adamo, international best selling author of the Eat Right For Your Type® book. Whether you are new to the Blood Type Diet® or a long time supporter, this app provides the food lists that are Right for Your Type® at your fingertips. It’s convenient when shopping, traveling, dining out, or simply when you are at home and don’t want to check the Eat Right For Your Type® book. The Blood Type Diet® app lists the Beneficial, Neutral, and Avoid foods for all four blood types. It now includes Unknown for those foods not determined. 
You can easily lookup any food by its category such as vegetables, fish, and beverages or search by the name of the food itself.
This is the entry point for Dr. Peter D'Adamo's Blood Type Diet® based on Right for Your Type® food lists. It's a great way to keep the Blood Type Diet at your fingertips - a quick, concise, and easy reference.
Includes:
Blood Type and optional Secretor Status selection
Food Lists
Shopping List - choose your own or combine family list for multiple blood types —see More section, then Family Food
Email Shopping List directly from the app 
Family Food List - combine common foods for multiple blood types —icon indicator lets you know if your are viewing Family Food List or the individual's.
Information about each Blood Type
User Guide
Latest food updates
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Food Search
Convenient Recipe Access (Note: Internet connection required)
We do support our app and encourage you to ask a question if you need help - or maybe just tell us what you like (see More, then Feedback or email appsupport@dadamo.com). We do want the app to work for you.
If you are new to the Blood Type Diet®, you can visit the www.4yourtype.com or www.dadamo.com websites to learn much more.

bluejetty:00065767:ios.description:

It’s up to you to assemble an unstoppable team of evolved super birds and put a stop to the pigs’ shenanigans once and for all. Or at least until the next time they pull a stunt like this...
Collect, assemble, and evolve your flock.
100+ crazy new Angry Birds?! We’re gonna need a bigger nest. The flock is bigger and badder than ever before. Build your own team, combine super skills and evolve your birds into their ultimate form.
Embark on an epic adventure.
Something sinister is brewing on Bird Island. Why are there so many pigs around? Who is behind the mysterious Bacon Corp? What’s the Eagle Force? Who lost the dungeon keys? Find the answers – only in Angry Birds Evolution.
FEATURES:
– Over 100 colorful new characters to hatch and collect.
– Assemble the ultimate flock of birds and take down the pigs with ease.
– 5 Classes of birds with unique abilities.
– Evolve your feathery heroes into unstoppable super birds.
– Explore the island and stop the Bacon Corp.
– Climb up the Eagle Mountain and win ultimate eggs.
– Battle other players in the Oinktagon.
– Join clans to unlock perks, compete with other clans, and chat with clanmates.
– Send out scouts for rewards & challenges.
MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION
Angry Birds Evolution offers a subscription service that grants subscribers exclusive benefits every month. 
Subscription Benefits: 
– One Premium Egg Ticket every day
– 10% more gold and gems when purchasing in the shop
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account >Settings after purchase
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that >publication, where applicable
The monthly subscription is available as a recurring monthly purchase at a price of 24.99 USD (or local equivalent) / month. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account starting at the initial confirmation of the subscription purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew 24-hours before the end of the current payment period. 
Manage subscription auto-renewal in iTunes Account Settings. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Cancellation will take effect at the start of the next subscription period.
---
We may update the game periodically, for example to add new features or content or to fix bugs or other technical issues. Please note that the game may not function properly if you do not have the newest version installed. If you have not installed the latest update, Rovio will not be responsible for the game failing to function as expected.
While our game is free to download and play, some game items can also be purchased for real money and the game may include loot boxes or other game mechanics with random rewards. Purchasing these items is optional but you can also disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.rovio.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.rovio.com/privacy
---
This game may include: 
- Direct links to social networking websites that are intended for an audience over the age of 13. 
- Direct links to the internet that can take players away from the game with the potential to browse any web page. 
- Advertising of Rovio products and also products from select partners.
- The option to make in-app purchases. The bill payer should always be consulted beforehand.
- This application may require internet connectivity and subsequent data transfer charges may apply. After the initial download, additional content will be downloaded and this may include data charges.

It’s up to you to assemble an unstoppable team of evolved super birds and put a stop to the pigs’ shenanigans once and for all. Or at least until the next time they pull a stunt like this...

Collect, assemble, and evolve your flock.
100+ crazy new Angry Birds?! We’re gonna need a bigger nest. The flock is bigger and badder than ever before. Build your own team, combine super skills and evolve your birds into their ultimate form.

Embark on an epic adventure.
Something sinister is brewing on Bird Island. Why are there so many pigs around? Who is behind the mysterious Bacon Corp? What’s the Eagle Force? Who lost the dungeon keys? Find the answers – only in Angry Birds Evolution.

FEATURES:
– Over 100 colorful new characters to hatch and collect.
– Assemble the ultimate flock of birds and take down the pigs with ease.
– 5 Classes of birds with unique abilities.
– Evolve your feathery heroes into unstoppable super birds.
– Explore the island and stop the Bacon Corp.
– Climb up the Eagle Mountain and win ultimate eggs.
– Battle other players in the Oinktagon.
– Join clans to unlock perks, compete with other clans, and chat with clanmates.
– Send out scouts for rewards & challenges.

MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION
Angry Birds Evolution offers a subscription service that grants subscribers exclusive benefits every month. 

Subscription Benefits: 
– One Premium Egg Ticket every day
– 10% more gold and gems when purchasing in the shop

– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account >Settings after purchase
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that >publication, where applicable

The monthly subscription is available as a recurring monthly purchase at a price of 24.99 USD (or local equivalent) / month. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account starting at the initial confirmation of the subscription purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew 24-hours before the end of the current payment period. 

Manage subscription auto-renewal in iTunes Account Settings. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Cancellation will take effect at the start of the next subscription period.

---

We may update the game periodically, for example to add new features or content or to fix bugs or other technical issues. Please note that the game may not function properly if you do not have the newest version installed. If you have not installed the latest update, Rovio will not be responsible for the game failing to function as expected.

While our game is free to download and play, some game items can also be purchased for real money and the game may include loot boxes or other game mechanics with random rewards. Purchasing these items is optional but you can also disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.rovio.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.rovio.com/privacy

bluejetty:00090670:ios.description:
Presenting SoSoValue, the AI-powered app for smarter and simpler crypto investing. Whether you are tracking 10,000+ cryptocurrencies, analyzing Crypto ETFs, we equip all the tools you need to succeed. Stay up to date with live AI-driven news feeds, build your personalized watchlist, and connect with a vibrant crypto community in TokenBar. Trusted by millions of investors globally, SoSoValue revolutionizes crypto research with innovative AI tools, offering a tailored and comprehensive experience. It is your go to companion for navigating the fast-paced crypto market.
SoSoValue app is a free crypto platform that allows you to:
- Track Real-Time Crypto Prices: Get real-time prices, market-data, and trends for your favorite coins.
- Stay up-to-date with AI-Powered Crypto News Feed: Get personalized updates and market insights tailored to your needs and interests
- Analyze ETFs and Market Data: Simplify decisions with live inflow/outlow data and performance dashboards.
- Track Sector Trends: Monitor specific crypto sectors, like Defi and Memes, to never miss out emerging investment opportunities.
- Find Your Tribe at TokenBar: Share insights, discuss trends, and learn from fellow investors at TokenBar. 
- Earn Rewards for Engagement: Unlock exclusive perks with our dynamic EXP Reward Center. 
Features offered on SoSoValue app:
Track Real-Time Crypto Prices 
Access real-time prices, coin stats, trading volumes, market caps, and detailed charts for over 10,000 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Dogecoin, and more. SoSoValue keeps you informed on all major market movements with comprehensive crypto coverage.
Stay up-to-date with AI-Powered Crypto News Feed: 
Get personalized crypto news powered by AI, delivering real-time updates on major trends and developments. SoSoValue’s intelligent feeds ensure you’re always in the loop, with the most relevant insights based on your interests, available in multiple languages and in format of both text and podcast.
Get AI-Driven Market Insights & Alerts
Leverage AI-powered insights and real-time voice alerts to stay on top of market fluctuations and key price movements, ensuring you never miss an important trend.
Analyze ETFs and Market Data
Gain valuable insights into crypto ETFs with SoSoValue’s intuitive dashboards, designed for easy navigation and comprehensive analysis. Track various asset classes and market trends with ease, positioning yourself ahead of the curve in the emerging crypto ETF space.
Track Sector Movers
Monitor specific crypto sectors like DeFi and NFTs to uncover emerging opportunities. SoSoValue’s sector tracking tools help you stay ahead of industry shifts and discover promising areas for investment.
Find Your Tribe at TokenBar
Engage with the global crypto community in the TokenBar forum. Share insights, discuss trends, and connect with fellow investors to stay informed and inspired.
Earn Rewards for Engagement
Unlock exciting rewards as you engage with the app. The EXP Reward Center recognizes your activity and offers exclusive incentives to enhance your experience.
Analyze Crypto with Comprehensive Charting Tools
Utilize advanced charting tools to conduct detailed technical analysis, helping you make data-driven decisions and assess market trends effectively.
Monitor Global Trends with Macro Charts
Understand the impact of global macroeconomic factors on the crypto market. SoSoValue’s macro charts provide valuable context, helping you make strategic, informed investment decisions.

Easily provide secure remote access and support across your organization. Work from anywhere with remote desktop access to your powerful office computer from a laptop or mobile device. And IT & helpdesk teams have all the features they need to manage remote support for their entire organization.
Why Splashtop
• Anytime unattended access with 4k streaming
• Simple on-demand support across all platforms
• Security you can trust to enable users to work from home
• Live support when you need it
Experience Splashtop Today – Start a Free Trial
1. Download the business app on the devices/computers you would like to connect from
2. Sign up for a free trial and create a Splashtop account
3. Download the streamer (splashtop.com/streamer) on the computer you would like to connect to
4. That’s it! Login and start your session!
*For attended access, please have your end-user download the Splashtop SOS App to their computer or mobile device.
Key Features:
• Broad Device Support – iOS, Windows, Mac, & Linux
• Cross-Platform Support
• Multi-to-Multi Monitor
• Remote Print
• Chat
• User Management*
• Group View*
• Remote reboot and reconnect*
• Unattended Remote Control*
• Attended Remote Access and Remote Control*
• Session Recording*
• SSO**
• Remote Device Management**
*SOS and Enterprise
**Enterprise
Splashtop Products – Pick the product that is right for you!
• Splashtop Business Access (splashtop.com/business) - Unattended desktop remote access for individuals and businesses to control computers from anywhere
• Splashtop SOS (splashtop.com/sos) - Attended and unattended remote access and support for IT and Helpdesk teams
• Splashtop Enterprise (splashtop.com/enterprise) - Attended and unattended remote access and support with SSO/SAML integration, remote device management, and more!

The Centre Daily Times local newspaper app is faster and easier to use. Read or watch daily local news coverage, investigative reporting, national headline news, crime, sports, local business, and more from State College, Bellefonte, and communities across Happy Valley in Pennsylvania.
The Centre Daily Times local news is your trusted source for local, daily journalism serving the Happy Valley region. Our newsroom delivers reporting on local government, public safety, education, courts, business, and community issues affecting residents in State College, Bellefonte, and surrounding Pennsylvania communities, alongside statewide coverage and national headline news.
LOCAL NEWS
• Daily local news and stories from around the Happy Valley area
• AI generated summaries on all articles reviewed by our newsroom
• The Centre Daily Times opinions, editorials and columns you love
• Edition, a digital destination for the latest news, features, and insights. Like the printed newspaper, it is intended to be a complete report of the day’s news compiled by our editors overnight
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video of local news stories and national news coverage
• View stunning photos and videos of local news and community events
LOCAL SPORTS
• Full coverage reporting on local, pro and college sports teams
• Stay connected to your favorite teams and favorite sports writers
PERSONALIZATION
• Stay informed on the topics and articles that matter to you
• Favorite topics to get personalized feeds. • Search for news articles, videos, games and more
• Bookmark news articles to read later
• Read articles your way with full support for dark mode and light mode
Other Features
• Browse articles by category
• Share articles on Facebook, X Twitter or by email
• Comment on news articles
• Access and download previous issues of our newspaper
• Recharge and unwind with our puzzles and games
GET DAILY NEWS AND MORE WITH THE CENTRE DAILY TIMES NEWS APP
Download our local newspaper app today to stay informed on local daily news, crime, sports, national headlines, and more.

Read our Terms of Service here: https://www.mcclatchy.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00023391:ios.description:
Compete against your friends to complete hilarious challenges in just seven seconds!
Perfect for parties, date nights, sleepovers, family gatherings and breaking the ice, 7 Second Challenge is a fast-paced group game that is easy to learn and guaranteed to get everyone laughing.
Take turns completing randomly selected challenges before the timer runs out. Once the seven seconds are up, the other players decide whether the challenge was completed successfully. Earn points, climb the scoreboard and prove that you can think fast under pressure!
Features:
- 300+ fun and original challenges
- Create and play your own custom challenges
- Play with up to 16 players on one device
- Keep track of everyone’s scores
- Choose the number of rounds
Tired of playing Would You Rather, Truth or Dare, Never Have I Ever and the same old party games? Gather your friends and put your speed, creativity and quick thinking to the test with 7 Second Challenge.
The rules are simple:
1) Add your players.
2) Take turns completing a random challenge.
3) Finish it before the seven-second timer ends.
4) Let the group decide whether you earned the point.
5) Finish with the highest score to win!
Inspired by the original 7 Second Challenge concept created by AmazingPhil.
What are you waiting for? Gather your friends, start the timer and see who can handle the pressure!

Cougarly is a bold and modern cougar dating app designed to connect mature, self-assured women with younger men who admire them. Whether you're interested in age-gap dating, finding someone new nearby, or simply want to meet like-minded singles, Cougarly helps you make meaningful, exciting connections.
We believe that relationships shouldn't be limited by age. Our app empowers women to embrace their confidence and men to explore genuine connections beyond age stereotypes. Whether you're here for romance, companionship, casual dating, or something that grows into more, Cougarly is your space. 
Cougarly has grown to become one of the largest cougar dating sites catering exclusively to mature cougar singles and  young men looking to date them. If online browsing has brought you to cougar life, chances are our community has what you're looking for.
Key Features:
- Discover local singles nearby based on your preferences
- Swipe to match with like-minded members
- Use advanced filters to find your ideal connection (age, location, interests, lifestyle)
- Send free roses and messages to express your interest
- Share your story in your profile to increase visibility and attract genuine matches
- Play the “Match” game to spark random fun connections
- Find open-minded people with the “Tag” feature
Whether you're a mature woman looking to date younger men, or a younger guy excited to meet strong, attractive women, Cougarly is a safe and exciting place to meet.
Why Choose Cougarly?
- Designed for age-gap dating and intergenerational romance
- All profiles are reviewed to maintain a respectful community
- Active, open-minded community of mature women and younger men
- Connect anytime, anywhere — on your terms
Free & Premium Options:
Cougarly is free to download and use, with optional premium subscriptions available to unlock enhanced features and faster matches. We offer monthly, 3 months and 6 months subscriptions. The prices may vary per country. Prices are clearly displayed in the app.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current 1, 3, or 6 month periods. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. If you don’t choose to purchase Cougarly Premium, you can simply continue using and enjoying Cougarly for free.
Privacy First:
We prioritize your safety. Every profile is manually reviewed, and users can block or report any inappropriate behavior instantly.
Questions or feedback? 
Reach out anytime: support@cougarly.co

bluejetty:00126844:ios.description:
▷ iLocation is a tool to search and share location easily and quickly.
With iLocation, you can tell the current location or the specified location by several screen clicks. And if you want to know the coordinates or address of the current location, you can simply run iLocation.
When you want to explain an appointment, or when you need to know your current location in a hurry, you can also pin the map on top of the map and simply select the transport to share the location.
◉ Function
• Automatically display current location information when running App
• Coordinate and altitude display of current position or specified position
• Show the location's address
• Show compass bearing
• Change the map format (General, Satellite)
• Specify the center of the map and check the coordinates and addresses
• Specify coordinates by entering coordinates
• Specify an arbitrary location by entering an address (Pro)
• Save map to camera roll or clipboard
• Save your location to Favorites for reuse
• Save the specified location information and map or share it via SNS
• The location is sent to the URL so that the recipient can connect to the map immediately
If you have iLocation, you will be able to explain your location without having to talk.
◉ Notice
• This is a completely free app, so no payment or subscription is required.
• Depending on the user's location and environment, GPS signal reception may not be smooth or there may be differences in accuracy.
• This app cannot change your device's system GPS information.
• Since the content of banner ads is published by advertising agencies, we do not know or participate in the interaction between the ads and app users.

bluejetty:00163444:android.description:
A popular tactical RPG where you can enjoy a battle system that tests your strategy and a solid authentic story.
The Ardra continent is a land of endless conflicts over hegemony.
A threat loomed over the small but independent "Lionis of the Red Lion".
What is the inescapable fate and destiny that the young twin princes of Leonis bear in the midst of the conflict...
A story called the Illusion War begins now, with twin princes and a beautiful iron princess.
Equipped with "auto mode" and "double speed mode" that are safe even for beginners.
Even those who play tactical RPG for the first time can enjoy it easily.
In addition, we have implemented useful functions that do not waste physical strength, such as "Skip Ticket" and "Repeat until a specific material drops"!
Defeat powerful enemies with the powerful special move "Limit Burst", which is unique to the FINAL FANTASY series!
Familiar FINAL FANTASY jobs such as Knight, Dragon Knight, White Mage, Black Mage,
Numerous jobs such as the job "Arithmetician" unique to tactical RPGs are now available!
Raise your favorite job and fight!
In addition, series familiar summons such as "Shiva" and "Odin" will also appear in powerful 3D movies!
The BGM of this work is in charge of Elements Garden (Noriyasu Uematsu), who is familiar with the FFBE series.
The heavy tones recorded by the full orchestra color the world of Illusion Wars.
You can enjoy the main story with full voice.
Enjoy the story of the Illusion War with the voices of gorgeous voice actors!

◆ ---------------------------------------- ◆
 Story introduction
◆ ---------------------------------------- ◆
Ardra continent where the great powers are competing.
One day, an incident occurs that shakes the balance of each country.
-There is a brigade attacked by bandits near the border-
Receiving the news, the young prince Mont of Leonis went to the scene.
There, Mont has a fateful encounter with an unexpected person.
It was Mashley, the princess of the great power Horn, known as the Iron Princess.
Taking advantage of the fateful encounter between the two,
The battle for supremacy over the Ardra continent becomes even more intense.
Presented by Square Enix
The latest in the FINAL FANTASY series tactical RPG!
The story called "Illusion War" begins now.

bluejetty:00073295:ios.description:
ABOUT THIS APP
We take the stress out of storage. Now we've made your self-storage experience even easier. With the free Public Storage app, you have everything you need for contactless storage in the palm of your hands: gate access, bill pay, account management, customer support and more!
OPEN GATES & DOORS:
Breeze right past the keypads at virtually every location. Just tap your phone and go. Once you’re within range of a gate, door or elevator, you gain access to your self-storage space with a touch. So every visit to your Public Storage unit is speedier.
PAY YOUR BILL:
Make monthly payments in a snap. Pay your bill or activate AutoPay with one tap for easy, contactless payments. Get notified when rent is due so you’re always on time and freed from late fees.
KEEP YOUR ACCOUNT IN CHECK:
Manage one or multiple accounts and storage units, all in one place. Update your payment preferences and other settings without a call to customer service or visit to your local Public Storage facility.
TALK TO THE SUPPORT TEAM:
Get the help you need, right when you need it. Find answers to critical questions. Call for instant support from our friendly customer service team. Drop us a quick note for important, but less timely storage needs.
ABOUT PUBLIC STORAGE:
Since opening our first self-storage location in 1972, we’ve grown to become the largest owner and operator of storage facilities in the world. With thousands of locations across the U.S. and Europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we have the space you need right in your neighborhood. 
With complete storage solutions of all sizes, there’s always a storage unit near you that lets you make extra space in your garage or basement, store your car or RV and find a temporary place for your furniture. Plus, flexible month-to-month contracts mean you can adjust your storage space to your short-term or long-term needs.

bluejetty:00183239:ios.description:
Shop fresh products from farmers | Free Shipping
It's easy to shop for groceries without leaving your home with Sayurbox! Prove it by installing now!
Sayurbox is an online shopping application in Jabodetabek that is practical for all your kitchen needs. We deliver everything directly to your doorstep and of course, FREE SHIPPING*!
Shop for fresh vegetables and fruits directly from farmers
Shop for the freshest and guaranteed quality proteins
Shop for cooking packages and pre-cut vegetables to make cooking easier
Shop for various basic needs for your kitchen
Keep shopping and collect XP and points to level up and get special discounts
Available delivery slots according to your needs:
Same Day Delivery - Shop before 3:00 PM WIB, items can arrive on the same day!
Jabodetabek
Afternoon Slot (2:00 PM - 5:00 PM WIB)
Evening Slot 1 (5:00 PM - 8:00 PM WIB)
Evening Slot 2 (8:00 PM - 10:00 PM WIB)

Morning Slot (8:00 AM - 11:00 AM WIB)
Noon Slot (11:00 AM - 2:00 PM WIB)
Afternoon Slot (2:00 PM - 5:00 PM WIB)

We conduct layered quality control, including packaging your shopping items neatly and cleanly (using paper wrap, plastic, aluminum foil, and ice gel if necessary)

Discover the restaurant and listen to music, take a nap in the Family room, VIP room or Honeymoon suite or indulge in wellness. Hang out at the spa to experience rest and relaxation at its finest. Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.

bluejetty:00123138:ios.description:
APP DESCRIPTION:
The Stock Growers Bank app is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Stock Growers Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Stock Growers Bank Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a Stock Growers Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00171149:ios.name: Winmail Reader Lite
bluejetty:00171149:ios.summary:
Winmail Reader is ultimate tool for reading "winmail.dat" attachment files on iPhones, iPads and iPod touch. Winmail Reader decodes "winmail.dat" file, and allows any attachments contained in them to be opened, read, saved or e-mailed.
* *
bluejetty:00171149:ios.description:
Winmail Reader is ultimate tool for reading "winmail.dat" attachment files on iPhones, iPads and iPod touch. Winmail Reader decodes "winmail.dat" file, and allows any attachments contained in them to be opened, read, saved or e-mailed.
* * * Winmail Reader for Mac is also available on the Mac App Store. * * *
Winmail.dat files are in fact TNEF format (Transport Neutral Encapsulation Format). Microsoft Outlook e-mail program for Windows send e-mails as TNEF. Most other e-mail programs, including Mail, do not understand TNEF. If your e-mail program doesn't understand TNEF, you may only see an attachment named "winmail.dat" that you cannot open. The easy-to-use solution to circumvent this problem is provided by Winmail Reader.
FEATURES:
◆ Decodes "winmail.dat" files and list all attachments contained in it including email message.
◆ Inbuilt quick-look preview to view attachments. Tap on attachment button to popup quick-look preview.
◆ Allows attachments files to Copy to… another application, Save to Files, Copy, Print, share file to nearby iOS devices via AirDrop and more... Long press on attachment button to show share action options.
◆ Resend entire decoded email as it is with message and extracted attachments.
◆ Creates, edit and adds Microsoft Outlook Appointment and Meeting to iOS Calendar. It also reads embedded note.
◆ Creates and adds contact address card into iOS Contacts.
◆ Reads nested message in full RTF format as separate file.
- The Lite Version can only decode winmail.dat file and show sender, subject, message and list of attachments. You can upgrade to full version at any time to remove all limitations to allows you to open, read, share, save, e-Mail all extracted attachments without any restrictions.

bluejetty:00046025:ios.description:
HEALBE is the companion app for HEALBE GoBe smart bands and HEALBE Scale.
GoBe helps you better understand how your daily habits affect your body. The smart band automatically estimates calorie intake, tracks hydration levels, monitors activity, and provides insights into how your body responds throughout the day — no manual logging required.
Manage your nutrition and lifestyle with ease. GoBe automatically calculates your calorie balance and organizes your data so you can stay focused on your goals.
With more than 32 body and lifestyle indicators, HEALBE gives you a complete picture of your daily patterns in one simple app.
GoBe tracks key metrics in real time, while the HEALBE app shows clear trends and easy-to-understand insights:
• Estimated calorie intake and calories burned (Energy Balance)
• Hydration trends and estimated water loss
• Daily stress levels
• Your overall daily state (calm, productive, tense, or overactive)
• Continuous heart rate tracking, including resting heart rate
• Sleep insights for both night sleep and short naps, including sleep quality trends and number of awakenings
• Steps taken and distance traveled
All data is presented in a clear and simple way to help you better understand your daily routines.

bluejetty:00098875:ios.description:
Woolscape 3D – A Cozy, Vibrant Puzzle Adventure!
Step into the coloful world of Woolscape 3D, where matching fuzzy patches becomes an art form. In this soothing wool‑themed puzzle game, your mission is clear: line up three wool pieces of the same hue to fill up yarn boxes and clear beautifully crafted 3D models spun entirely from colorful threads.
Every stage unveils a charming new wool creation—whether it’s adorable animals, delectable treats, or familiar objects. As you peel away each yarn design, you’ll relish a calming blend of brain‑teasing play and creative delight.
HOW TO PLAY
Tap on wool or yarn bits embedded in the model
Match three of the same color to assemble a tidy yarn box
Remove every thread from the sculpture to unlock the next challenge
Plan your moves wisely—one wrong patch can leave you all tangled up!
FEATURES
Gorgeous 3D models woven entirely from vibrant wool
Intuitive gameplay that’s easy to pick up, yet deep enough for puzzle fans
A delightful fusion of match‑3 mechanics, sorting puzzles, and visual calm
Fluid animations and comforting textures inspired by knitting and fiber art
Perfect for quick breaks or longer unwinding sessions
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WOOLSCAPE 3D
Merges the warmth of yarn crafting with clever, relaxing puzzles
Appeals to lovers of brain‑benders, sorting games, and knit‑style visuals
Progress through hundreds of levels for endless woolly satisfaction
Suitable for all ages—simple to learn, impossible to stop playing
Whether you’re seeking a stress‑free escape, wanting to sharpen your planning skills, or just craving the tactile joy of sorting soft wool puzzles, Woolscape 3D offers a soothing yet addictive experience. It’s the ideal companion for coffee breaks, bedtime calm, or any moment you need a cozy space.
Download now and let the wool‑tastic fun begin!

bluejetty:00095557:ios.summary:
Unravel the Threads of Joy: The Ultimate Cozy Yarn Puzzle!
Welcome to Knit Away - a satisfying yarn puzzle game designed to bring calm and relaxing vibes to your day. If you love cozy puzzle challenges, it's time to unravel vibrant threads
bluejetty:00095557:ios.description:
Unravel the Threads of Joy: The Ultimate Cozy Yarn Puzzle!
Welcome to Knit Away - a satisfying yarn puzzle game designed to bring calm and relaxing vibes to your day. If you love cozy puzzle challenges, it's time to unravel vibrant threads and bring order to beautifully knitted designs in this unique color sort adventure.
Put your organization skills to the test with satisfying thread mechanics. Every move in this calm wool sort puzzle is a brain teaser that helps you unwind while keeping your mind sharp. Whether you're a fan of screw puzzles or simply looking for a relaxing knit game — Knit Away is your perfect escape.
How to Play:
• Tap & Sort: Pull colorful threads from beautifully knitted items and sort them into matching-colored boxes
• Strategic Unraveling: Use empty slots as temporary holders for tricky yarn pieces as you solve each cozy puzzle
• Find the Perfect Angle: Drag to rotate and pinch to zoom to see the best way to unravel the wool
• Plan Wisely: Keep your board clear to master this satisfying thread challenge - once all slots are filled, it's game over! 
What You'll Actually Feel:
From the moment you pull your first colorful thread, you'll feel it - that deeply satisfying ASMR sensation that keeps you coming back level after level. Sink into soothing pastel visuals and peaceful background music as you master the unravel puzzle logic across hundreds of diverse handcrafted levels, with new cozy content added every week. Use your slots wisely to sort wool by color, clear the board, and work your way through increasingly tricky yarn sort patterns that are easy to learn - but genuinely hard to put down.
Game Features:
• New handcrafted cozy puzzle content added every week
• Vibrant colorful yarn designs with relaxing, ASMR-style visuals
• Optional extra boxes and slots for flexible wool sort gameplay
• Smooth satisfying thread mechanics with rotate & zoom controls
• Daily rewards and challenges to keep your knit game streak going
• Enjoy your relaxing puzzle anytime - fully playable offline
Perfect For:
Whether you're a fan of wool sort screw puzzles, color sort challenges, calm threads games, or simply want a satisfying yarn experience to decompress - Knit Away is the perfect hybrid-casual relaxing puzzle game for you.
Take a breath. Pull a thread. Feel the calm.
Download Knit Away now — sort, unravel, and knit your way to joy, one thread at a time!

bluejetty:00078223:ios.summary:
Most goal apps are lists. Goals is a coach.
Meet the Growth Coach — a new kind of AI coach that doesn't just talk. It builds with you: share what you're working toward and the coach creates the goal, breaks it into steps, designs tiny habi
bluejetty:00078223:ios.description:
Most goal apps are lists. Goals is a coach.
Meet the Growth Coach — a new kind of AI coach that doesn't just talk. It builds with you: share what you're working toward and the coach creates the goal, breaks it into steps, designs tiny habits around it, sets reminders, checks you in, and tracks your pace — all from conversation, always yours to confirm.
And it coaches the way the best books do. The coach knows 16 research-backed methods and applies the right one to your situation:
• Atomic Habits & Tiny Habits — start small, stay consistent
• CBT thinking tools — for the thoughts that get in the way
• Deep Work & Flow — protect and train your focus
• Getting Things Done & SMART goals — get organized for real
• Stoic practice, Self-compassion, Grit, The ONE Thing, and more
READ THE METHOD, THEN PRACTICE IT
The Practice Library is a shelf of beautiful, magazine-style guides — each method's key idea drawn as a real figure, its moving parts, golden lines from the authors, worked examples, and a "try this now" you can hand straight to your coach.
TRACK WHAT MATTERS
• Goals with progress, pace per day, and a projected finish
• Habits with rings, streaks, and live routines you can run step by step
• Your own life areas, colors, and photo backgrounds
• A calendar of everything — including the days you worked with your coach
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Coach chats are saved on your device, not in your account. Your history shows how much you practiced — never what you said.
IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Fully localized in 17 languages. The coach speaks yours.
Free to start: up to 20 goals and 8 habits. Pro removes the limits.
Every account includes free coach messages. Start with what's on your mind — and build from there.
