Harassed by "No Caller ID" calls? Turn the tables on them with MaskOff. Get instant proof of who's really calling and take back control.
Want proof it works? Call us with your number blocked at *67 1-415-429-1633. We'll show you what we can do!
REVEAL THE HIDDEN NUMBER
When someone hides behind No Caller ID, Private, or Blocked, MaskOff can reveal the phone number calling you. Decline the eligible hidden call and receive an alert with the revealed number.
TURN REPEATED CALLS INTO A RECORD
Keep revealed numbers, timestamps, and available call recordings together. Instead of trying to remember what happened, you’ll have a clear history of the calls you received.
CREATE EVIDENCE YOU CAN USE
Export your records as an evidence PDF or CSV for yourself, the police, an attorney, or anyone helping you deal with the situation.
Police and victim-support organizations have recommended MaskOff to people experiencing abuse. Evidence PDFs generated by MaskOff have also been used in U.S. court proceedings.
WORKS WITH ALL U.S. CARRIERS
MaskOff works with all U.S. carriers. Some mobile plans may require your carrier to enable conditional call forwarding on your line before setup.
SET UP ONCE
MaskOff guides you through a quick, one-time setup. When an eligible hidden call arrives, decline it and MaskOff handles the rest.
GET ANSWERS. TAKE BACK CONTROL.
You should not have to live with the fear and uncertainty of anonymous calls. MaskOff helps you identify the number, document the pattern, and decide what to do next.
NEED HELP?
Contact: support@maskoff.com

bluejetty:00116332:ios.name: Bass Booster - Volume Booster
bluejetty:00116332:ios.summary: This app offers audio enthusiasts a top-tier audio playback experience along with highly customizable sound adjustment features. Whether you are in a noisy environment or immersed in a music world with powerful bass and clear sound quality,
bluejetty:00116332:ios.description:
This app offers audio enthusiasts a top-tier audio playback experience along with highly customizable sound adjustment features. Whether you are in a noisy environment or immersed in a music world with powerful bass and clear sound quality, you will enjoy an ultimate listening experience. It is suitable for all users who love audio tuning, especially music lovers, audio producers, and those who enjoy high-quality audio in daily life. The app not only supports local music playback but also provides diverse functions such as music import and audio processing, meeting users’ multiple needs for sound quality and functionality.
FEATURES
Bass Booster
The bass boost feature is designed to enhance the low-frequency parts of the audio, making the bass in your music deeper and more impactful. Whether you are a fan of electronic music, rock, or hip-hop, the bass boost delivers a more intense and immersive auditory experience. By enhancing the low frequencies, you can enjoy a truly immersive music sensation, with a noticeable improvement especially on tracks with prominent bass effects.
Volume Booster
The volume boost function effectively increases the overall audio output, making the sound clearer and more penetrating. This is especially useful when using the app in noisy environments or playing audio files with originally low volume. Whether you are on a noisy street, public transportation, or outdoors, the volume boost ensures every detail of the music can be heard clearly.
Equalizer
The built-in multi-band equalizer allows users to adjust the balance of treble, midrange, and bass according to personal preference or different music genres. Users can customize sound effects for different styles such as classical, pop, jazz, etc., finely tuning the performance of each note to ensure every song sounds its best.
Music Player
The app supports local music playback, enabling users to easily manage their music library and play their favorite songs anytime. With this feature, users can access all audio files stored on their device and quickly search for and play music they love.
Audio Import
To facilitate quick import and processing of audio files, the app offers multiple import methods, supporting audio retrieval from various devices and cloud storage. Users can transfer files from other devices over Wi-Fi or import audio files from cloud services like Google Drive, iCloud Drive, Dropbox, and more.
OTHER HIGHLIGHTS
- High-Quality Audio Format Support: Supports multiple audio formats such as MP3, WAV, FLAC, ensuring high-quality playback to meet the needs of professional audio producers and music lovers.
- Intuitive Interface: The app features a clean and user-friendly interface, with clearly organized function modules and simple operation for quick mastery.
This app combines audio playback with personalized tuning to provide users with an unprecedented music experience. Not only does it support local music playback, but it also offers powerful sound adjustment features to satisfy different scenarios and individual preferences. Whether you are a music lover, audio producer, or general user, you can enjoy high-quality audio and a customized musical journey anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00076369:ios.summary:
Discover 150+ solitaire games in one complete collection.
Play the solitaire classics you know and love — including Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, TriPeaks and Yukon — and discover dozens of challenging and lesser-known card games.
bluejetty:00076369:ios.description:
Discover 150+ solitaire games in one complete collection.
Play the solitaire classics you know and love — including Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, TriPeaks and Yukon — and discover dozens of challenging and lesser-known card games.
Solitaire Master brings together 150+ solitaire games, from timeless classics to unusual variations such as Forty Thieves, Scorpion, Golf, Monte Carlo, Scoundrel, Sawayama, Baker's Dozen, Accordion, Canfield and many more.
Whether you want a quick relaxing game, a challenging solitaire that requires strategy, or simply want to discover new ways to play cards, there is always another game to try.
DAILY SOLITAIRE CHALLENGES
Take on a new challenge every day with popular games such as Klondike, Klondike by Threes, Yukon, FreeCell and Spider. Complete the daily challenges and test your solitaire skills throughout the month.
WINNABLE OR RANDOM GAMES
Choose how you want to play. Try a random deal for the traditional solitaire experience or choose a winnable game when you want a deal that can be solved.
150+ SOLITAIRE GAMES
Enjoy classics such as Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, TriPeaks and Yukon, along with dozens of other games including Forty Thieves, Scorpion, Golf, Monte Carlo, Scoundrel, Sawayama, Baker's Dozen, Accordion, Canfield and many more.
MAKE EVERY GAME YOUR OWN
Customize your solitaire experience with different card decks, card backs, backgrounds and game layouts. Adjust card sizes, margins and other options to make each game comfortable to play on your device.
Play in portrait or landscape mode on iPhone or iPad, with layouts designed to make the best use of every screen size.
LEARN NEW SOLITAIRE GAMES
Every solitaire includes detailed rules and instructions, making it easy to discover games you have never played before. Hints are also available whenever you need a little help.
MORE FEATURES
• Daily Challenges
• Winnable and random games
• Detailed statistics for every game
• Achievements
• Hints
• Undo and redo
• Save and restore games
• Multiple layouts for every solitaire
• Customizable cards and backgrounds
• Portrait and landscape modes
• Victory animations, relaxing sound effects and subtle haptic feedback
• Filters to find games by difficulty, duration and other characteristics
• Play offline
Solitaire Master is made for both casual players who enjoy a classic game of Klondike and solitaire enthusiasts looking for challenging and unusual card games.
Start with a classic, discover something new and find your next favorite solitaire.

Hold a world of fitness in the palm of your hand with MyDiR! The new DiR App will give you complete control over your experience before and during your workouts, all through your phone.

Search:
- Access a detailed database of our experienced personal trainers, knowledgeable physiotherapists, and exciting in-house activities.
Get informed:
- View the biography and qualifications of all of our personal trainers and physiotherapists
- Access a helpful summary of each and every one of the directed activities at DiR

In addition, if a session that interests you is full, if you go into the wait list, the MyDiR app will notify you when there is any free space at any time and then you can book it!
Your reservations will be registered in your personal agenda, so you view your upcoming bookings at any time.
You also have a stopwatch available within MyDiR to accurately track your routines.
Go ahead and discover MyDiR, the fastest connection between thinking and training!

Step into the HeadOn: Bodycam Shooter – An Unmatched Realism on Mobile!
Prepare to be immersed in the most realistic first-person shooter experience ever created for mobile. This groundbreaking bodycam simulator brings hyper-realistic visuals and unparalleled gameplay that redefines mobile combat.
Key Features:
- Real-Time 12-Player Battles: Jump into intense 6v6 matches across classic game modes like Deathmatch, Domination, and Free-For-All.
- Solo Practice Mode: Hone your skills offline with AI opponents before facing real players.
- Massive Arsenal: Choose from a wide variety of upgradable weapons, each with its own unique skins and attachments to suit your combat style.
- Tactical Gear & Explosives: Equip yourself with flashbangs, frag grenades, stun grenades, and high-tech devices like night vision goggles and spotter scopes.

- Dynamic Bodycam Effects: Watch your bodycam crack under fire, and replace it in real-time to stay in the action.
- Customize Your Look: Stand out with hundreds of skins for both your weapons and characters, adding a personal touch to your loadout.
- Immersive Audio: Hear every gunshot, distant echo, and environmental noise with studio-recorded sound effects that bring the battlefield to life.
This is not just a shooter – it’s the future of mobile warfare. Optimized for iPhones 8 and up, delivering an exceptional experience on every device.
Gear up. Get tactical. Dominate the battlefield.

bluejetty:00110763:android.description:
UNIVERSAL mobile CRM for SMALL BUSINESSES and SELF-EMPLOYED
Client accounting, Tasks, Call recording, Financial accounting, Notes, Automation.
Manage leads and attract more clients with an all-in-one small business CRM.
Flexible, customizable interface and functionality. Customize the interface as you need for your specific tasks.
・Customizable interface and functionality - you can enable/disable only the functionality you need
・Tasks - a simple and powerful task list that will help you organize your life and work. You can group tasks into folders and boards (lists or steps). You can set a date for a task. If you need additional fields, comments, or link contacts to tasks, you can add them in a couple of clicks. There are also flexible settings for displaying the list
・Notes - Use them as: notes, support tickets, deals, ideas, etc. etc. If you need additional fields, comments on a note, you can add them in a couple of clicks
・Folders and lists - help you organize your tasks, cards and contacts
・Custom fields - allow you to customize tasks, contacts, cards and your own input forms (custom entities) if standard fields are not enough
・Call Recording - Automatically records phone conversations with customizable recording and storage rules
・Custom data entry forms - adds the ability to create your own forms (forms are menu items on the main screen) with custom fields. You can customize the data entry form with a structure to suit your type of activity. For example, “Price lists” and add fields: Name, Description, Purchase price, Sale price, Warehouse number, etc. It is very convenient when you need to adjust the structure to your type of activity. You can create your custom object with any type of fields and any number of them
・Calendar - helps in planning and distributing to-do lists and tasks for the day, week, month, year, etc.
・CRM - converts your calls into clients. Helps to conclude more deals by systematizing work with potential and current clients
・Contacts - functionality helps you interact with customers more effectively. If you need additional fields, comments on contacts or tasks, you can add them in a couple of clicks, as well as view call history and conversation recordings
・Automates daily routine activities with clients
・Quick responses - save time when communicating with cli

- Security seals

- Free cancellation

**THE CUSTOMERS THAT LOVE US (rated 4.6/5 online):**
- Travelers before check-in or after check-out time

- Families with kids who want to enjoy their day unburdened
**SEE YOU ON YOUR NEXT TRIP!**

So pack your bags, download our app today, and find a convenient luggage storage location for your next trip!

Practice speaking English in real life situations! Be the hero in our interactive series. Move the story forward by speaking English.
—
How does Lola Speak help me learn English?
Many English learners already know a lot of grammar and vocabulary, but are afraid to actually speak English. Why? Many are embarrassed to make mistakes, or mispronounce words. 
Lola Speak provides a safe environment to practice real life conversations. You can repeat as many times as you like. You can practice communicating in a life-like setting, but without the pressure and stress. You can build confidence to communicate in English.

How will I know if I am speaking correctly?
Our AI provides instant feedback on your pronunciation. 
Also, you can listen to your own audio and recordings by native speakers to learn to sound more like a native.

From plot driven stories (Welcome to Hollywood) to series helping you navigate specific situations (Job Interview) you will be immersed in American English and culture. We think you won't want to stop - all while speaking English to move the stories forward!

bluejetty:00039191:ios.name: LifeWheel Goal Habit Tracker
bluejetty:00039191:ios.summary: The LifeWheel app is your personal tool for transformation, designed to help you build and maintain healthy habits, achieve a balanced work-life dynamic, and reach your goals with precision. At its core, LifeWheel encourages holistic growth
bluejetty:00039191:ios.description:
The LifeWheel app is your personal tool for transformation, designed to help you build and maintain healthy habits, achieve a balanced work-life dynamic, and reach your goals with precision. At its core, LifeWheel encourages holistic growth by focusing on various aspects of your life, ensuring you don't neglect any important area.
Features:
Healthy Habit Formation: Easily create and track daily habits that contribute to your overall well-being. Whether it's fitness, meditation, or reading, LifeWheel keeps you accountable.
Productivity Boost: Streamline your tasks and projects with built-in productivity tools. Prioritize what's important and stay focused on your objectives.
Work-Life Balance: Gain insights into how you allocate your time and energy. Adjust your routines to ensure you're giving ample attention to both personal and professional aspects of your life.
Goal Setting & Achievement: Set clear, achievable goals in all spheres of your life. Break them down into actionable steps and monitor your progress with visual trackers.
Journaling & Gratitude: Reflect on your day, jot down your thoughts, and cultivate a gratitude practice. LifeWheel's journaling feature is a space for self-reflection and appreciation.
How It Works:
LifeWheel employs the "Wheel of Life" concept, a powerful tool for visualizing and assessing various life areas. This approach ensures a comprehensive view of your personal growth journey. By setting goals and tasks in each life area, you create a balanced path towards fulfillment and success.
Why LifeWheel?
Evidence-Based: Grounded in psychological principles and productivity techniques, LifeWheel is designed to enhance your motivation and overall happiness.
User-Centric Design: With an intuitive interface, LifeWheel is easy to navigate, making personal development accessible to everyone.
Regular Updates: We continuously improve and update LifeWheel based on user feedback and the latest research in personal development.
Embark on a journey of self-improvement with LifeWheel and unlock your full potential. Whether you're looking to cultivate new habits, achieve your career goals, or find harmony in your daily life, LifeWheel is your companion towards a more balanced and fulfilling life.
Frequently asked questions:
1. How do I remove a goal or subtask?
You can swipe it to the left on main screen, and you will see Delete button. Exactly the same like for other iPhone apps.
2. How do I configure the wheel of life (diagram) ?
Simply tap on life sphere (part of diagram) and move your finger.
3. How I can restore a goal that I accidentally marked as completed? 
When you scroll to the bottom of all your goals and tasks you will see an achieved goals button, press it and you will see a list of achieved goals. Open the specific goal and uncheck the completed box.
LifeWheel comes with an auto-renewable subscription. After a trial, you may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase. (If you do not maintain a subscription, the app will have certain restrictions - such as the inability to access your data across multiple devices.)
• Auto-renewable subscription
• Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• A current subscription may not be canceled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
• Privacy policy and terms of use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/10-Dk5vDAovlA7nD6QKNCIZ4_9RKcsm76a8Yz-rOLXcM/mobilebasic

bluejetty:00073691:ios.description:

bluejetty:00072491:ios.description:
Unlock Your Potential with ADHD Sound App: Focus, Relax and Sleep Better.
How It Works?
ADHD Sound App combines quick brain-boosting exercises with sound therapy to deliver noticeable results. From studying and working to winding down at night, our app is designed to adapt to your unique brain, helping you unlock your full potential every step of the way.
ADHD Sound App delivers science-backed soundscapes specifically designed to enhance focus, improve sleep, and transform your mental clarity. Using the power of sound, we help shift your brainwave patterns so you can effortlessly enter deep focus or drift into restful sleep every time. You are now featuring an innovative ADHD model tailored for your needs!
Why ADHD Sound App?
Are you struggling to focus at work or school? Finding it hard to relax or fall asleep? ADHD Sound App is your go-to solution for:
- Falling asleep faster and staying asleep longer
- Achieving deep focus and getting into a flow state quickly
- Overcoming procrastination with ease
- Sustaining focus and productivity for longer periods
- Meditating more effectively to recharge your mind
- Reducing stress and anxiety for a calmer day
10X Your Focus, Relaxation, and Sleep
- Boost brain activity in areas responsible for attention and productivity.
- Increase your ability to focus by up to 10x.
- Experience twice the anxiety relief compared to regular relaxing music.
- Enhance your brain’s natural patterns for deep, rejuvenating sleep.
Your ADHD Companion
Whether you're battling focus issues, procrastination, disorganization, or anxiety, the ADHD Sound App is here to help. Forget struggling with calendars, planners, and habit trackers that don't stick. Let our expertly crafted soundtracks do the heavy lifting by clearing mental clutter and keeping your brain sharp for daily challenges.
Start your journey to better focus, relaxation, and sleep today with ADHD Sound App.

ADHD Sound App offers monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscription options to get unlimited access to all content in the app. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. bluejetty:00165651:ios.description:
IVY is a period tracker, ovulation and fertility calendar, and pregnancy app trusted by millions of women worldwide.
Whether you're tracking your cycle, trying to conceive, or following your pregnancy week by week, IVY gives you personalized insights every day.
HEALTH ASSISTANT
IVY Health Assistant is all you need when it comes to your personal health questions related to anything cycle, pregnancy, postpartum, or anything else in between.
- Log via chat
- Get immediate feedback
- Health & lifestyle recommendations
CYCLE & PERIOD TRACKER
Have you ever asked yourself, "When will I get my period?". IVY can help you chart your cycle, understand where you are in it, and learn how to make use of your hormones' rising and dropping levels. Track and monitor your period and log all the symptoms that come along with each phase of the cycle.
- Period Log
- Period Calendar
- Log flow, symptoms, moods, weight, temperature, and notes
OVULATION CALCULATOR & CALENDAR
Knowing the fertile window and ovulation day is vital, whether you are trying to conceive or not. IVY's proprietary algorithm will guide you so that you know when you are most fertile or when you should be aware of your fertility window.
- Ovulation and fertile window predictions
- Cycle Calendar
- Log cervical fluid, symptoms, moods, weight, temperature, and notes
PREGNANCY TRACKING
Observe your baby's development at each stage. Understand what each week, month, and trimester brings and how to fully utilize the phases. Follow professional suggestions to make the most of your pregnancy experience.
- Pregnancy and postpartum support
REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH REPORT
Export your reproductive health data, which includes all your cycle logs and an overview of patterns throughout the month.
WELLNESS COACHING
Log your cycle & symptoms and subscribe to coaching to receive personalized material tailored to you, your goals, and the stage of your cycle. IVY will offer you daily nutrition, workout, and mindfulness advice to help you stay healthy and balanced during your cycle. With over 1,000 articles covering all aspects of women's health, you'll become an expert on your own body and cycle.
- Mood support, pain relief, energy boost, digestion help, better sleep, workouts, nutrition, meditations, mindfulness exercises, and more.
REMINDERS
Receive reminders when your period is due or when your fertile window starts.
Your data belongs to you — and only you
- Private key encryption keeps your health data readable only by you, never us
- Delete any or all of your information permanently, anytime, with one tap
- Your data is never sold or shared with third parties. Ever.
Once a subscription is purchased:
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account after purchase confirmation
- Unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, subscriptions renew & charge automatically
- After purchase, user can modify their subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in their account settings
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
Terms of Service: https://legal.stringhealth.ai/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00120599:ios.description:
Spelling practice, reimagined. Custom quizzes, fun games, and smart study tools—all in one powerful app.
Whether you’re a student, teacher, or parent, you know the spelling routine: Monday words, Wednesday quiz, Friday test—plus surprise drills everywhere in between. Say hello to SpellBoard, the smarter way to study and master spelling.
With SpellBoard, you can create custom spelling quizzes in any language, making it just as useful for Spanish class as for weekly English words. Add fun and challenging activities like Word Search, Scramble, Alphabetization, Matching, and Missing Letter puzzles—automatically generated from your word lists.
• How It Works
 • Quickly enter words with optional definitions, sentences, synonyms, antonyms, notes, and images
 • SpellBoard uses built-in speech to quiz you, or you can record your own voice
 • Add fun learning activities and games to boost engagement
 • Enter once, share everywhere—quizzes sync across SpellBoard, SpellBoard Buddy, and SpellBoard Mac
• Great for Classrooms and Families
 • Create multiple student profiles
 • Track individual or group performance across multiple quizzes
 • Share quizzes with classmates or family members
• Study Mode + Smart Tools
 • Walk through quizzes with spoken words and phrases
 • Write responses on the built-in virtual whiteboard
 • Look up word definitions with Wordnik integration
• Optimized for Apple Devices
 • Full support for iCloud Sync
 • Works with Apple Pencil, Split View, mouse and trackpad, and Magic Keyboard pointer interactions
Say goodbye to paper lists and hello to SpellBoard—your new favorite spelling companion.

Basic Theory Test (BTT), Final Theory Test (FTT), and Riding Theory Test (RTT) with the ultimate app for Singapore’s driving theory exams. Packed with official materials, smart learning tools, and unlimited randomised quizzes, it’s your all-in-one solution for test success.

- Offline Mode: Study anytime, anywhere with no internet required.
- Explanation: All answer come with an explanation for you to understand.
- Official Handbook Access with One-Tap Reference: Unable to understand the explanation. Instantly view the related section in the official handbook for clear explanations — no need to search manually.
- Regular Content Updates: Always up-to-date with the latest driving theory materials and question formats.
Why Learners Love It
1. Realistic exam simulation with every attempt
2. Unlimited randomised quizzes for topics & mock tests
3. Detailed explanations for all answers that refer to official handbook.

bluejetty:00123374:ios.name: Brew Cloud: Homebrew Recipes
bluejetty:00123374:ios.summary: Brew Cloud is a homebrewing app for iPhone and iPad that brings beer recipe design, brewing calculators, and a digital brew log into one place. Plan your next homebrew, calculate recipe targets, and track each batch from brew day through fe
bluejetty:00123374:ios.description:
Brew Cloud is a homebrewing app for iPhone and iPad that brings beer recipe design, brewing calculators, and a digital brew log into one place. Plan your next homebrew, calculate recipe targets, and track each batch from brew day through fermentation.
DESIGN YOUR BEER RECIPES
Build recipes with fermentables, hops, yeast, mash steps, and other additions. Adjust ingredients and batch size, review estimated original gravity (OG), final gravity (FG), alcohol by volume (ABV), bitterness (IBU), and color (SRM), and scale a recipe for your next batch.
Choose from the built-in ingredient library or create custom ingredients with the Ingredients Editor. Keep recipe notes so you can refine a favorite IPA, stout, lager, or other beer style.
12 BREWING CALCULATORS
Keep practical homebrew calculations close at hand:
- ABV, ABW, calorie and carbohydrate estimates
- Original gravity, final gravity, and alcohol calculations
- IBU bitterness and SRM color
- Mash and sparge water
- Water chemistry and yeast pitch rate
- Priming sugar for bottling
- Hydrometer temperature adjustment and Brix-to-gravity conversion
- All-grain-to-extract and dry/liquid malt extract conversions
TRACK BATCHES AND FERMENTATION
Create batches from your recipes and keep a brewing log. Record gravity and temperature readings, view fermentation graphs, and save notes to compare results over time. Brew-day instructions and timers help you follow your process.
SAVE, SHARE, AND DISCOVER
Save recipes to your account and sync them across devices. Import and export BeerXML files to share recipes with other homebrewers. Browse community recipes for inspiration and consult the included BJCP beer style guidelines.
MADE FOR YOUR BREW DAY
Use US or metric units, switch between light and Dark Mode, and work on iPhone or iPad. Keep your recipe builder, brewing calculations, batch records, and notes together wherever you brew.
Brew Cloud includes ads, with an optional in-app purchase to remove them.
Questions or ideas? Contact support@thebrewcloud.com.

bluejetty:00016681:ios.summary:

• With colorful, unique color palettes like chameleo
bluejetty:00016681:ios.description:
Enjoy coloring
• 3 stages with 10 pictures each, for a total of 30 cute pictures to choose your favorite characters from!
• Highly intuitive coloring tool helps you stay inside the lines!
• With colorful, unique color palettes like chameleon and macaron!
Enjoy moving pictures
• Your finished pictures will start moving just like they've come to life!
• Tap to enjoy various animations!
• Drag the train and watch it go super fast!
Make your own unique pictures • Save your favorite pictures in the app!
• Add stars and line up your favorite pictures in order! • Choose characters from your favorites to appear on the stage!
Color lots of wonderful original pictures to decorate the stage!
===How to use===
There are three types of stages: the insect stage, the train stage, and the sea creatures stage. (There will be more types soon!)
Please choose any stage you like.
Choose a picture to color, then choose a coloring method.
• Coloring mode: This will help you color each part separately and stay inside the lines.
• Drawing mode: This lets you color and draw freely over the lines.
Actions on the coloring screen
• Choose a coloring tool from the top palette. There are four different brushes, a roller tool that lets you color an entire section with just one touch, and an eraser tool to erase your coloring.
• Use the zoom tool in the top palette to zoom in and color small areas.
• Choose from three different line thicknesses in the top palette.
• You can use the Undo button in the top palette to undo a certain number of actions.
• You can also zoom in or out by pinching in or out with two fingers.
• Drag with two fingers to move the screen while zoomed in.
• Choose preset colors from the bottom palette. You can scroll to the right and left in the bottom palette.
• Use the palette button in the bottom palette to display the custom color palette and choose any color you like.
Choose characters on stages
The insect stage has a total of 10 characters to choose from, including the butterfly, bee, stag beetle, ladybug, sunflower, caterpillar, beetle, dragonfly, and mushroom!
The train stage has a total of 10 characters including the Shinkansen, Express, Conventional, and Locomotive!
The sea creatures stage has a total of 10 characters including the whale, octopus, jellyfish, starfish, turtle, crab, dolphin, angelfish, blowfish, and seaweed!
There will be even more stages and characters soon!

bluejetty:00149467:ios.description:
NOVA is the curated freelancer platform for the next generation of creatives. Our mission is to provide Network, Opportunity, and Visibility to Artists. 
For creatives, NOVA is a first-of-its-kind multi application platform for artists to build their network, display their work, and easily access job opportunities. 
For clients, NOVA is the next evolution of creative hiring, providing a direct link to top freelance creative talent. 
_
At NOVA, our priority is community, which is why we are an application-based platform. Prospective members should download the mobile app here and submit an application. As a creative, we'll ask you to include information like skills and past project work. As a client, we'll ask you to include your company name and job title. Once you've submitted an application, it will be placed into the queue to be reviewed by our board of creatives and internal team. You could receive your acceptance at any time, so keep your push notifications on! Once admitted, creatives and clients will have full-access to the platform. 
Users must continuously abide by our community guidelines of integrity, professionalism, and privacy. 
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00126978:ios.name: Routie ~ GPS Sports Tracker
bluejetty:00126978:ios.summary: Routie is a simple, fast & beautiful way to track and share all your fitness activities. It uses GPS in your iPhone to track your runs, walks, bike rides, kayaking trips and more. Here are some of the more interesting features that Routie o
bluejetty:00126978:ios.description:
Routie is a simple, fast & beautiful way to track and share all your fitness activities. It uses GPS in your iPhone to track your runs, walks, bike rides, kayaking trips and more. Here are some of the more interesting features that Routie offers:
○ Interactive graphs
Explore beautiful graphs of speed and altitude for each of your tracks.
○ Take Photos
With Routie or iPhone camera and have them added to the track.
○ Statistics
View total distance, duration and route count for each of your activity. For last month, last year or All time.
○ Live metrics
During tracking, you can view current speed, current altitude, distance so far, average speed, total time and more.
○ File export
Easily export to GPX, KML or KMZ and use your data with other services
○ Open Street Maps
Apart from Apple maps, you can view your tracks on Street, Cycle or MapQuest maps.
○ Track properties
You can optionally set track name, activity and notes. You can also add placemarks to map as notes, and set captions to your photos.
○ 1 tap sharing
Share to Facebook with just one tap of a button. No typing required.
○ Auto pause
Tracking session is paused automatically when you stop moving.
○ Voice coaching
Be periodically updated about your progress via audio feedback (speech).
○ Today widget
Control tracking, view metrics and launch Routie app right from notification center.
○ Health integration
You can choose to have your workouts and distance written to Health app.
○ Info in badge
View tracking activity, current speed or distance on Routie icon, right from your home screen.
○ Universal tracking
While supporting wide variety of fitness activities, Routie is also great for tracking your travels. It’s a fitness and travel diary in one place.
○ All the tracking data
For each of your tracks, you can view: start time, end time, distance, duration, time moving, time paused, average speed, max speed, max & min altitude and climb.
○ Resume tracking
In case Routie is accidentally closed, you can restore the tracking session upon next launch. This means that you won’t loose your tracking data ever again.
○ Watch app
Use your Apple Watch as a remote control for active tracking on your iPhone. You can see live metrics in the watch app as well.
Please note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
These are just some of the features that Routie offers. But the strength of Routie lies in its beautiful, simple and functional user interface. A great amount of care was put into every aspect of it, you’ll be pleased how easy-to-use yet powerful Routie is.
And most importantly, you’ll have more fun with your fitness activities!

bluejetty:00075156:ios.name: Musical Chairs: Party Games
bluejetty:00075156:ios.summary: Transform your children's parties with Musical Chairs - the ultimate party game companion that automatically plays and stops music for you! Say goodbye to manually controlling the music during classic party games. Our app handles all the ti
bluejetty:00075156:ios.description:
Transform your children's parties with Musical Chairs - the ultimate party game companion that automatically plays and stops music for you! Say goodbye to manually controlling the music during classic party games. Our app handles all the timing, letting you focus on having fun with the kids.
PERFECT FOR CLASSIC PARTY GAMES
Musical Chairs brings automation to four beloved party games that every child loves:
MUSICAL CHAIRS
Set up chairs in a row (one fewer than the number of players). When the music plays, children walk or dance around the chairs. When it stops, everyone rushes to sit down. The player left standing is out, and one chair is removed. The game continues until one winner remains sitting in the final chair. No more awkwardly timing when to stop the music - our app does it for you at random intervals!
MUSICAL STATUES
Children dance freely while the music plays. When it stops, they must freeze like statues. Anyone caught moving or making a sound is out. The last player remaining wins. The app's unpredictable stop times keep kids on their toes and make the game even more exciting!
MUSICAL BUMPS
Kids dance energetically to the music. When it stops, they must quickly sit on the floor. The last child to sit down is eliminated. Play continues until there's one winner. Our automatic timing ensures fair play - no accusations of favoritism when the music stops!
PASS THE PARCEL
Wrap a prize in multiple layers and have children sit in a circle. As music plays, they pass the parcel around. When it stops, whoever holds it removes one layer. The game continues until someone unwraps the final layer and wins the prize. Perfect timing every time means every child gets a turn to unwrap!
BUILT-IN MUSIC & APPLE MUSIC INTEGRATION
Choose from our collection of fun, kid-friendly built-in music tracks, or take it to the next level with Apple Music integration. Connect with Apple Music to:
• Select your favorite party songs from millions of tracks
• Create custom playlists for different party themes
• Use familiar songs that kids already know and love
CUSTOMIZABLE FEATURES
• Adjustable playing time: Set how long music plays before stopping
• Auto-resume controls: Choose how long music stays paused

Transform your children's parties with Musical Chairs - the ultimate party game companion that automatically plays and stops music for you! Say goodbye to manually controlling the music during classic party games. Our app handles all the timing, letting you focus on having fun with the kids.

PERFECT FOR CLASSIC PARTY GAMES

Musical Chairs brings automation to four beloved party games that every child loves:

MUSICAL CHAIRS
Set up chairs in a row (one fewer than the number of players). When the music plays, children walk or dance around the chairs. When it stops, everyone rushes to sit down. The player left standing is out, and one chair is removed. The game continues until one winner remains sitting in the final chair. No more awkwardly timing when to stop the music - our app does it for you at random intervals!

MUSICAL STATUES
Children dance freely while the music plays. When it stops, they must freeze like statues. Anyone caught moving or making a sound is out. The last player remaining wins. The app's unpredictable stop times keep kids on their toes and make the game even more exciting!

MUSICAL BUMPS
Kids dance energetically to the music. When it stops, they must quickly sit on the floor. The last child to sit down is eliminated. Play continues until there's one winner. Our automatic timing ensures fair play - no accusations of favoritism when the music stops!

PASS THE PARCEL
Wrap a prize in multiple layers and have children sit in a circle. As music plays, they pass the parcel around. When it stops, whoever holds it removes one layer. The game continues until someone unwraps the final layer and wins the prize. Perfect timing every time means every child gets a turn to unwrap!

bluejetty:00184299:ios.description:
Bank First goBank gives you complete control over your finances – anytime, anywhere. Whether managing personal accounts or overseeing business operations, goBank provides the tools to bank your way. Our intuitive, easy-to-use app simplifies your banking experience and keeps you in control of your finances. Explore the key features designed to make managing your money easier than ever:
ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
• View balances and transaction history in real time.
• Personalize your banking experience with account nicknames and custom views.
• View account balances instantly with Fast Balances, no login required.
• Open select Bank First accounts quickly and securely.
• Easily place stop payments on checks.
• Sync with Quicken and QuickBooks for simplified financial management.
CARD CONTROLS
• Instantly lock or unlock debit and credit cards.
• Set transaction limits and location preferences.
• Receive real-time alerts for card activity.
• Report lost or stolen cards to prevent unauthorized transactions.

• Move money between Bank First accounts or to external institutions.
• Use Bill Pay to manage bills and keep personal and business commitments on track.
• Manage loan and credit card payments, with the option to set up recurring payments.
• Send money to anyone on your contact list with Zelle® – a fast, safe, and easy way to send and receive money.
MOBILE DEPOSIT
• Deposit checks into your Bank First checking or savings account using your device’s camera.
• Track deposit history and status updates.
TOOLS FOR FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
• Monitor your credit score with 24/7 credit monitoring, financial tips, and more!
• Track spending, set budgets, and manage your finances with Financial Manager.
SECURITY & ACCESS
• Use Face ID or Touch ID for quick, secure access.
• Required two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security.
• Change your username and password anytime for added control.
CONTACT US
• Chat live with us during business hours, or explore quick self-service options anytime.
• Submit requests for address changes, mobile deposit limits, and more via secure forms.
• Find nearby Bank First branches and ATMs.

bluejetty:00090469:ios.description:
Keep track of anything you want to keep an eye on, from habits and chores to symptoms. Chronicling shows how long it's been, how often things happen, and which days and times they tend to happen.
Some things happen every day, like coffee, a walk or your medication. Others come and go: changing the bed sheets, a headache, calling home. Chronicling handles both, so it all lives in one place.
"If you're looking for a flexible approach to tracking events in your life and want to try an app with an excellent, modern design that supports the latest iOS and iPadOS technologies, be sure to give Chronicling a try." - MacStories
LOG IT IN A TAP
- Add events from your Apple Watch, widgets, Control Center, the Lock Screen, Siri and Shortcuts
- Record a number or a note too, such as cups, miles, pages or how you felt
- Automate logging with Shortcuts, from workouts to arriving home
SEE HOW OFTEN, AND WHEN
- Time since last logged, average gap and longest gap for every category
- Heatmaps, charts and trends over weeks, months and years
- Spot patterns by weekday and time of day
- An annual Wrapped to look back at your year
GENTLE REMINDERS
- Time Since Last Event: get a nudge when it's been too long since you last logged something, from a few hours to a few months
- Daily Goal: pick a time of day, and you'll only be notified if you haven't hit that day's goal
- Rolling Goal: aim for a number over the last few days or weeks, with a daily check that only notifies you if you're falling short
YOUR CATEGORIES, YOUR WAY
- Create your own categories with emoji or symbols and your own colors
- Choose the period each category's stats cover
- Organize them into groups and filter by Focus
ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
- iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro
- Private iCloud sync between your devices
- Export to CSV or a single-file backup at any time - your data is yours
If you have questions, suggestions or any other feedback, please contact me at support@chroniclingapp.com.
Subscriptions to Chronicling Premium will automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription. For more information, see https://chroniclingapp.com/terms-of-use/ and https://chroniclingapp.com/privacy-policy/.

bluejetty:00035528:ios.description:
Cheap Calls for Business and Personal Use Anywhere, Anytime
LOOKING FOR A SEPARATE NUMBER FOR PRIVATE COMMUNICATIONS?
GSM+ gives you access to multiple phone lines in 40+ countries for business and personal use, all without needing an extra SIM card. Choose a custom number to make calls, send SMS and MMS, and protect the privacy of your real number.
Forget the hassle of buying and swapping SIM cards for different numbers. With GSM+, switching between numbers for calls is quick and effortless!
Maintain your international number for as long as you desire, and replenish your GSM+ balance with more minutes and SMS. Enjoy making international calls and texts from a different number at the most affordable rates. Calls worldwide are easy and economical with our in-app currency system.
GSM+ is perfect for various scenarios, providing additional numbers to use instead of your real phone number:
• Online Marketplaces: Safely post ads and communicate using a temporary number.
• Dating: Share an alternative number from GSM+ for new connections, ensuring your privacy.
• Business Communications: Use GSM+ as a secondary work number to separate professional and personal calls.
• Property Rentals and Car Hiring: Remain anonymous and secure by providing a GSM+ number for public services.
• Registrations: Sign up for platforms requiring a phone number, including messengers and social networks, without revealing your personal number.
Share your actual phone number only with trusted contacts. For all other purposes, GSM+ is your go-to solution!
If you wish, you can keep the application away from curious eyes with a PIN code.

- Number blocking.
- Ability to disable incoming calls.
- Ability to create Voicemail.
- Call forwarding.
- Ability to turn on/off recordings.
- Ability to stop receiving SMS.
- Automatic reply to SMS messages.
- Ability to turn on/off notifications.
- Credit calculation page.
- Transaction history page.
- SmsActivate alternative.

bluejetty:00172234:ios.description:
Unblock Master VPN keeps connecting on networks that block other VPNs — and now protects you even when the connection changes.
TWO STEALTH ENGINES, ONE TAP
• Faster (AmneziaWG): WireGuard with its fingerprint removed, so deep packet inspection can't single it out. Quick enough for video calls and streaming.
• Unblocker (Reality): makes your connection look like an ordinary visit to a real HTTPS website. For the strictest networks.
Switch between them with one tap. No config files, no setup.
KILL SWITCH, YOUR WAY
• Auto Kill Switch (on by default): while you're connected, nothing goes out on the open network — not while you switch countries, not when a server stops responding.
• Permanent Kill Switch: blocks the internet whenever the VPN is off, even after you disconnect, until you turn it off.
BLOCKS MALWARE, PHISHING & ADS
Optional protection that runs inside the VPN: stop known malware, phishing and scam sites, and block ads and trackers if you want. No separate app or profile needed.
SWITCH COUNTRIES WITHOUT DROPPING
Pick another country while connected and the app moves you over inside the running tunnel — your traffic never falls back to the plain network.
SEE WHERE YOU ARE
A 3D globe shows every server location and spins to the country you pick. Drag it to look around.
BUILT FOR RESTRICTED NETWORKS
Travellers, expats and residents use Unblock Master to reach messaging apps, voice and video calls, social networks, video sites and news on networks that filter them — at airports, hotels, offices, schools and in countries with heavy censorship. If our own website is blocked where you are, the app finds another way to reach us on its own.
STAYS CONNECTED
The tunnel survives sleep and switches between Wi-Fi and cellular, and a built-in health check reconnects on its own if a server stops responding.
SERVERS IN 13 COUNTRIES
United States, Canada, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, Finland, Luxembourg, Türkiye, United Arab Emirates, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan and Australia.
PRIVACY
• No-logs policy: we don't record the sites you visit or the traffic you send.
• No account needed to start.
• Servers run by Yuix Networks only, not rented from resellers.
• Encrypts your traffic on public Wi-Fi.
FREE TOOLS
Check your connection with our free DNS leak test, WebRTC leak test and VPN checker at unblockmaster.com/tools.
SUBSCRIPTION
Weekly, monthly and yearly plans — one subscription works on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Monthly and yearly plans start with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.
Terms: https://www.unblockmaster.com/en/terms/
Privacy: https://www.unblockmaster.com/en/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00073221:ios.description:
Welcome to Banksola: Your Ultimate Money Budget Planner!
Take control of your finances with Banksola, the budget planner, expense tracker, and personal finance app designed to simplify money management. Whether you're a seasoned budgeter or beginning your journey to financial literacy, Banksola provides tools to manage money, track spending, and work toward your financial goals.
Why Choose Banksola?
Banksola is more than a budgeting app; it's your money manager and financial assistant. Track every dollar, create a monthly budget, set financial goals, and manage expenses. Gain insights into spending habits and discover ways to save.
Key Features:
Seamless Bank Integration: Connect supported bank accounts securely through Plaid with an eligible Business or six-month subscription. View bank balances and synchronized transactions in one place.
Effortless Budget Creation: Create budgets based on income and expenses. Use Banksola as your daily and monthly budget planner. Adjust your budget on the go to meet your goals.
Simplified Expense Tracking: Monitor spending with expense tracker and money management tools. Review income, expenses, and transactions for a clear overview of spending patterns.
Financial Organization: Organize checking, savings, business, credit card, investment, and other account types. Manage personal and business accounts in one dashboard.
Goal Setting & Monitoring: Organize goals, whether saving for a vacation or paying off debt. Use your budget and spending information to track progress.
Visual Financial Insights: Explore financial summaries and available reports. Review income, expenses, and spending activity to make informed budgeting decisions.
Data Security: Banksola supports secure account access and available biometric authentication. Eligible subscribers can link institutions through Plaid.
Customizable Budget Categories: Tailor your budget to your spending habits for a personalized experience.
Account and Credit Management: Organize records for supported account types, including credit cards, loans, checking, savings, and business accounts.
Additional Features:
Multi-Currency Support: Manage finances in your preferred display currency—convenient for travelers and international users.
Transaction History Management: View and edit supported transaction details to keep accurate records of income, expenses, payments, and transfers.
Budget Analysis Tools: Review spending patterns, summaries, and transaction history to adjust your monthly budget.
Read Aloud Financial Figures: Select an available voice and listen to supported financial amounts with Banksola's Audio Figure Reader.
Language Preferences: Choose from available app languages and personalize your experience.
Subscription Plans:
Banksola offers flexible subscription options:
Free Access: Essential budgeting and expense tracking with limited account and transaction creation.
One Month Basic: Unlimited manual accounts, account titles, and transactions without advertisements.
One Month Business: All Basic benefits plus eligible external bank linking and synchronization.
Six Months: Business-level benefits, including eligible bank synchronization, for six months.
Subscription prices and terms are displayed in the app before purchase.
Transform your financial management with Banksola! Install now and work toward financial success.
Customer Support:
If you have questions, reach our support team via email.

https://www.banksola.com/terms
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00039927:ios.name: Big Keys Keyboard
bluejetty:00039927:ios.summary: Big Keys Keyboard helps you type with large keys, large text, and an accessible keypad on iPhone. It is built for low vision, seniors, and anyone who wants a clearer, calmer keyboard. Make your next message easier to write and easier to tru
bluejetty:00039927:ios.description:
Big Keys Keyboard helps you type with large keys, large text, and an accessible keypad on iPhone. It is built for low vision, seniors, and anyone who wants a clearer, calmer keyboard. Make your next message easier to write and easier to trust, starting now!
Keys, text, and emojis — as big as you need
This is the heart of Big Keys. Adjust key size to reduce mistaps and make each tap feel more accurate. Make the typing text larger so you can confirm words faster before you hit send. And if emojis look tiny, scale them up so your favorites are easier to see and select.
Your keyboard can speak
Turn on Speak and hear what you type, in the language of your keyboard. Big Keys can speak every key, every word, and every autocorrection, so silent changes never slip past you. Tap and hold a suggestion to hear it before you choose it, and deleted characters and words are spoken in a lower voice so you always know what changed. Choose the voice, speed, and volume. Speak works hand in hand with VoiceOver.
Built for visibility
Most keyboards assume perfect vision and tiny, precise taps. Big Keys Keyboard focuses on clarity with bigger letters, clearer spacing, and layouts that feel easier to follow so you can type with less strain.
A calmer keyboard experience
Some people find standard keyboards visually noisy or overwhelming. This keyboard aims to feel more predictable by keeping things clear and reducing unnecessary clutter, which may help support focused typing for users who prefer a calmer layout.
Dedicated keypad
Need to type digits fast? The built-in keypad is there for PINs and codes, but also for phone numbers, prices, and addresses.
High contrast themes
Choose a look that keeps the keyboard clear and readable. Bright light can wash things out, so stronger contrast often helps. At night, a calmer theme can feel better while the letters stay easy to see.
Now speaks Japanese too
Type Japanese on a full kana keyboard with big keys: flick input with a large, easy-to-see guide, multi-tap input with an adjustable tap window, a dedicated kaomoji key with over 150 text faces, and Japanese word suggestions.
Language support
If you type in more than one language, switching should not feel like work. Big Keys supports more than 25 languages, including the new Japanese kana keyboard. Switch with a simple hold on the space bar and keep your flow across messages, email, and search.
Less retyping
Gesture shortcuts can help you reach the keypad or special characters faster. If enabled, haptic feedback can make key presses feel more certain, and a last key indicator can make quick corrections easier.
One keyboard, made for many
Big Keys helps a wide range of people type more comfortably: people with low vision or tired eyes, seniors who want larger targets, anyone with tremors or less precise fingers, users with dyslexia or ADHD who prefer a calmer layout, and kids just learning to type. And if you are setting up a phone for a parent or someone you care for, Big Keys gets them typing comfortably in minutes.
Quick answers
- Can I really make the keys bigger? Yes, you can adjust key size to match your comfort.
- Can the keyboard read my typing out loud? Yes. Turn on Speak to hear keys, words, corrections, and suggestions in your keyboard language.
- Does it help with low vision? Yes, the design focuses on large letters, clear spacing, and contrast.
- Is there a number pad? Yes, there is a dedicated keypad for fast digits and codes.
- Can I make emojis bigger? Yes, emoji size can be increased too.
- Is setup complicated? No. Enable the keyboard once in iPhone Settings and then use it anywhere you type.
- Is there an upgrade? Big Keys Keyboard may offer optional upgrades that unlock additional options.
Download Big Keys and start typing with less strain and more confidence. Set your ideal key size, pick a high contrast theme, and enjoy a clearer keyboard every day!
Terms of Use: https://www.youapps.co/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00015234:ios.description:
“Flags of the World” is a quiz game (trivia) that teaches the flags and capitals of all world countries in the most fun way possible. You will always remember the flags and the capital cities you learned with this game. You can play Multiplayer games with people who are from all over the world.
There are 200 flags, 200 capital cities, 5 game types and 11 levels which will get harder progressively in this flags quiz game.
Every level has 20 flags, 20 capital cities or 20 currencies and you have 20 seconds to match the flag and country for each question. If you choose a wrong flag, you will see the name of that flag.
You will also learn details like capitals, currencies and populations while guessing a flag or a country, every question.
List the flags by levels (according to difficulty) in Practice section. You may study and learn all flags and countries’ names with our functional flashcards at every level.
Guess the country name from 4 flags or guess the flag from 4 countries. Guess the country flag of given capital city name. No confusing mechanics. Simple and modern design.
You will feel like you are competing with yourself. Additionally there is a leaderboard of players around the world. Try more and put your name in Top 100 List.
You will also compete with other players in multiplayer mode. There is a leaderboard of multiplayer players around the world. Try hard and put your name in Multiplayer Top 100 List.
Don’t forget! You will learn all the flags by finishing all the levels with 3 hearts in 2 modes.
With a wide range of languages, learn in your native language or any other desired language.
You can use our fun and educational app “Flags of The World Quiz” in 25 different languages: English, Turkish, French, Spanish, Russian, German, Portuguese, Polish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Indonesian, Danish, Norwegian, Arabic, Czech, Persian, Romanian, Ukrainian, Hungarian, Finnish, Korean, Japanese, Bulgarian, Azerbaijani.
When you finish the Flags’ app in a language, you may clear your app data and go on learning flags in other languages.

bluejetty:00071125:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00071125:ios.description:
CREATE LIFE ON MARS
Lead a corporation and launch ambitious Mars terraforming projects. Direct massive construction works, manage and use your resources, create cities, forests and oceans, and set rewards and objectives to win the game!
In Terraforming Mars, place your cards on the board and use them wisely:
- Achieve a high Terraform Rating, by increasing the temperature and oxygen level or creating oceans... Make the planet habitable for future generations!
- Get Victory Points by building cities, infrastructure and other ambitious projects.
- But watch out! Rival corporations will try to slow you down... That's a nice forest you planted there... It'd be a shame if an asteroid crashed right on it.
Will you be able to lead humanity into a new era? The terraforming race begins now!
Features:
• The official adaptation of Jacob Fryxelius' famous board game.
• Mars for all: Play against the computer or challenge up to 5 players in multiplayer mode, online or offline.
• Game variant: Try the rules of the Corporate Era for a more complex game. With the addition of new cards, including 2 new corporations, focused on economy and technology, you will discover one of the most strategic variants of the game!
• Solo Challenge: Finish terraforming Mars before the end of generation 14. Try new rules and features in the most challenging Solo mode on the (red) planet.
DLCs:
• Speed up your game with the Prelude expansion, adding a new phase at the start of the game to specialize your corporation and boost your early game. It also introduces new cards, corporations and a new solo challenge.
• Explore a new side of Mars with the Hellas & Elysium maps, each bringing a new set of twists, awards and milestones. From the Southern Wilds to the Other Face of Mars, the taming of the Red Planet continues.
• Add the Venus board to your game, with a new Solar phase to hasten your games. Shake up Terraforming Mars with the Morning Star expansion, featuring new cards, corporations, and resources!
• Spice up the game with 7 new cards from the Original Promo Pack: Includes everything from the microbe-oriented corporation Splice to the game-changing Self-Replication Robot project.
* Try the Big Box Promo Pack and its 23 cards to raise the level even higher. Play as the expert-only Pharmacy Union or enjoy the more relaxed Astrodrill corporation with this DLC!
* Establish outposts and trade with them in Colonies! Featuring 49 project cards, 5 corporations, and a whole new game system, Colonies is the most content-packed DLC to date!
Languages available: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Swedish
Having an issue? Looking for support? Please contact us: https://asmodee.helpshift.com/
Find all the latest news for Terraforming Mars on Facebook, Twitter and Youtube!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TwinSailsInt
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TwinSailsInt
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/twinsailsinteractive

bluejetty:00031058:ios.description:
## App Of The Day - Apple
## New Apps We Love - Apple
## Try These Out - Apple
## Student App of the Month - The App Brewery (London)
Focus Tomato is a serious tomato helping you stay focused. 
Cheer you up when you succeed.
—— Recommended consuming order ——
Step 1: Goal setting
If the goal is too big, break it down.
Step 2: only focus for 25 minutes
* Only focus on one thing
* Avoid distraction; make efforts to keep the Tomato running (ex. if someone hits you up, tell him/her getting back to you shortly!)
* Better to watch the timer counting
Step 3: Rest for 5 minutes
* Not suitable for mental consuming tasks
* Light activities that are good for your mind and body
* Pause your work momentarily can help you view things from another perspective and avoid couldn't see the forests for the trees. 
Step 4: Repeat 4 times, then take a more extended rest for 15 to 30 minutes
Repeat the previous two steps for 4 times, and take a 15 to 30 minutes long rest
—— After taking it, you can gain the following benefits on top of straight As —— 
* Prevent distracting and stay focused more easily: counting down timer brings good stress
* Reduce interruptions: postpone other tasks; most things can wait for 25 minutes
* Avoid procrastinating: when the timer is running, it means the declaration of a focused time frame
* Endure longer: with adequate rest, you can run further 
—— Features of “Focus Tomato” ——
Based on the Pomodoro method with new spice-ups and improvements.
* Do not force stop; keep the flow
Classical Promodoro clock asks you to stop working asap when time is up; Focus Tomato only notifies you with sound and does not force you to stop. You can keep staying in the zone and running the timer.
* Fractional time is allowed
Classical Promodoro clock requires to maintain 25 minutes duration. Focus Tomato freely lets you count the fractional time as long as it starts running.
* Modifiable Timeline
It is usual to forget to stop the timer. Focus Tomato allows you to modify the Timeline and make adjustments afterward.
* Do Not Disturb mode is available
Distracted by too many notifications? Do Not Disturb mode can be enabled when Focus Tomato is running.
* Integrate smoothly with other work methods and/or apps
Because the app only applies the timing part of the Promodoro technique, in addition to the original Promodoro method, you can also use the Reminder, Trello, or physical notebooks along with it.
Good tomato, why not eat it?

bluejetty:00019356:ios.description:
RPG game with an amazing artstyle and thousands of ways to customize your hero. Dive deep into challenging turn-based battles, defeat powerful monsters, and gain epic rewards!
Create and customize your own character, collect epic gear, equip your hero with powerful artifacts, and climb the rankings! Join the guild, chat with friends, and compete in epic multiplayer guild raids to rule the world of Valia!
One of the top rated turn-based RPGs out there!
- Immerse yourself in an amazing story, defeat evil, and bask in glory and fame!
- Enjoy a deep character customization with hundreds of looks, skins & cosmetics to choose from!
- Dynamic evolution - level up your hero, upgrade equipment, unlock talents and magic skills to boost your hero power!
- Create your unique character build from thousands of possible combos, mixing weapons, gear sets, and talents!
- Collect legendary gear, gather gold & eternium, forge mighty artifacts, and use their power to your advantage!
- Complete hundreds of special Quest Events and battle your way to climb the ranking!
- Fight powerful monsters and bosses in a turn-based combat!
- Challenge other players in PvP battles and dominate the Arena!
- Fight in the action-packed PvE campaign and discover a rich fantasy world!
- See the variety of locations in your RPG adventure: discover the city, visit shops, craft in the forge, embark on voyages!
- Join multiplayer guild boss battles and lead your team to victory!
- Take part in the addictive weekly Battle Events with stunning equipment as a reward!
A real treat for all dungeons & dragons and RPG quest games enthusiasts. Prepare yourself for a fantasy game like you’ve never experienced before!
DIGITAL SUBSCRIPTIONS
Auto-renewing subscriptions grant you great game benefits.
Following subscription is available:
- "Basic Monthly Contract" subscription per 1 month.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy:
https://gamesture.com/gamesture-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service:
https://gamesture.com/gamesture-terms-of-service.pdf

bluejetty:00087515:ios.name: Fieldy - AI note taker
bluejetty:00087515:ios.summary:
Turn conversations into clear summaries, searchable transcripts and next steps with Fieldy, your AI note taker.
A useful conversation should leave you with more than a long transcript. Fieldy helps you find the decisions, remember the deta
bluejetty:00087515:ios.description:
Turn conversations into clear summaries, searchable transcripts and next steps with Fieldy, your AI note taker.
A useful conversation should leave you with more than a long transcript. Fieldy helps you find the decisions, remember the details and follow through on what you agreed, from team meetings and client conversations to interviews and everyday plans.
Capture conversations with Fieldy's desktop app or a Fieldy wearable (sold separately), then review your notes on iPhone. Recording directly on iPhone is not yet available.
START WITH THE SUMMARY
Get the key points without rereading every word. Generate a summary of a conversation and choose a format that fits the discussion, whether you need meeting minutes, a client recap or a concise overview.
- Review important topics and decisions.
- Keep the summary alongside the original transcript.
- Return to the details whenever you need more context.
TURN TALK INTO ACTION
Keep follow-up tasks connected to the conversation they came from. Review deadlines, check what needs doing and mark tasks complete as you go. Before your next meeting, look back at the commitments instead of piecing them together from memory.
FIND WHAT WAS SAID
Browse and search your saved conversations. Open a transcript to revisit the discussion, with speaker labels to help you follow who said what. Use the summary for the overview and the transcript when the details matter.
ASK YOUR NOTES
Ask questions about a conversation in Fieldy instead of scanning the whole transcript. Find a decision, revisit a requirement or check the next step.
- What did we agree about the launch?
- Which requirements did the client mention?
- What do I need to follow up on?
AI-generated answers and transcripts can contain mistakes. Check important details before relying on them.
SHARE THE CONTEXT
Once you've generated a summary, send a conversation link so a colleague can read the summary and transcript in a browser. They don't need the app to read it. Anyone with the link can open that conversation, so share it thoughtfully.
Use Make Private to turn the link off again. Sharing one conversation does not give the recipient access to the rest of your account.
TAKE YOUR NOTES FURTHER
Copy a transcript or export a file for your documents, project notes and follow-up emails. Keep useful details in the workflow you already use, without retyping the discussion.
Connect Fieldy to ChatGPT, Claude or another compatible AI assistant to work with your conversations there. Draft a follow-up, prepare for your next meeting or turn a discussion into a document. You choose which tools to connect.
FOR THE CONVERSATIONS THAT MATTER
- Team meetings: revisit decisions and check follow-up tasks.
- Client conversations: find requirements before preparing your next response.
- Interviews: review a speaker's words rather than relying on memory.
- Everyday plans: return to details and commitments you want to remember.
YOUR CONVERSATIONS, YOUR CONTROL
Manage conversations and sharing from the app. Fieldy does not sell your personal information or use it to train general-purpose AI models. Its AI service providers are not permitted to use your data to train their models.
GET STARTED
Sign in with the same Fieldy account you use for desktop or wearable capture to review your conversations on iPhone. Open a conversation, generate its summary and explore the transcript, tasks and sharing tools.
Some features require a subscription. Available plans, features and limits are shown in the app. Always obtain any required consent before recording a conversation.
Support: https://fieldy.support/
Privacy Policy: https://www.fieldy.ai/policy/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.fieldy.ai/policy/terms-of-services

Wortschatz – Learn Languages with Confidence

Unlock a new language the fun, focused way. Wortschatz blends bite-sized lessons, real-life dialogues, and smart practice to help you speak naturally—whether you’re starting from zero or refining advanced skills.

Highlights

• Conversational language you’ll actually use: travel, work, and everyday life
• Adaptive practice that adjusts difficulty as you improve
• Instant pronunciation feedback powered by speech recognition
• Offline lessons so you can learn anywhere
• Streaks, goals, and gentle reminders to keep you consistent

What you can do

• Build vocabulary with spaced repetition
• Shadow native-speaker audio for natural pronunciation
• Complete interactive exercises: fill-in-the-blank, matching, and speaking
• Track progress with weekly stats and skill milestones
• Create custom word lists for travel, business, or exams

Why learners choose Wortschatz

• Real-world focus: lessons built around situations you’ll actually face
• Confidence-first approach: instant feedback helps you fix mistakes immediately
• Flexible learning: quick 5-minute sessions or deep study—your choice

How it works

Choose your language and set a daily goal

Follow guided learning paths or explore themed modules

Practice speaking, listening, reading, and writing every day

Review with smart reminders to lock in what you’ve learned

Download Wortschatz and start speaking with confidence today.

With Flamify, you don’t just chat — you talk, connect, and explore creative conversations in a whole new way.

Communicate naturally using AI-powered voice technology. Speak freely and receive instant, lifelike voice responses from AI characters that adapt to your tone, style, and preferences.

bluejetty:00115292:ios.description:
This innovative app is designed for coin enthusiasts and collectors. It provides users with random facts about various coins, enriching their knowledge with interesting trivia. The app allows users to calculate the total value of their coin collections and offers seven in-depth articles covering different aspects of numismatics.
Users can easily find out the estimated market value and face value of individual coins using built-in recognition and evaluation tools. With the ability to create, modify, and delete collections, users can efficiently organize their coins.
Adding new coins is simple—either by scanning both sides of a coin using the camera or by manually entering details and uploading images, with support for 10–15 parameters. Additionally, the app features a robust search function to help users quickly find specific coins within their database.
This comprehensive tool is perfect for anyone looking to enhance their coin collecting experience through smart organization, accurate valuation, and educational content.

bluejetty:00018536:ios.description:
efood - delivery in Greece
efood is the #1 online delivery platform in Greece and for good reason. It has so much to offer. We’ve brought together food, coffee, supermarkets, local neighborhood shops, offers, rewards, and so much more – all in one place! 
Whatever you want, whenever you want it, it’s just a few taps away!
• Coffee & food
You haven't cooked and you're hungry. We’ve been there. You woke up, and there's no way you’re getting up without a coffee. We get it. You always study late at night, but a chocolate-banana-cookie crepe could take your productivity to the next level. We totally understand. So, how can we help?
 - Quick order: Through “Order again”, easily find and repeat your previous orders.
 - Special selections: With Chef Leonidas Koutsopoulos, we created the Red Selection – a curated list of restaurants offering something special. We suggest taking a look. Or two. 
• Supermarket
Why go to the supermarket, when the supermarket can come to you? Forget the heavy bags, the checkout lines, and wandering through endless aisles.
Tap on the relevant category on efood and check out efood market — efood’s very own supermarket. Discover your favorite supermarket chains (SKLAVENITIS, AB, My market, Kritikos, BAZAAR, Carrefour and more) and choose whatever you want, at the same prices as in-store.
 - You choose the delivery time: Place your order and pick the day and time that works best for you. Yep, there are supermarkets open on efood, daily, even on Sundays.
 - Don’t miss the deals: Take a look at our awesome prices. 
• Want more? We’ve got you covered!
If you think that we would stop at food, coffee, and supermarkets, think again - we have more! Discover flower shops, liquor stores, pharmacies, greengrocers, butcher shops, fish shops, delicatessens, bookstores, technology products, bio products, optical stores, fitness options, and pet shops. What else do you want? We can bring that too!
 - Forgot a birthday or anniversary? No worries - order flowers, books, or anything else you’d like, and surprise your loved ones with a gift!
- Deals & rewards
Our goal is to help you enjoy everything efood has to offer every single day. Discover how you can make the most of it.
- Become a pro | Free unlimited delivery and 10% off on selected stores.
- Collect rubies, earn coupons | Each order from the same store gets you closer to a coupon for your next one.
- Are you a student? Get ready to eat well! | If you have a student pass, discover unique deals exclusively for you.
Add. Cart. Send.
Τhink it's difficult? Not at all. Trust us! 
 - Step 1: Choose your location
 - Step 2: Pick the store you want
 - Step 3: Add products to your cart
 - Step 4: Cash? Card? Apple Pay? Google Pay? Ticket Restaurant? It’s up to you!
 - Step 5: Send your order
That’s it!
Something went wrong? Check out our FAQ section, or chat with one of our agents.
Available in 100+ cities across Greece
Download the efood app and enjoy anything you want, whenever you want.
