bluejetty:00021286:ios.summary:
Emerge Healing offers 82 guided hypnosis programs by Joel Thielke, C.Ht., for weight and eating habits, letting go of the past, confidence and rest.
START WITH LET GO OF THE PAST
Let Go Of The Past is included with the app: a full session
bluejetty:00021286:ios.description:
Emerge Healing offers 82 guided hypnosis programs by Joel Thielke, C.Ht., for weight and eating habits, letting go of the past, confidence and rest.
START WITH LET GO OF THE PAST
Let Go Of The Past is included with the app: a full session for relaxing deeply, looking back at an old hurt from a safe distance and practising setting it down. Play it in full with no purchase and no subscription. It is built into the app, so it plays without a connection.
WEIGHT AND FITNESS FIRST
The library opens on Weight & Fitness: twelve programs including Weight Loss, Healthy Weight Loss, Stop Sugar Cravings, Cravings Buster, Exercise Motivation and Love Your Workout. Six more shelves cover habits and change, release and healing, confidence, mind and motivation, love and connection, and sleep and spirit. Search by everyday words, such as "snacking" or "can't sleep".
HOW IT WORKS
Hypnotherapy is guided relaxation with a purpose. You settle into a calm, focused state, then listen to suggestions written for one goal at a time: the thoughts and routines around food, an old pattern you want to change, or the way you talk to yourself.
SHAPE EACH SESSION
Choose a program, then one of six inductions, classic and new: the original Short, Long and Sleep, plus Beach (a calm walk along the shore), Speed (a fast way in) and Staircase (counting down step by step). Then pick an ending: Wake, Sleep, None or Delay. Line programs up in a playlist, repeat them for as long as you like, and set a sleep timer. Playback continues with the screen locked, with lock-screen controls. Programs stream the first time and are kept on your device after that.
A SOUND BENEATH THE VOICE
Sessions play voice only unless you add a sound. The Sound Mixer plays calm sounds on their own from the Home screen or beneath any program. One sound is included; the Sound Mixer purchase, or Unlock All, layers up to six of 15 sounds, such as rain, ocean, campfire and wind, with your own levels and saved mixes.
ONE-TIME PURCHASES
Buy single programs, or unlock every program with one payment. Unlock All covers the program library and the Sound Mixer, and is available through Family Sharing; the Sound Mixer is also sold on its own. Every purchase is one-time and restorable. There is no subscription. Programs you bought before are still yours: tap Restore Purchases in Settings.
ABOUT JOEL THIELKE
Joel Thielke is a certified clinical hypnotherapist, certified instructor, NLP coach and trainer. Questions? Write to support@motivationalhypnotherapy.com from Settings.

bluejetty:00089019:ios.description:
Progress Knight is a life-sim incremental based in a fantasy/medieval setting, where you must progress through the career ladder and acquire new skills to become the ultimate being.
You first start off as a beggar, barely being able to feed yourself as the days go by. However, over the years you learn new skills and gain plenty of work experience to enter new high paying jobs while managing your living expenses...
Will you decide to take the easy route of doing simple commoner work? Or will you go through harsh training to climb the ranks within the military? Or maybe will you decide to study hard and enrol in a magic academy, learning life-impacting spells? Your career path is open-ended, the decision is up to you.
Eventually, your age will catch up to you. You will be given an option to prestige and gain xp multipliers (based on the performance of your current life) for your next life at the cost of losing all your levels and assets. Fear not though, as you will re-gain your levels much, much more quickly than in your previous life...

PICK. PLAY. PROVE.
Flex your sports IQ by predicting player performances. Will LeBron score over 30? Can Mahomes throw for 300+ yards? You make the call, we keep the score.
CLIMB THE RANKS
Start as a Rookie, end as a Legend. Your correct picks boost your standing. Watch your virtual bankroll grow as you outsmart the competition.
NO WALLET NEEDED
Leave your cash at home. We dish out free virtual coins every 12 hours. It's all the rush of sports action without the financial stress. Play more, worry less.

Mix and match players across sports. Create a 5-star lineup and watch your potential winnings skyrocket. More picks, more thrill, more bragging rights.
THE WEEKLY SHOWDOWN
Every week is a fresh start. Compete, climb the leaderboard, and see where you stand among the sports elite. New week, new chances to shine.
FAIR PLAY FOR ALL
Whether you're a casual fan or a stats junkie, our over/under system keeps it simple and fair. No complex odds, just pure sports prediction fun.

bluejetty:00088718:ios.name: Guava: Health Tracker
bluejetty:00088718:ios.summary: Guava empowers you to manage your overall health or chronic illness. Whether you’re seeking a diagnosis or living with complex conditions like POTS, EDS, MCAS, ME/CFS, or Long COVID, Guava simplifies health tracking with powerful tools and
bluejetty:00088718:ios.description:
Guava empowers you to manage your overall health or chronic illness. Whether you’re seeking a diagnosis or living with complex conditions like POTS, EDS, MCAS, ME/CFS, or Long COVID, Guava simplifies health tracking with powerful tools and insights.
Guava is a comprehensive symptom tracker, chronic pain tracker, mental health tracker, and health monitor to manage your wellness, fitness, and medical needs. Connect devices, sync medical records, track medications, and discover health insights, all in one app.
How Guava supports your health:
• Track symptoms, mood, and mental health
• Set medication reminders, track pill count, & monitor effects
• Discover insights and trends over time
• Compare treatments and track progress
• Organize and search medical records
• Use AI to summarize doctor notes & understand health data
• Coordinate care across providers
ALL YOUR HEALTH RECORDS IN ONE PLACE
Connect to 50,000+ US providers through patient portals like MyChart and Cerner for up-to-date medical records, lab results, and doctor notes. Upload CCDA files, X-rays & MRIs (DICOM), PDFs, or images—Guava uses AI to digitize, extract, and organize data into a searchable, easy-to-understand format.
SYMPTOM TRACKER
Log symptoms or pain to discover triggers, evaluate treatments, and visualize changes using the body heat map. See which symptoms commonly co-occur, which factors correlate with them, and details about severity and frequency. Whether you’re looking to track symptoms or chronic pain, Guava helps you uncover patterns and habits that lead to improvement.
MEDICATION REMINDERS
Never forget to take your meds again. Track your med schedule, set reminders, track pill supply, get refill alerts, and monitor how medications affect your health and wellness.
TRACK DAILY HABITS, SLEEP & BODY MEASUREMENTS
Record habits and activities to see trends and correlations. Sync with sleep trackers and glucose monitors, track food intake, menstrual cycle, caffeine consumption, exercise, weight, blood pressure, custom factors, and more. Set health goals to optimize treatment or prevention.
GET PERSONALIZED HEALTH INSIGHTS
Find correlations between your symptoms, meds, mental health, lifestyle, and environment. Discover if new medications affect mood or if nutrition or weather triggers flare-ups, migraines, etc.
PERIOD, FERTILITY, & PREGNANCY TRACKER
Log your cycle with Guava’s free period tracker and pregnancy app. Get period and ovulation predictions, fertility reminders, and discover trends between your cycle, symptoms, and mood. Enable Baby Plan to track pregnancy milestones, symptoms, and health updates.
DOCTOR VISIT PREP
Create custom summaries of your medical history including symptoms, meds, and conditions to show your providers. Add questions, requests, and assessments that you may have leading up to your appointment, so you remember everything.
SYNC FITNESS & MEDICAL DATA
Connect to fitness and medical apps and devices to sync everyday health data like steps, heart rate, glucose and sleep.
BE PREPARED FOR EMERGENCIES
Guava’s Emergency Card alerts first responders to your conditions, allergies, and medications that impact care.
YOUR SECURITY AND PRIVACY
Guava is HIPAA compliant. We take your security and privacy seriously. We do not sell your data and we follow all applicable laws. Learn more: https://guavahealth.com/privacy-and-security
No ads, ever.
Some things Guava is used as:
Fatigue tracker • POTS tracker • Period tracker
Mental health tracker • Mood tracker • Migraine tracker
Food diary • Headache tracker • Urine tracker
Automatically pull in data and see insights from:
Apple Health • Google Fit • Health Connect • Dexcom • Freestyle Libre • Omron • Withings • Oura • Whoop • Strava • Fitbit • Garmin
Organize records from patient portals:
Medicare.gov • Veterans Affairs / VA.gov • Epic MyChart • Healow / eClinicalWorks • NextGen / NextMD • Quest Diagnostics • LabCorp • Cerner • AthenaHealth • And more

bluejetty:00068410:ios.description:
ArtDraw: Sketch & Paint Studio - Unleash Your Creativity Anywhere!
Discover the limitless possibilities of ArtDraw, a versatile and user-friendly sketching app designed for mobile devices. With its comprehensive artist toolbox, this app empowers you to create stunning sketches, fun paintings, and engaging illustrations on the go. Whether you're a scribbler, a doodler, or a budding artist, ArtDraw provides an intuitive way to bring your custom drawings to life.
Elevate your canvas creations to a professional level with ArtDraw's rich and powerful feature set. It caters to artists of all levels, whether art is a hobby, passion, or career. Creating digital art and drawing has never been easier or more entertaining. With its awesome interface, you can spend more time drawing and coloring great illustrations and less time searching for tools. ArtDraw is your all-in-one digital sketching application, offering everything from basic sketching to sophisticated illustrations.
The intuitive interface of ArtDraw enables effortless navigation and features multiple layers with advanced configuration settings. Paint, draw, sketch, and color with over 150 brushes, including Basic, Texture Essentials, Copic, Pen Brush, Synthetic Paint, Traditional, Texture, Shape, Splatter, Designer, Artist, Pastel, Eraser, Cutter, and Smudge tools.
ArtDraw isn't just for adults; it's loved by children as well. It's a family-friendly application that encourages everyone to unleash their creativity. The app includes coloring books for kids' engagement and offers adults a chance to relax and unwind. Immerse yourself in the world of art therapy and experience mindfulness through color. Customize multiple coloring books for the ultimate relaxing experience, featuring mandalas, patterns, animals, florals, butterflies, cartoons, and more. Let the fun begin and watch anxiety fade away.
Features:
Explore a collection of over 500 pictures to paint, including mandalas, florals, animals, patterns, cats, gardens, famous paintings, and more.
Shake it to make it! Fill in random colors to visualize the look and feel of the book.
Enjoy easy coloring with a variety of color palettes to choose from. Simply tap to color.
Select from various brush types for advanced effects and precision.
Share your drawings on your preferred social networks and showcase your artistic talent.
Optimized for the latest iPhone models, ensuring a seamless drawing experience.
Save and share your artwork as images and videos to inspire others.
Dive into gorgeous coloring books and pages tailored for everyone's taste.
Explore diverse coloring categories like mandalas, animals, abstract, cartoons, flowers, and more, with new additions constantly being added.
Kids Coloring Book for Fruitful Engagement:
ArtDraw is also a creative and fun application that nurtures kids' creative abilities. Engage with your child as you explore wonderful illustrations of fruits, vegetables, animals, and more, all while learning their names!
Features:
Choose from 20+ categories filled with delightful pictures.
Each picture offers a learning experience, making education enjoyable.
Enjoy the most colorful tools for your child's activities.
Engage in coloring alphabet artwork and much more.

You can easily cancel a subscription or free trial at any time through the subscription settings in your iTunes account. Remember to do so at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period or free trial to avoid being charged. Unleash Your Beat with Drum Pads Pro
Take your rhythm game to the next level with Drum Pads Pro, the ultimate drum loop machine for musicians and performers. Whether you're creating in the studio, performing live, or jamming on the go, Drum Pads Pro delivers an expansive library of drum loops from every genre and culture—right at your fingertips.
Features:
• AUv3 Support: Seamlessly integrate with your favorite AUv3-compatible DAWs for a streamlined workflow.
• Diverse Drum Loop Library: Access a huge variety of drum loops—from Disco, Funk, Jazz, Heavy Metal, to World Music styles like Latin, Oriental, and more. 
• Layer and Play: Stack rhythms, layer beats, add dynamic fills, and play hits in real time for a professional performance. 
• Custom Loop Import: Import your own loops in WAV format and add your personal touch to your music. 
• Set Lists for Live Performances: Create and organize set lists for a flawless live performance experience. 
• MIDI Learn Integration: Control virtually every function from your external MIDI controller with MIDI Learn. 
• Tap or Lock Tempo: Easily tap out or lock in your tempo to keep every loop perfectly in sync.
• Smooth Transitions: Fade in, fade out, add breaks, and end rhythms cleanly with precision for seamless transitions. 
• Ableton Link Support: Sync your beats with Ableton Link for collaborative sessions and live performances. 
• Record and Share: Capture your live performances or studio sessions with built-in output recording. 
• iCloud Backup: Securely back up your custom sounds and loops using iCloud.

"Going Tilt: Wild West Pinball offers a pretty faithful recreation of the pinball machine
bluejetty:00071665:ios.description:
DON'T MISS OUR NEW GAMES:
- Pinball HD Collection
- War Pinball HD
- Jungle Style Pinball
- The Deep Pinball
--------------------------------------
"Going Tilt: Wild West Pinball offers a pretty faithful recreation of the pinball machine experience on your iPhone."
-- Jeff Phillips, Macworld.com
"The game is earning high praise from pinball fans who have been looking for a more authentic experience. Several users have commented on the accurate physics model and "real feel" of Wild West Pinball."
-- Arnold Kim, TouchArcade.com
"The physics and sounds of the game are specifically designed to make the game "feel right" and give pinball fans the closest feel to actually being on a machine."
-- Erik Fikkert, AppVee.com
"...it's a very good game indeed and probably the best digital pin table I've seen in a long time."
-- Sir Digby, AllAboutTheGames.co.uk
"Fantastic 3D pinball table and animations. Very crisp visuals, and a buttery smooth frame rate. It doesn’t get any more realistic than this."
-- Matt Dunn, iPhoneGamesNetwork.com
"...there's no title screen, no front end interface or needless menu navigation. You tap, and you're instantly in. It's really clean, and as long as you aren't expecting some sort of epic experience in your pinball, it's perfect given the nature of mobile gaming."
-- Mark Bozon, IGN
ABOUT THE GAME
Wild West Pinball team - more than 3 000 000 players around the world!
Welcome to Wild West Pinball - world first professional pinball simulator for the iPhone. With fast 3D graphics and realistic physics this game will blow your mind. All parts of pinball table are real objects and you can see how it works! Western style locations and environment gives you a lot of fun.
IMPORTANT
• You can find SOUND, MUSIC and THEME options in standart iPhone “Settings” section.
• During the game pinch your fingers together or apart to toggle camera mode from live to fixed.
HOW TO PLAY
When running the app, you are presented with a 3D simulated camera zoom, pan and fly-over of one of the games. Swiping right brings up Gameprom news and swiping left brings up the local score screen. Tapping on a game's fly-over screen starts game play. Controls in game:
• Tap ANYWHERE on the left side of screen to control the left flipper and ANYWHERE on the right side to control the right flipper.
• Shake your iPad to realistically shake the pinball table, but not too much or you'll tilt.
• Tap on the "electronic caption" at the top of the screen to pause or resume your game.
• During the game pinch your fingers together or apart to toggle camera mode from live to fixed.
Features and capabilities of the game:
– New improved 3D engine
– Missions and Checkpoints
– Hidden locations
– Realistic physics
– Multiball
– Camera effects with two modes
– Save/load game
– Unique sounds
– Original soundtrack
– Table tilting

-- Arnold Kim, TouchArcade.com

"The physics and sounds of the game are specifically designed to make the game "feel right" and give pinball fans the closest feel to actually being on a machine."
-- Erik Fikkert, AppVee.com

"...it's a very good game indeed and probably the best digital pin table I've seen in a long time."
-- Sir Digby, AllAboutTheGames.co.uk

"Fantastic 3D pinball table and animations. Very crisp visuals, and a buttery smooth frame rate. It doesn’t get any more realistic than this."
-- Matt Dunn, iPhoneGamesNetwork.com

"...there's no title screen, no front end interface or needless menu navigation. You tap, and you're instantly in. It's really clean, and as long as you aren't expecting some sort of epic experience in your pinball, it's perfect given the nature of mobile gaming."
-- Mark Bozon, IGN

ABOUT THE GAME

Wild West Pinball team - more than 3 000 000 players around the world!

Welcome to Wild West Pinball - world first professional pinball simulator for the iPhone. With fast 3D graphics and realistic physics this game will blow your mind. All parts of pinball table are real objects and you can see how it works! Western style locations and environment gives you a lot of fun.

IMPORTANT

• You can find SOUND, MUSIC and THEME options in standart iPhone “Settings” section.
• During the game pinch your fingers together or apart to toggle camera mode from live to fixed.


HOW TO PLAY

When running the app, you are presented with a 3D simulated camera zoom, pan and fly-over of one of the games. Swiping right brings up Gameprom news and swiping left brings up the local score screen. Tapping on a game's fly-over screen starts game play. Controls in game:
• Tap ANYWHERE on the left side of screen to control the left flipper and ANYWHERE on the right side to control the right flipper.
• Shake your iPad to realistically shake the pinball table, but not too much or you'll tilt.
• Tap on the "electronic caption" at the top of the screen to pause or resume your game.
• During the game pinch your fingers together or apart to toggle camera mode from live to fixed.

Features and capabilities of the game:

– New improved 3D engine
– Missions and Checkpoints
– Hidden locations
– Realistic physics
– Multiball
– Camera effects with two modes
– Save/load game
– Unique sounds
– Original soundtrack
– Table tilting
– Local scores table
– World scores table

bluejetty:00091249:ios.name: Verify 365
bluejetty:00091249:ios.summary:
Verify 365 is an automated, biometric, NFC-based and AI-powered identity verification and anti-money laundering compliance app. Built for security. Loved by lawyers.
Verify 365 ID Check app lets you confirm your identity online. 
The app
bluejetty:00091249:ios.description:
Verify 365 is an automated, biometric, NFC-based and AI-powered identity verification and anti-money laundering compliance app. Built for security. Loved by lawyers.
Verify 365 ID Check app lets you confirm your identity online. 
The app is safe and secure. Your personal information will not be stored in the app or on the phone when you finish using it.
If you have been invited by your lawyer to download and use this app, you may not have to attend an appointment with your lawyer to confirm and prove your identity.
What is Verify 365? 
Verify 365 app makes it easy to prove who you are. 
By using our app, you can provide identity documents and bank statements to your lawyer quickly and securely, to help confirm your identity and source of funds. 
Biometric Verification Platform
Verify 365 supports over 9,000 government issued IDs from over 190 countries. Our global reach allows us to verify your documents from all corners of the world. 
Verify 365 offers highly automated biometric verifications to make this quick and simple, so you can quickly prove your identity when requested by your lawyer. 
NFC Document Verification
With our latest NFC-chip reader verification technology, we can verify your identity document in a matter of seconds. Not only does our NFC technology make mobile verification flows more convenient, but our NFC verification process is also a much more secure method of data validation and it's fully compliant with HM Land Registry standards.
AML Checks through Open Banking platform
If requested by your lawyer, Verify 365 will verify your source of funds securely and easily through our FCA-regulated Open Banking technology. Our Account Information Service extracts individual or company transactions and balance data from multiple accounts, using bank-side authentication and consent processes. 
Accurate and Complete Bank Account Transaction Data
A thorough anti-money laundering source of funds check is critical to cover AML-requirements and reduce money laundering fraud risks. 
Providing paper statements to your lawyer can lead to long turnaround times. With Verify 365, your bank account transaction data is guaranteed to be authentic and complete and it's instantly available to your lawyer, analysed and verified without the need to provide additional bank statements.
Verify 365 Open Banking Features: 
1. Accurate Bank Account Statements
2. Verified Source of Funds
3. Automated Anti-money Laundering Checks
4. Instant PEPs & Sanctions Checks
5. Open Banking and PSD2 compliant
BEFORE YOU START YOUR VERIFICATION 
You will need a biometric ID document, so a passport, drivers licence, ID card or residence permit, and be in a well-lit area, so you can take a good quality photograph of yourself. 
How Verify 365 works? 
You will need to: 
1. Get an invite by text message from your lawyer 
2. Download the Verify 365 app
3. Log in using your phone number and OTP code
4. Take an image of your document
5. Read the chip in your document using your phone
6. Scan your face using your phone
7. Take a photograph of yourself for your digital status
8. Provide your address and upload supporting documents, if required 
9. Provide access to your bank statements through secure Open Banking API platform 
10. Complete a Source of Funds questionnaire 
Objective Decisions Make Clear Verifications
Our video-first approach allows for more certainty, security and objectivity. 
Our identity document checks are 98% automated, making verification lightning fast and automated decisions clear and logical.

bluejetty:00082454:ios.description:
Eerie Worlds - A Tactical CCG Where Horror and Myth Collide
Where the fabric of realms and worlds meet, our reality holds its breath. For eons, the barriers to other worlds stood firm, untouched, but now, these bonds fray at the edges, sending shadows spilling back into our lands, allowing long-forgotten myths to return. A convergence of realms, foretold by the ancients, is upon us, and now is the moment for champions to rise and battle to reclaim the long-established equilibrium.
Guided by their ancient grimoire, these chosen few seek to master the intricate web of alliances newly formed from the remnants of upheaval. This sacred tome reveals the mysteries of realms unseen, inhabited by malevolent beings and nightmarish specters, all awaiting a leader who can harness their formidable powers for battle.
Dive into Eerie Worlds, the latest tactical collectible card game (CCG) where real horror and myth converge. Rooted in real-world folklore, mythology, and documented events, this game immerses you in a realm teeming with supernatural forces. Players wield the power to link worlds, set the rules of engagement, and command monstrous entities in fierce battles for control over mystical Rifts—gateways bridging our reality to the terrifying unknown.
Collect and Battle
Card Duels: Combine forces from different mythologies, folklore, and entities. Imagine Yokai joining Vampires to battle Greek Minotaurs and Medieval Ghouls.
Strategic Play: Command mythical creatures and legendary figures to outwit and overpower your opponents.
Ultimate Decks: Build powerful decks with cards that are the very essence of folklore and mythology.
Features
Battle Decks: Create powerful decks with eerie cards that embody folklore and mythology.
Unique Abilities: Use cards with special abilities to gain the upper hand.
Dynamic Arenas: Battle in haunted forests, ancient crypts, and shadowy caves, determined by the placement of 'world cards'. One arena can take over another, changing the battlefield dynamically.
Upgradable Cards: Combine duplicates to create more powerful, shiny cards!
Play with Friends
Weekly Leagues: Participate in PvP leagues and events.
Duel Friends: Build battle decks to duel friends in epic weekly battles.
Rewards
Daily Rewards: Earn free unique rewards daily.
Leaderboards: Collect trophies and climb the leaderboard for big prizes.

- Share groups of contacts by text, email, and more

- A simple, intuitive, and beautiful design

bluejetty:00137647:ios.summary: Looking for a boat ramp? Need to find public hunting areas? Looking for a family-friendly TWRA fishing lake? Want to know more about watchable wildlife and even get ideas on where you can get your next awesome photo? Want the luxury of buyi
bluejetty:00137647:ios.description:
Looking for a boat ramp? Need to find public hunting areas? Looking for a family-friendly TWRA fishing lake? Want to know more about watchable wildlife and even get ideas on where you can get your next awesome photo? Want the luxury of buying your hunting and fishing licenses, or renewing your boat registration from your smart phone instead of standing in long lines at the store?
Well, now you can have all of that, and so much more, on our upgraded TWRA On The Go app! Our goal is to continue making it as easy as possible for you to enjoy a day outside anywhere in this great state of ours. 
You can also browse our app for hunting, fishing, and boating guides as well as current season dates and trout stocking schedules in order to get the most reliable understanding of Tennessee’s rules and regulations.
If you need to buy hunting and fishing licenses, or renew a boat registration, our app can help you with those needs as well. You can buy any of these items from your smart phone and have a legally official document on your phone immediately without the need to leave your favorite hunting spot, fishing hole or boat ramp.
Be better informed about Tennessee’s great outdoor opportunities, and then stay On The Go as much as you like!

bluejetty:00088276:ios.summary:
Keep your eyes on the road while DashCam Recorder turns your iPhone into a private, high-quality dashcam.
Continuously record video with GPS, speed, altitude, accelerometer, pitch & roll and date/time metadata.
Replay your drives on a map w
bluejetty:00088276:ios.description:
Keep your eyes on the road while DashCam Recorder turns your iPhone into a private, high-quality dashcam.
Continuously record video with GPS, speed, altitude, accelerometer, pitch & roll and date/time metadata.
Replay your drives on a map with the free iOS & macOS DashCam-Player apps.
Truly free – no ads, no subscriptions, no signups, no "pro" version.
Auto-start, loop recording, crash sensor, video compression, and driver focus mode for safe, reliable operation.
Why DashCam is different:
 • High-quality video – stabilised recording at up to your device’s maximum resolution and frame rate
 • Complete metadata – GPS location, speed, altitude, date and time, pitch & roll, accelerometer. Embed in an invisible track or as a watermark
 • Replay and explore – view your drives on a map with the free macOS & iOS DashCam Player app
Key Benefits:
 • Easy and reliable – start recording with one tap, auto-start, loop recording, and Driver Focus mode (screen off)
 • Seamless integration – sync videos with iCloud and save directly to Photos. Works with Siri, Navigation, and Music in the background
 • Adjustable recording – set video length (1 to 15 minutes) and choose front or back camera, landscape or portrait
Why choose DashCam over a physical DashCam?
 • High-quality video recording – with advanced stabilisation and ultra-wide camera support
 • Enhanced privacy and security – recordings are protected with Face ID or Touch ID
 • Easy access to your videos – via iCloud or AirDrop
 • Use navigation and music apps in the background while recording
 • Free to use – perfect for giving older iPhones a second life
Technical Highlights:
 • Automatic and superb video stabilisation
 • HEVC video compression, same quality but 40% smaller file size
 • Embed GPS, speed, altitude, pitch & roll, time, date and accelerometer as metadata
 • Add a Watermark to the video with all data
 • Save videos to daily trip albums, add daily driving distance to the Watermark 
 • Save a video instantaneously to Photos with Siri (iOS16+): "Save Video", start the App with "Start DashCam Recording"
 • Display a Map with your current position (use a Navigation App in the background for verbal instructions)
 • Infinite loop recording with automatic saving of crash events
 • Parking sensor – pause and resume recording automatically
 • Thermal and battery monitoring to protect your device
 • Autostart - Start/Stop recording with your car (when plugged in)
 • Snap a photo at any time by tapping the screen
 • Pitch & Roll - Record your off-road trips
 • Stable App, top rated crash free score
Tips and Notes:
 • Use flight mode for uninterrupted recording
 • Check local DashCam laws before use
 • DashCam Player for iOS & macOS displays route, speed, and other metadata
Website and Support:
 • https://dashcam.cam – manual, FAQs, and macOS app downloads
Do you like this app? Please rate it in the App Store !
And please check out our macOS app, ADS-B Radar, the most beautiful visualiser for your ADS-B receiver:
https://apps.apple.com/app/id1538149835

This app is provided for personal use only. Always operate your vehicle safely and in compliance with local laws. Do not interact with the app while driving. The developer is not responsible for any accidents, damages, or legal issues arising from use of the app.

bluejetty:00015153:ios.description:
The only meditation app that builds a custom guided meditation for you on demand.
Pick a length from 5 to 60 minutes. Pick how much voice guidance you want. Tap Build. In seconds, you'll have a one-of-a-kind guided practice assembled from a real practitioner's voice. No two are alike.
Plus 500+ guided meditations for anxiety, sleep, stress, focus, anger, grief, self-compassion, and the small stuff that doesn't fit anywhere else.
Meditation without the woo-woo.
Why Declutter The Mind
Most meditation apps either lock the good stuff behind a paywall or dress mindfulness up as spirituality. We did the opposite. The free tier is real: 500+ practices, every topic, no ads, no 7-day trial that turns into an $80 charge.
If you've bounced off meditation apps because the wellness vibe felt off, you're our target user.
What's inside
• Custom Meditation: build your own session on demand
• 500+ guided meditations across 18+ topics
• A new daily meditation every day
• Full courses, from a 30-day beginner foundation to advanced practice
• Meditation timer for silent sits
• Offline downloads so you can practice without signal
• Streak tracking, total minutes, and session history
• Reminders that don't pester
• Dark-mode ready
Topics we go deep on
Anxiety. Sleep. Stress. Focus. Anger. Grief. Self-compassion. Loving-kindness. Body scan. Breathing. Mindful walking. Beginner foundations. Performance anxiety. Racing thoughts before bed. Work decompression. Letting go of overthinking.
What you won't find here
No celebrity narrators. No "manifest your best life." No chakras, vibrations, or sacred energy. No 7-day trial that auto-renews at $79. No subscription required to access the library. No ads. No upsells inside meditations. No guru.
Free vs DTM+
Free, forever: the full 500+ library, one Custom Meditation, all topics, the timer, reminders, streaks.
DTM+ ($7.99/month or $59.99/year): unlimited Custom Meditations, a new meditation every day, full courses, and offline downloads.
A practical approach
Practices are based on mindfulness, vipassana, and the measurable benefits of regular meditation: lower anxiety, better sleep, sharper focus, more emotional regulation. No mysticism dressed up as wellness.
We're a small independent team. We read every email. If you want a practice that doesn't exist yet, tell us. New content drops every month.
Press play. See you on the inside.

bluejetty:00186232:ios.name: SENTENCE READING MAGIC
bluejetty:00186232:ios.summary: Introducing "Sentence Reading Magic" – the app designed to transform your child into an excellent reader! Built on evidence-based Science of Reading principles, this app bridges the gap between reading words and reading books, focusing on t
bluejetty:00186232:ios.description:
Introducing "Sentence Reading Magic" – the app designed to transform your child into an excellent reader! Built on evidence-based Science of Reading principles, this app bridges the gap between reading words and reading books, focusing on the crucial skill of reading sentences. By offering a gradual and enjoyable step up from reading individual words, it instills confidence and fosters skill building in emerging readers.
With its Sentence Reading Magic feature, this app empowers children to become proficient readers while familiarizing them with essential high frequency words and guiding them from reading words to reading sentences. By providing practice in decoding, blending, and comprehending complete sentences, it prepares young readers to tackle decodable sentences and books, all while boosting fluency and comprehension skills.
What sets "Sentence Reading Magic" apart is its incorporation of the five pillars of reading – Phonemic Awareness, Phonics, Vocabulary, Fluency, and Comprehension. Through engaging games and activities, the app helps children recognize and manipulate individual sounds in words, understand the relationship between letters and sounds, expand their vocabulary within a sentence context, and practice reading sentences repeatedly to enhance fluency and comprehension.
The app offers four captivating sentence games that aid in building, reading, and spelling out short, simple sentences. Additionally, it includes five mini-games for learning and practicing the most common high-frequency words, using a phonetic approach to help children see patterns within these words.
For those seeking an even more enriching experience, the full upgradeable version of "Sentence Reading Magic" boasts 324 sentences divided into 27 lessons, multiple sound and voice options, and three font choices. However, it's important to note that the app requires children to have a prerequisite skill level of consistently and easily reading 3-letter short vowel words before use.
Developed by a team of educators using accelerated learning techniques, Montessori principles, and the Science of Reading, "Sentence Reading Magic" has undergone rigorous testing and garnered approval from preschool children and their teachers in various settings. Your feedback and suggestions are highly valued as we continue to refine and enhance the app for an optimal learning experience.
Don't miss this opportunity to unlock your child's reading potential with "Sentence Reading Magic" – where learning to read becomes a magical journey!

bluejetty:00087717:ios.name: Sano: Photo Calorie Tracking
bluejetty:00087717:ios.summary: Discover the future of meal tracking with Sano, a revolutionary iOS app designed to make meal tracking easy and effortless. Simply snap a photo of your meal, and let Sano's advanced AI technology break it down into nutritional content, offe
bluejetty:00087717:ios.description:
Discover the future of meal tracking with Sano, a revolutionary iOS app designed to make meal tracking easy and effortless. Simply snap a photo of your meal, and let Sano's advanced AI technology break it down into nutritional content, offering detailed insights into calories and macros. You can also describe your meal with human readable text, and Sano will intelligently break down the text into the correct nutritional information.
No more scrolling endlessly through a database, trying to find the right food entry. No more relying on random nutritional information from other users, that may or may not be correct. With Sano's intelligent AI, it's quicker and easier than ever to track your meals.
Sano Premium is required to access AI meal recognition, calorie tracking, and macro tracking. Premium is offered as an auto-renewing subscription with a free trial.
Key Features (Premium subscription required):
- AI-Powered Photo Recognition: Capture your meal in a photo, and let Sano break down it's nutritional content.
- AI-Powered Text Recognition: Simply describe your meal (ie: "2 cups of rice, 6 oz of beef, 1 cup of broccoli"), and Sano will do the rest.
- AI-Powered Voice Recognition: Describe your meal using your voice for faster, hands-free meal logging.
- Ask Sano AI for corrections: refine an analysis when an ingredient, quantity, or other meal detail needs changing.
- Macro & Calorie Tracking: Instant, detailed breakdowns of your macros for mindful eating.
- Siri meal logging: say “Hey Siri, use Sano to log a meal” to describe, review, and save a meal hands-free.
- Goals and progress: follow your calorie and macro targets, review calorie trends, and log weight progress.
- Fitness-Focused: Ideal for those into fitness, personal training, and weight loss.
- Effortless Meal Logging: Quick, accurate, and hassle-free.
- Meal-Logging Streaks: Build consistency, follow your current streak, view your personal best, and review your logging calendar.
- Weekly and Monthly Summaries: Review your meals logged, days on target, most frequently logged meals, and progress over time.
- Shareable Recaps: Share personalized nutrition recap cards with friends.
- Meal and Streak Reminders: Set reminders to log meals and keep your streak going.
- Quick-Access Widgets: Open photo, text, or voice meal logging directly from a Sano widget.
- Exercise Tracking: Log workouts, duration, intensity, and estimated calories burned.
- Apple Health Integration: Sync supported nutrition, weight, body-fat, and activity information with Apple Health.
- Invite Friends: Eligible users can give a friend a free month of Sano Premium and receive a free month in return.
Why Choose Sano?
- Revolutionary Technology: The first iOS app to analyze meals with a photo or text description.
- Time-Saving: More time for fitness, less on meal tracking.
- Educational: Understand your diet, optimize your health.
- Motivation That Lasts: Build streaks, review summaries, and see your progress over time.
- Flexible Tracking: Log meals using a photo, text, voice, Siri, recent meals, saved meals, or widgets.
Subscription Details:
Sano Premium unlocks all features. Subscriptions auto-renew until canceled. You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. See our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy for details.
Follow Sano on Instagram for meal-tracking tips, product updates, and behind-the-scenes content: @tracksano
https://www.instagram.com/tracksano/
Sano uses Apple's standard Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00146055:ios.description:
Doggy Time - Puppy Potty Log & Dog Care Tracker
The easiest way to track your dog's day! Log potty breaks, meals, sleep, walks, and training in one tap - then share with your whole family. Designed for puppy potty training and daily dog care, Doggy Time also supports cats, rabbits, birds, and 35+ other pets.
● COMPLETE PUPPY & DOG TRAINING APP TOOLS
- Smart puppy potty log with customizable reminders to prevent accidents
- Obedience training progress log with success tracking
- Training timers for crate training, sleep training & socialization
- Step-by-step training guides for new puppy owners
● COMPREHENSIVE PET HEALTH MONITOR
- Track vaccinations with automatic reminder schedules
- Monitor medication doses and set medication alerts
- Log nutrition details, food allergies, and dietary changes
- Record weight, growth, and developmental milestones
- Track grooming sessions and veterinary appointments
● ACTIVITY & EXERCISE TRACKER
- GPS walk tracking maps routes, distance, and duration
- Activity timer for play sessions, training, and sleep
- Monitor daily exercise goals customized for your pet's breed
- Track bathroom breaks and potty training success
- Log daily routines and monitor behavioral patterns
- Set activity reminders for consistent pet care
● MULTI-PET HOUSEHOLD SUPPORT
- Create custom profiles for unlimited pets
- Dog-focused features adaptable for cats, rabbits, guinea pigs & hamsters
- Species-specific care reminders and health tracking
- Manage your entire pet family in one convenient app
- From puppies to parrots, track all your companions
● ADVANCED SHARING & INTEGRATION
- Apple Watch (Watch OS) integration for on-the-go tracking
- Assign care tasks to multiple caregivers with progress tracking
- Share pet information with walkers, sitters, and family
- Export health data for veterinary appointments
- Live activity tracking for real-time monitoring
- Offline access to all essential pet data
● SMART INSIGHTS & ANALYTICS
- Training progress reports with actionable recommendations
- Behavior pattern recognition to improve training effectiveness
Download Doggy Time today - your complete solution for dog training, cat care, and multi-pet household management!
Contact us at help@kidplay.app.
Terms of Use: https://www.kidplay.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.kidplay.app/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00186408:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00186408:ios.description:
With more than 600 hadiths in its bank, each hadith has been carefully chosen which, if pondered upon, it could inspire its reader and trigger a life changing experience.
The App features:
• It is free.
• It has more than 600 hadiths in six languages: English, Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Turkish and Indonesian.
• You can set up a timer to automatically pop up the day’s hadith on your screen on daily basis.
• Choose a default language for hadith to be displayed. 
• Toggle manually between translations.
• Add a hadith to Favourites.
• View Previous Days Hadiths.
• Share a hadith as text or image through email, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram or SMS in any of the four languages.
• One time download, no Internet connection is required afterwards.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.
----------------- العربية -----------------
حديث اليوم يوفر لك هذا التطبيق فرصة التعرف على حديث شريف جديد في كل يوم. يوفر البرنامج أكثرمن ٦٠٠ حديث شريف لأهل البيت، تم اختيار كل حديث شريف بعناية لتحفيز القارئ بالتفكر والتأمل ، وربما تلهمه وتدفعه لتجربة حياة مختلفة
فيما يلي بعض مميزات تطبيقات حديث اليوم 
خدمة مجانية
يضم أكثر من ٦٠٠ حديث شريف ب ٦ لغات: اللغة العربية، الإنجليزية والفارسية والأردية والتركية والإندونيسية
يمكنك ضبط جهاز الموقت (تايمر) لتنزيل الحديث الشريف اليومي تلقائياً على شاشة جهازك بشكل يومي
إختيار لغة عرض الحديث الشريف
التنقل يدوياً بين الترجمات
إضافة الحديث الشريف للقائمة المفضلة - فيفوريت
الإطلاع على الأحاديث الشريفة التي تم عرضها في الأيام السابقة
يمكن مشاركة او إرسال الحديث الشريف عبر البريد الإلكتروني و تويتر وإنستغرام و فيس بوك أو الرسائل النصية باستخدام أي من اللغات الثلاث
التحميل لمرة واحدة ولا يتطلب الاتصال بالإنترنت بعد ذلك
يعمل البرنامج على أجهزة الآيفون والآيباد
----------------- فارسی -----------------
هر روز با یک حدیث جدید با اپلیکیشن حدیث روز. در این نرم افزار بیش از ششصد حدیث برگزیده از اهل بیت علیهم السلام گرد آوری شده است، احادیثی که تفکر و تعمق در مفاهیم آنها، می تواند تغییر بزرگی در زندگی روزمره خواننده ایجاد کند.
برخی از ویژگی های نرم افزار حدیث روز 
رایگان
بیش از ششصد حدیث به شش زبان فارسی، عربی، انگلیسی، اردو، ترکی و اندونزیایی
امکان تنظیم زمان ساعت برای نمایش خودکار روزانه حدیث بر روی صفحه
دریافت حدیث به زبان مورد نظر
امکان دیدن ترجمه های چهار گانه حدیث
امکان افزودن حدیث مورد علاقه به فهرست علاقهمندی
امکان مشاهده احادیث روزهای قبل
امکان به اشتراک گذاشتن حدیث به صورت متن یا تصویر در تويتر٬ اینستاگرام ٬ فيس بوك ٬اس ام اس و یا ایمیل به هر یک از زبان های چهار گانه
یک بار دانلود، بدون نیاز به اتصال اینترنتی در مراجعات بعدی
قابل دریافت روی دستگاه های آیفون و آیپد
----------------- Indonesia -----------------
"Hadis Harian Saya" memberi Anda satu hadis baru setiap hari. Dengan lebih dari 600 koleksi hadis yang bersumber dari Ahlulbayt, masing-masing hadits telah dipilih dengan cermat, apabila direnungkan, akan dapat mengilhami pembacanya dan memberikan pengalaman yang akan mampu mengubah hidup.
Di bawah ini adalah beberapa fitur dari aplikasi "My Daily Hadith".
• Gratis.
• Memiliki lebih dari 600 hadits dalam enam bahasa: Inggris, Arab, Persia, Urdu, Turki, dan Indonesia.
• Anda dapat mengatur waktu untuk memunculkan hadits harian di layar Anda setiap hari secara otomatis.
• Pilih bahasa standar untuk hadits yang akan ditampilkan.
• Beralih secara manual di antara terjemahan.
• Tambahkan sebuah hadits ke Favorit.
• Lihat Hadits Hadits Sebelumnya.
• Bagikan sebuah hadits melalui email, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook atau SMS dalam salah satu dari empat bahasa.
• Satu kali unduhan, tidak diperlukan koneksi internet setelahnya.
• Berfungsi pada iPhone, iPad.

*** Downloading this app is a 2-step process: installation of the app, and a full download of app content. This can take 5 to 10 minutes. Please do not navigate away from the app until both steps have been completed. ***
The Merck Veterinary Manual, a renowned animal health reference for more than 60 years, covers all species and disorders of veterinary interest worldwide. 
This app provides veterinarians, students and other animal health professionals with clear, practical explanations of thousands of conditions across all body systems. It covers etiology, pathophysiology, and options for diagnosis and treatment. 
The trusted Merck Veterinary app offers: 
• Thousands of topics written and updated regularly by more than 400 veterinary experts from more than 20 countries 
• Photos, illustrations, and video of thousands of disorders and diseases
• Quizzes* check knowledge of veterinary disorders, signs, and treatments 
• Interactive Case Simulations* test ability to treat a specific patient over the disease course 
• Clinical calculators
• Numerous reference guides and hundreds of useful tables
• Pet health content* written in consumer-friendly language for clients
• FAQ and User Guide
*Internet access needed. 
About Merck Manuals
Our mission is simple: 
We believe that health information is a universal right and that every person is entitled to accurate, accessible and usable medical information. We have a responsibility to protect, preserve and share the best current medical information to enable more informed decisions, enhance relationships between patients and professionals, and improve health care outcomes around the world. 
That’s why we are making the Merck Manuals available for free in digital form to veterinary professionals and clients around the world. No registration or subscription required, and no ads. 
NOND-1179303-0001 04/16
This mobile application is intended for Veterinary Professionals.
For more information please read the End User License Agreement at http://www.msd.com/policy/terms-of-use/home.html
For more information about our privacy practices, please see our privacy commitment at https://www.msdprivacy.com
Adverse Event Reporting: To report an adverse event with a specific Merck product, please call the Merck National Service Center at 1-800-672-6372. For questions or help with the app please contact merckmanualsinfo@merck.com

bluejetty:00035910:ios.description:
Meal planning, done for you.
Personalized weekly plans and smart grocery lists—tailored to your taste.
Let us build you a personalized weekly meal plan, or build a plan from recipes you love – plus a smart grocery list that comes together automatically. Set your taste preferences once so every recommendation fits how you actually cook. No more guessing what to make or what to buy.
SMART PERSONALIZATION
Set up your Taste Profile to tell us what you love, what you avoid, and how you like to cook. Whether you build your own plan or let us build one for you, every recommendation feels relevant and doable.
MEAL PLANNING, YOUR WAY
Plan your week in seconds. Use the Personalized Meal Planner to build a plan for any days and meals you want, or build your own from recipes you love. Choose to minimize groceries or prioritize ingredient variety with a single tap.
ONE SMART GROCERY LIST
Your entire week, organized in one place. Ingredients automatically combine across recipes and group by aisle for easier shopping. Check items off as you go, move completed items to the bottom of your list, or order everything at once with Instacart.
THOUSANDS OF RELIABLE RECIPES
Explore a large library of tried-and-true recipes from Tastemade’s chefs and creators. Whether you’re cooking something quick or trying something new, every recipe works seamlessly with your meal plan and grocery list.
COOK WITH CONFIDENCE
Follow step-by-step cooking mode, view detailed nutrition info, scale serving sizes, and switch instantly between metric and imperial measurements—all designed to make cooking feel simpler and more approachable.
SAVE & STAY ORGANIZED
Save favorite recipes, build collections, and organize everything in your personal Recipe Box—so your go-to meals are always easy to find.
ACCESS & PRICING
Tastemade Cooking is free to download. Start with a 1-week free trial, then choose a subscription plan to continue access.
Subscription options:
– Monthly: 1-week free trial, then $5.99/month
– Annual: 1-week free trial, then $49.99/year (save 30%)
Cancel anytime.
This app does not include our full shows and documentaries, which can be found in the Tastemade: Stream Shows & Docs app.

Dexcom Clarity is an important part of your Dexcom CGM system. It ca
bluejetty:00026614:ios.description:
Dexcom Clarity is a diabetes management application for CGM users. It provides relevant insights into users’ retrospective glucose values, patterns, and trends over time.
Dexcom Clarity is an important part of your Dexcom CGM system. It can help you identify glucose patterns and, with your healthcare professional, determine the potential causes of those patterns.
Dexcom Clarity users experience up to 15% increased time in range (70-180mg/dL) as compared to non-users.*
Log in with your Dexcom account to:
• Keep tabs on your time in range, patterns and other key metrics.
• Allow clinics to access to your data and reports to make appointments more efficient.
• Set Time in Range goals.
• Turn on daily or weekly notifications and emails.
• View, save, print, and email all reports.
• Connect to partner apps for more features and benefits.
This app store should not be used as your first point of contact to resolve technical or customer services issues. In order to protect your privacy and personal information, and promptly resolve any technical or customer services issues you are having with any Dexcom product, please contact 1-888-738-3646.
Dexcom is required to follow up with customers regarding product-related complaints. If Dexcom determines that your comment/complaint requires follow up, a technical support representative will attempt to contact you to gather more information regarding your comment/complaint.
*Parker AS, Welsh J, Jimenez A, Walker T. Insights from big data (2): Benefits of self-guided retrospective review of continuous glucose monitoring reports. Diabetes Technol Ther. 2018;20(S1):A-27.

bluejetty:00152097:ios.description:
NoContact: Breakup Recovery & Healing
The #1 app to help you move on, heal, and regain your strength after a breakup.
Breakups are hard — but you don’t have to go through it alone. NoContact gives you the structure, tools, and daily support to finally break free, resist the urge to reach out, and focus on becoming the strongest version of yourself.
WHY YOU NEED NOCONTACT
Stay Consistent – 90% of people break no contact at some point. Daily motivation, reminders & accountability tools keep you strong so you don’t cave in.
Track Your Progress – Watch your no contact streak grow, celebrate milestones, and see your recovery become real.
Regain Confidence – Build clarity and self-worth step by step, without rushing.
Proven Psychology – Everything is rooted in breakup recovery psychology, not guesswork.
KEY FEATURES
Personalized No Contact Plan – Get a tailored plan and timeline to help you through every stage of recovery.
Temptation Mode – Instant emergency support when urges hit, so you stay on track.
Grounding Tools – Stay committed to no contact by using the app's built-in reminders for when times get hard, and positive self-love tools to grow and move on.
Progress Tracking – See your streaks, milestones, and growth in real time.
Breakup Advice & Resources – Expert tips, articles, and strategies for moving on and coping with emotions.
Instant Affirmations – Daily reminders and affirmations to keep you motivated.
Community Support – Connect with others going through the same journey and share your progress.
WHY IT WORKS
Prevents Relapse – Tools intercept cravings and temptations before they turn into mistakes.
Built-in Accountability – AI coach, progress counters, and milestones keep you on track.
Visible Healing – Your streaks and growth make recovery tangible.
Daily Support – Motivation, affirmations, and practical exercises help you heal faster.
THIS APP IS FOR YOU IF…
You just ended a breakup or divorce and don’t know how to cope
You keep slipping back into contact with your ex
You are stuck in an ongoing toxic situationship / relationship
You feel stuck in an unhealthy cycle you can’t break alone
You want structure, support, and real results
Download NoContact today and start your healing journey.
Stay strong, stay no contact, and move forward with confidence.
TIMER & FULL APP ACCESS REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION.

bluejetty:00073084:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00073084:ios.description:
VoiceAgain Lets Your Phone Speak For You!
Text to Speech is a modern TTS (text to speech) app, designed to helps people who’ve lost their voice communicate again in person and call.
Text to Speech has a familiar “chat-style” interface, so it feels just like you're texting somebody, helping you speak with SPEED and EFFICIENCY.
HOW IT WORKS
————————
That’s easy – just type, then press “speak”. 
More specifically, AI Text to Speech produces natural sounding speech from the words that you type. 
WHO THIS APP IS FOR
———————————
For people who rely on text to speech every day:
Designed to be stable, predictable, and easy to use when you need it most.
Clear playback, saved phrases, and consistent behavior you can depend on.
USES
———
- I lost my voice, and I use to struggle to communicate with others. But then I found this app which enables me to speak to people again!
- I was bored, but not anymore! This app is surprisingly addicting and makes a fun and entertaining way to have my phone say funny things.
- I can even use this text to speech app as a text reader. Just copy and paste online articles, books, etc., and this TTS reader will read it to me.
Features we DO have
——————————
- Free to download. No ads either.
- Natural text to speech with a clean, chat-style interface.
- 56 voices across 38 languages.
- Adjust volume, pitch, rate, and tone.
- Save frequent phrases for quick access.
- Background Audio implemented so the text reader can continue playing even when your phone is locked.
- Email Support. Don’t hesitate to email any questions or suggestions you have while using this app. We hope to make your experience as great as possible.
Advanced features
—————————
- Voice clone for a more personal voice.
- Lifelike avatar voices with expressive tone control.
- Save spoken audio for replay or sharing.
- Smart Reply suggestions to speed up typing.
- Call for Me: let the app make phone calls for you.
Features we (happily) DON’T have
————————————————
- NO Ads
 - Sorry, we know you love being blasted by popup ads every second like many text to speech apps, but this app doesn’t have any.
- EASY to Try
 - A free text to speech app for basic communication and text reading.
 - Subscription unlocks unlimited communication and advanced features.
Voices - 56 different voices in 38 languages
—————————————————————

Chinese (China mainland)

bluejetty:00035045:ios.name: World Warfare
bluejetty:00035045:ios.summary: A unique fusion of sandbox simulator, real-time strategy, and military tactics gameplay. World Warfare will take you to World War II battlegrounds, where you will be able to use classic military units to conduct battles. For those commander
bluejetty:00035045:ios.description:
A unique fusion of sandbox simulator, real-time strategy, and military tactics gameplay. World Warfare will take you to World War II battlegrounds, where you will be able to use classic military units to conduct battles. For those commanders who want to feel the thrill of victory, let’s use skill and strategy to battle to the top!
▶FEATURES◀
WW2 MILITARY LAYOUT
Real ww2 military technologies and equipment, including Tiger Heavy Tank, M4 Sherman Tank, P-51 Mustang, they are all under your control. 
It’s up to you whether to do a ruthless expansion or an intelligent alliance.
Variety maps with different conditions, we reproduce the best environment just for you.
SIMULATION STRATEGY
You can control single unit or tons of units all at once, based on your strategy. 
Your units only follow your orders, within a finger touch to move and attack or even capture.
Units move in real-time across the battlefield, you can zoom freely and explore in the palm of your hand.
TACTICS COLLOCATIONS
Conquer resources, forge alliances and strengthen your economy. Be prepared for every battle!
Learn different tactics to be the best commander and claim your honorable achievements.
Develop yourself freely in live wars as an Airman, a Tanker or an Artillerist in different battles.
ALLIANCE COMRADERY
Team up with allies to increase your power and expand your territory tactically. 
Enjoy the cooperation, battle for profit Tournament Rewards with stunning badges.
Build up loyal leagues, work well among members and fight to the top.
Enjoy World Warfare? Learn more about the game and share your experiences with us!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/worldwarfaregame/
Forum: https://www.worldwarfare.com/

bluejetty:00033028:ios.summary:

Welcome to Aurora Hills!
Nestled deep within the Appalachian Mountains, Aurora Hills was known for its thriving industry and its picturesque landscape. O
bluejetty:00033028:ios.description:
Aurora Hills: Chapter 2 has been officially released! Find it now on the App Store! 
Welcome to Aurora Hills!
Nestled deep within the Appalachian Mountains, Aurora Hills was known for its thriving industry and its picturesque landscape. Owing to the region's natural resources, Aurora Hills was looking to become one of the most prosperous towns in the state.
All is not how it seems, however. A series of disappearances of residents and tourists alike have plagued the region over the past few years, sparking a mass exodus from the small town. Now, in October 1981, the town is a shell of its former self. The prosperity that once blessed Aurora Hills has all but evaporated.
Working as a park ranger, you must investigate what's going on with these disappearances and answer questions that have tormented residents for years. Why has there been an increase in disappearances over the past 6 months? Why are there no traces of the people who went missing? Perhaps most importantly, who, or what, could be behind all of this? It's up to you to venture forth, deep into the national park, to uncover the mysteries of Aurora Hills...
Developed by the creators of Meridian 157, Aurora Hills: Chapter 1 is the first part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Based in the year 1981 in a small West Virginian community, Aurora Hills follows the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from the region. Explore the rolling hills of West Virginia, find clues of the whereabouts of the missing people and solve intriguing puzzles to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills!
Features:
• Custom soundtrack and sound effects designed for a creepy in-game atmosphere
• Challenging and clever puzzles
• A logical hint system for some of the most difficult riddles
• Available in 9 languages, including English, French, Russian, German, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Japanese!
• New colour blind mode available for people who might have trouble with colour based puzzles
Follow us to receive all the latest news!

Twitter: https://twitter.com/novasoftint
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/novasoftint/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/NovaSoftInteractive

bluejetty:00179554:ios.description:
WiFi Around is your all‑in‑one Wi‑Fi safety, diagnostics, and travel connectivity app.
Whether you're at home, at the office, or traveling the world, it helps you understand network quality, spot risks, and stay connected globally — fast.
Key features:
- Global Travel eSIMs: Explore eSIM data plans for worldwide travel — stay connected without expensive roaming fees.
- DNS & SSL Safety Checks: Help spot risky or unsecured network connections.
- Speed Test: One‑tap analysis for download, upload, and latency.
- Nearby Hotspots: Public Wi‑Fi discovery for travel and daily use.
- Reachability Tests: Check connections for popular AI, gaming, and media platforms.
- Local Network Scan: Find connected devices and detect suspicious hidden cameras.
- Captive Portal Detection: Helps trigger public network sign‑in pages easily.
- Data Monitor: Keep track of your mobile data usage.
- Charging Animations: Personalize your charging experience.
Who it's for:
- Travelers needing affordable global data and secure public Wi-Fi.
- Anyone troubleshooting slow or unstable networks.
- Users who care about privacy, network safety, and connected devices.
Take control of your connection with WiFi Around.
Subscription Information:
Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings in the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

bluejetty:00098882:ios.description:
Thinking about rhinoplasty? See your results before nose surgery. Visualize different nose shapes and aesthetic changes in seconds.
Redefine your look with the newest technology! If you are not happy with your nose shape and need a retouch, try our Nosefix app right now! 
The nose is one of the most important parts of the face. If your nose is crooked or misshapen, it can be a bit annoying. If you avoid taking photos or try to hide your nose, we can help you in this case.
Upload the photo you took to our application and our latest technology AI-supported application will fix your photo for you. If you wish, you can try our application before any surgery or procedure and get an idea.
Thanks to our Nosefix application, you will now look much more beautiful in your photos. Change your nose shape immediately.
Thanks to our easy-to-use application, you will have the nose shape of your dreams in seconds. Just upload your photo and let the AI do its job.
About Subscription
- To access all features listed above, you must make a weekly or annual purchase.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Cost depends on the plan selected.
How do we handle face data?
- We collect the photos you upload to generate an image.
- We use the uploaded photo solely to create n image. Once the image is generated, we immediately delete the original photo from our servers.
- We do not share face data with any third parties. The data is temporarily processed on our secure servers and deleted immediately after the image is created.
- We retain face data only for the duration of the image generation process, and it is deleted immediately afterward.
You can refer to Section 9 of our Privacy Policy for more information. To learn why we collect these photos, please see Section 9.1. To find out how long the collected photos are retained, refer to Section 9.2. For details on sharing with third-party applications, see Section 9.3. For information on how long we keep facial data, check Section 9.4.
Privacy Policy: https://nosefix.volarapps.co/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://nosefix.volarapps.co/terms/

bluejetty:00131170:ios.description:
Solitaire is a classic Klondike solitaire card game. Solitaire is so interesting and so popular, people all over the world like playing solitaire to relax themselves. When people say "Solitaire", it is generally referred to as the Klondike solitaire. Klondike solitaire is most popular and most classic solitaire card game, compared to the other solitaire card games, like Spider Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, and TriPeaks Solitaire.
Let's install this perfect solitaire to train your brain and relax your life! This Classic Klondike has lots of good gameplay and pretty art.
Backgrounds
This classic solitaire has hundreds of pretty backgrounds, when playing this Klondike solitaire card game, you will immerse in beautiful view, in mountain, in forest, and so on. You will also love the sweet animals in the backgrounds.
Card Faces & Card Backs
In this classic solitaire, there are tens of card faces and card backs, you can choose the one you mostly like.
Events
Solitaire Klondike has many events and activities, such as sea adventure pass, tarot card pass, design houses and gardens, star chests to unlock, and so on.
Don't hesitate, let's install this perfect solitaire card game!
About the Solitaire Classic Klondike Subscription:
The Solitaire Classic Klondike subscription is an optional premium service. Once subscribed, you will receive all of the following benefits simultaneously:
· Removal of all advertisements
· extra Magic Wands every day
· extra Shuffle chances every day
Solitaire offers multiple subscription periods, including monthly, quarterly, and yearly plans. The monthly subscription includes a 7-day free trial. After the trial period ends, the subscription will automatically begin, and the subscription price will be based on the amount shown in the App Store for your region. Other subscription plans do not include a trial period.
Unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, your subscription will automatically renew. Renewal fees will be charged to your Apple ID account. You can manage or turn off auto-renewal in your device settings under “Settings” → “Apple ID” → “Subscriptions.”
You cannot cancel an active subscription during the current subscription period, but you may disable auto-renewal at any time to prevent charges in the next billing cycle.

bluejetty:00043328:ios.summary: Description: Software featuring manual data entry, storage, display, transfer, and self-managing of diabetes taking into account a number of parameters, such as insulin sensitivity factors, insulin-to-carbohydrate ratios, target blood gluco
bluejetty:00043328:ios.description:
Description: Software featuring manual data entry, storage, display, transfer, and self-managing of diabetes taking into account a number of parameters, such as insulin sensitivity factors, insulin-to-carbohydrate ratios, target blood glucose range and current blood glucose values thus facilitating the calculation of the required insulin dose and providing a better glycemic control.
Intended Use: The software is intended for the self-management of diabetes, facilitating the calculation of the bolus insulin dose and providing a better glycemic control.
Additional info:
SocialDiabetes helps you to control better your diabetes treatment with the convenience of carrying your logs directly on your smartphone. Register and combine logs and have your blood glucose under control. 
Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes care requires a lot of tracking. With SocialDiabetes, register all the relevant information to your treatment such as blood glucose levels, insulin, carbs, medicaments or physical activity. 
SocialDiabetes uses The Health app from Apple to register and read data related to your diabetes and exercise: blood sugar levels, weight, steps...
AWARDS
- Award to most innovator product by E.U. in 2017.
- Recognized as the best health app by UNESCO - WSA.
- International Mobile Premier Awards winner at the Mobile World Congress in Barcelona.
FEATURES 
View your glycemic and insulin on board. Take a look at your diabetes progress and the factors that might affect your glycemic. 
Combine the information, have a better comprehension of your diabetes. From New Log register:
 •Glycemic
 •Food
 •Medication
 •Activity
 •A1c
 •Weight 
 •Heart Pressure 
 •Ketones
With a minimum of 3 blood glucose logs daily for 3 months, we will be able to calculate your estimated A1c.
TOOLS
It will help you with your daily diabetes calculations:
-Bolus calculator: with your insulin-to-carb ratio, insulin sensitivity factor, and glycemic targets. receive insulin dose recommendations. 
-Carb Calculator: from the nutritional database, select each food and calculate the number of carbs that you are going to eat, by grams or rations. 
-Food. Consult the number of carbs from different food and add new ones.
-Connect with your device. Your glycemic logs will go from automatically your Smartphone. 
Check our compatible devices. 
-Reports generation.

bluejetty:00014726:ios.description:
Mind mapping helps you organize your thoughts, remember information and generate new ideas. We've created a beautiful, intuitive app, so you can mind map wherever you are and whenever you want.
SimpleMind Pro is designed to synchronize your Mind Maps across platforms. For example (as a separate purchase) for Mac - https://simplemind.eu/download/full-edition/
Highlights
• Easy to use.
• Continuously fine-tuned based on customer feedback.
• Trustworthy and reliable: 15+ years of updates and improvements.
• Used in a wide range of applications: business, education, legal and medical.
• Unique free-form layout or various auto layouts.
• Seamless synchronization using clouds.
• Add media and documents.
• Share Mind Maps.
• Change and customize the style of the Mind Map.
• Tools to help you maintain overview.
Create
○ place topics anywhere you want in the free-form layout
○ or use auto layout - great for brainstorming
○ reorganize and restructure using drag, rotate, re-arrange or reconnect
○ use checkboxes, progress bars, auto-numbering
○ connect any two topics with a crosslink
○ label relations
○ virtually unlimited page size and number of elements
○ supports multiple Mind Maps on one page
Add media and documents
○ images and photos
○ notes
○ icons (stock, emojis or custom)
○ link to a topic, mind map, contact, file or webpage
○ voice memos
○ videos
Seamless synchronization using clouds
○ sync mind maps with your iPads and iPhones
○ sync mind maps across platforms. For example with Mac - as a separate purchase
○ sync using iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, 坚果云 - Nutstore and Nextcloud
Share your Mind Map
○ for example as PDF or Image
○ outline, can be imported in word processors
○ create a slideshow to present your Mind Map (Tablet only)
○ print
○ export to Reminders or Calendar
Style your mind map
○ change the appearance by selecting one of the 15+ style sheets
○ create your own style sheets
○ style every detail, exactly how you want it
○ change borders, lines, colors, background color, the checkbox color, and much more
Maintain overview
○ collapse and expand branches
○ hide or show branches or topics
○ block out distractions with autofocus
○ highlight branches by displaying branch borders
○ visually group topics with group borders
○ organize your Mind Maps in folders
○ outline view
○ search

bluejetty:00180973:ios.description:
Get ready for X-War: Clash of Zombies. It is time for you to rise up and fight for your survival in a zombie apocalypse in this strategy adventure!
The deadly T Virus outbreak and infected all the human race. Those dead started turning into zombies and those few survivors that have resistance in their blood turning into mutants. As a leader of mutants, you must recruit Ice Queen, Monkey King, Sword man, Twin-headed dragon and other mutants from fantasy land. Build and defend your homeland, you are the last hope! Create the strongest mutants army, join the epic battle, kill all zombies, lead us to victory!
Game Features:
● Build Your Own Base
Upgrade buildings and walls, train your troops, research technology, recruit heroes, design your base layout. You can save more layouts of your base to defend zombies attack!
● Utilize Troop Formations
10+ different troop types and 10+ spell for you to choose from! Plan your lineups, take advantage of the counter system, and train your troops with the right Heroes! Perfect your strategy to defeat your enemies!
● Powerful Heroes Await
Create a strong team of Heroes to fight through zombies campaign! Let them lead your kingdom to glory!
● Forge League
Join a league to fight alongside your allies! Ride into war together to conquer various exciting events: League War, cross-server League War, Boss, zombies clash, and much more!
● Clash Online with Zombies
Brawl with zombies and save Doctor X. He can help you speed up the buildings defense!
● Raid Resources
Collect resources and steal loot from other players to upgrade your own Base and strengthen Defense!
Leader! Make everything and anything to survive and tell your story!
We are happy to share more with you and hear your thoughts! Please contact us at:
Chat in QQ Group:285306911

Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61560247351115
Feedback by Email: feedback@caesarsgame.com

bluejetty:00151200:ios.summary: Pillowtalk makes journaling easy, fun, and totally private. Just talk or type to vent—Pillowtalk’s AI gets you, replying with insights that help you understand your thoughts and emotions. With guided journal prompts, you’ll dive deeper and
bluejetty:00151200:ios.description:
Pillowtalk makes journaling easy, fun, and totally private. Just talk or type to vent—Pillowtalk’s AI gets you, replying with insights that help you understand your thoughts and emotions. With guided journal prompts, you’ll dive deeper and figure out what makes you, you.
*****
“I love using Pillowtalk in the mornings to record my dreams! Its AI insights are super useful for finding patterns in my thinking and journal entries.”
— Amy
AI FEEDBACK TO LEVEL UP YOUR SELF-AWARENESS
Explore your thoughts with conversational AI designed to help you unpack emotions, relationships, and patterns in your behavior. Whether you’re journaling dreams, managing stress, or creating mindfulness habits, Pillowtalk is your personal journal here to help you live with clarity and purpose.
WHY WE CREATED PILLOWTALK
Pillowtalk was born from a personal journey. Our co-founder, Belen, struggled with anxiety and sleep disorders in the chaos of modern life. Journaling became her safe space—helping her stress less, organize her thoughts, and spark creativity.
We built Pillowtalk to share those benefits with you. It’s a private, easy-to-use journal designed to help you unwind, reflect, grow, and bring back balance to your life.
YOUR ALL-IN-ONE JOURNALING COMPANION
Record & Transcribe
Talk or type your private journal entries—Pillowtalk’s AI supports transcripts in 99+ languages.
AI Feedback That Gets You
Connect the dots between your feelings, behaviors, and dreams with meaningful journal insights.
Dream Analysis
Decode your dream journals with AI and uncover the personal meaning behind them.
Your Safe Space
Journal in a private, judgment-free space that’s all about you.
Know Yourself Better
Boost your emotional intelligence and reflect on what makes you unique—your strengths, values, and resilience.
Track Progress
Build positive journaling habits with weekly streaks, guided journal prompts, and AI feedback that helps you grow.
Sleep Soundly
Wind down with tools designed to reduce stress and improve sleep, including dream journaling, mindfulness, and CBT-based techniques.
RESEARCH-BASED GUIDED PROMPTS
Personal, conversational journaling questions based on proven techniques like DBT, ACT, and mindfulness make journaling easier:
• Discover Purpose: Reflect on what matters to you.
• Overcome Challenges: Process emotions and situations with AI guided reflection.
• Boost Emotional Intelligence: Understand yourself deeply with AI journal insights
• Practice Gratitude: Embrace the warmth around you.
• Unlock Creativity: Capture and explore your ideas through journaling
• Sleep Better: Let go of worries and unwind before sleep.
• Find Peace: Stay grounded in the present.
PRIVACY YOU CAN COUNT ON
We believe your thoughts are yours and yours alone. That’s why:
• Locally Stored: Your private journal entries stay on your device and are never used for AI training.
• No Ads, No Data Selling: Ever.
• Password and Face ID Protected: Your personal journal stays locked and secure.
• Encrypted: Your data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (min TLS 1.2).
HELLO FROM BROOKLYN
Pillowtalk is a journal built by founders Belen and Cherri, who are passionate about design, creativity, mental health, AI, and self-discovery. Our mission is to help you unlock your inner world and bring balance to your life—one journal entry at a time.
