bluejetty:00070432:ios.description:
Knitting is a method by which yarn is manipulated to create a textile or fabric; it is used in many types of garments.
Knitting Master puzzle will give you best simulation of knitting beautiful and eye catching designs. Stitch and yarn combines to form a challenging puzzle game. Knitting Master is the best app to learn the knitting technique. Knits are combine to form a perfect design.
Knitting Master has the best knitting simulation effect on for mobile, Tablets screens. x-stitches of different colors combine to form best knitting designs.
The quality of the knits and stitches are very high to produce HD design as an end product.
How To Play:
- Click on the stitches at the bottom and different point on the designs will be highlighted.
- Select the stitch which needs to be placed at current needle's point.

- If you sewing the wrong color stitch then you need to cut that stitch by Scissor Button on the right bottom of the design.

Features:
- Beautiful Knitting Patterns
- Cross Stitch Designs
- Sewing
- Needle Craft
- Frame Stitch Line
If you love knitting/sewing then Knitting Master is the best fit for you. Just Download it now and start creating new designs by knitting technique.

bluejetty:00043689:ios.description:
Escape Game Christmas at Junk Mountain 
Welcome to Junk Mountain, a place on the outskirts of town. 
Today, there's a Christmas party scheduled to take place. 
However, due to the clumsiness of the residents, it's been quite a challenge to get the party started. 
Would you like to help us ensure that the Christmas party gets underway?
Square Head Factory 2023 Winter New Escape Game
Features:
• This escape game is themed around Christmas and features a short storybook-like narrative.
• It's recommended for those who love stuffed animals, robots, and enjoy a cute atmosphere.
• Enjoy a visually stunning escape game with 3D CG graphics.
• Recommended for those who love escape games and a cute atmosphere.
• While there's only one ending, you might not want to escape after all?
• When you get stuck, there are hints and answers available, making it suitable for escape game beginners.
• In some areas, you can use the screenshot function. You can save up to two screenshots.
• A memo pad feature has been added. Please make use of it in conjunction with the screenshot function.
How to Play:
• You can play the game for free until the end.
• The game is operated with taps only.
• Hints and answers are available, making it suitable for beginners.
• The game includes an auto-save feature.
• Select an item with one tap and tap on the place you want to use it to use the item.
• Double-tap an item to see its enlarged image.
• Some items can be combined when using them in the opened state of the enlarged item.
Regarding Advertisements:
• The production of this app is supported by ad revenue. Thank you for your understanding.
Sound Materials:
• DOVA-SYNDROME
• OtoLogic: https://otologic.jp/
• Sound Effect Lab: https://soundeffect-lab.info/
• Yufuruka: https://wingless-seraph.net/

bluejetty:00127708:ios.name: Translate AI- Voice Translator
bluejetty:00127708:ios.summary: Translate AI makes communication across languages easier, wherever life takes you. Whether you're exploring a new city, studying, working with international colleagues, or keeping in touch with friends, understand messages and express yours
bluejetty:00127708:ios.description:
Translate AI makes communication across languages easier, wherever life takes you. Whether you're exploring a new city, studying, working with international colleagues, or keeping in touch with friends, understand messages and express yourself in other languages.
Go beyond word-for-word translation. Translate AI helps you explore meaning, tone, and pronunciation so you can feel more confident about what you read, write, and say. Type, speak, translate text around you, or use Conversation Mode to talk with someone in another language.
Communicate with confidence
Translate messages, study material, travel information, and work text. Automatic language detection and quick switching make moving between languages simple. AI Insights adds examples, synonyms, dictionary entries, tone suggestions, and pronunciation tips. Copy, share, listen to, or bookmark results to use again.
Speak and listen
Use voice input when typing isn't convenient, and hear results with text-to-speech. Choose a voice and adjust playback speed, whether you're practicing a phrase or following spoken words.
Understand the world around you
Read menus, signs, and documents in your language. With Pro, translate photos from your camera or gallery, scan text live on supported devices, and translate PDF pages, including scanned documents with OCR. Crop images to focus on the text you need, then save or share the result.
Have a more natural conversation
Conversation Mode lets you talk in two languages. Use Manual mode for control, or hands-free Auto mode, which listens to one language at a time and switches after a pause. Pause, end, or start new conversations and revisit them in History. Tabletop and book layouts are available on supported devices.
Keep useful translations close
Search History, revisit conversations, bookmark helpful translations, and remove items you no longer need.
Translate offline — Pro
Download language models to translate text without an internet connection, useful when traveling or saving mobile data.
Languages
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Thai, Vietnamese, Dutch, Greek, Hebrew, Turkish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Polish, Romanian, Czech, Finnish, Hungarian, Malay, Indonesian, Filipino, Ukrainian, Bengali, Tamil, and more.
Free & Pro
The free version includes 5 text translations per day (up to ~500 characters each), 3 voice inputs per day, and 5 turns per conversation. Pro removes these limits and unlocks photo, PDF, live scanner, and offline translation.
Subscription Information
Pro is available as weekly, monthly, or yearly auto-renewable subscriptions, or as a non-renewing one-day pass (24 hours of Pro access). Prices are shown in the app and may vary by region.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. If a free trial is offered, you'll be charged when it ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours beforehand. Any unused portion of a trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > your Apple ID > Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription. Refunds are handled by Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com.
Privacy Policy: https://maximaapps.com/translate-ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://maximaapps.com/translate-ai/terms_of_use

Welcome to Girls Nail Salon: Paint Polish, a colorful and creative nail-art game where every manicure becomes a tiny masterpiece!
Step into your very own virtual nail salon and discover a fun world filled with beautiful colors, sparkling glitter, stylish polish, magical unicorn themes, and eye-catching rainbow designs. Whether you love elegant manicures, bright party nails, cute fantasy styles, or bold acrylic looks, this nail salon game gives you plenty of ways to express your creativity.
Become a talented virtual nail artist and create a new look whenever inspiration strikes. Experiment with different polish colors, decorate acrylic nails, explore gel-style finishes, add glittering details, and bring playful nail-art ideas to life. There is no need to worry about making mistakes—simply try another design and continue creating until your manicure looks exactly the way you imagined.

Turn ordinary nails into stunning nail art designs in your own virtual nail salon game! Choose from trendy colors, stylish patterns, and professional nail tools to create beautiful manicures. Try cute, simple looks or go bold with glitter nails, acrylic nails, gel polish, and 3D nail art designs. From soft pastel styles to eye-catching fashion nails, every design is a new creative experience.

Mix and match styles to create salon-quality manicures inspired by real nail spa games and beauty salon makeovers. Whether you love elegant French tips, shiny chrome nails, or trendy aesthetic nail art, you can design it all in your virtual salon.

Try popular themes like kawaii nails, princess nails, fairy nails, butterfly nails, and cute aesthetic styles. Experiment with bright colors, sparkles, and stickers to make every manicure unique.
PLAY & CREATE ANYWHERE
Enjoy a relaxing and fun offline nail salon game anytime, anywhere. No internet needed! Perfect for kids, girls, and anyone who loves makeover games, fashion games, and beauty salon games. Create endless nail designs and improve your creativity with every session.

Create realistic acrylic nail art designs
Explore hundreds of nail polish colors & styles

Design unicorn, rainbow & kawaii nail themes
Enjoy relaxing beauty salon makeover gameplay
Perfect for fans of nail art games & fashion games

bluejetty:00099469:ios.description:
"Forget everything you know about parking games—Parking Jam Out flips the genre on its head with strategic twists, chaotic fun, and loads of new gameplay mechanics that leave the usual boring parking puzzles in the dust.
Sure, you’ll still slide cars to escape the lot… but now you’ll have to outsmart trigger walls, dodge around massive tanker trucks, deal with unpredictable dozers, and more! Every level is a fresh challenge packed with clever mechanics that force you to think ahead and adapt your moves on the fly.
Why Parking Jam Out Stands Out:
▶ Innovative gameplay mechanics – trigger walls, moving obstacles, special vehicles, and more!
▶ Deep strategy – planning your moves matters more than ever.
▶ Huge variety of levels – no two puzzles feel the same.
▶ Outsmart the jam – slide cars, activate mechanisms, and escape tight spots.
Key Features:
▶ Tons of exclusive gameplay elements that add real depth and excitement.
▶ Strategic puzzles that get progressively more complex—never boring, always fresh.
▶ Satisfying car-sorting and parking chaos with a funny, colorful style.
▶ Offline play – enjoy the full experience anytime, anywhere.
Whether you love tricky puzzles or wild logic challenges, Parking Jam Out delivers a fast-paced, brain-tickling experience that’s way more than just parking.
DOWNLOAD NOW and escape the jam in the most strategic, feature-packed puzzle game on the road!"

bluejetty:00134258:ios.description:
If you like to break cars in the trash, then you are here! RCC game - Real Car Crash Online is 3D demolition crash simulator where engine damage is shown at ultimate level. Exciting missions, large locations, collisions with bots, jumping from a ramp are waiting for you. Become a professional driver, pass extreme crash tests, tune and upgrade parts, earn experience of realistic destruction.
ONLINE GAMES WITH FRIENDS ONLINE
Play crash test online with your friends. Destroy cars in real time! Stunning locations, extreme destruction, online chat with rivals around the world.
Get action in multiplayer!
COOL CARS
Collect & test for durability over 30 legendary vehicles of different classes: from old machines to new supercars, from simple russian vaz to a sports lambo. Tune and upgrade parts: engine, suspension, drive, tires and body metal to smash everyone!
EXCITING GAME MODES
• Explore open locations, jump, drive, drift, break everything to unlock new autos and upgrade them, but be careful, we have set many traps for you on the map!
• Noob or pro? Pass difficult tests and complete interesting missions!
• Derby mode - destroy your rivals until they smash you! You can choose the number of enemies by yourself!
• Send your vehicle to the fly from a mega ramp, gain maximum speed so that your car jumps as far as possible and does more damage!
DESTRUCTION SIMULATOR IN YOUR PHONE
Realistic graphics and 3D physics of body damage. Wreck your vehicle and watch it disassembly! The hood, doors, trunk and even wheels fall off from it! Enjoy a crash test wherever you are: on a plane, train, at school or at work.
We track the feedback on our game RCC - Real Car Crash Online to make it better. We will be glad to see your destructive ideas and wishes for the game in the reviews or by mail: crashtimecontact@gmail.com

bluejetty:00029771:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00029771:ios.description:
Make every outdoor adventure weatherproof!
With the bergfex Weather App, you’ll always have precise weather forecasts for over 350,000 locations throughout Europe right at your fingertips. Our app offers hyper-local forecasts, mountain and valley weather, rain radar, and many other features to ensure you’re perfectly prepared for your outdoor experiences.
Download the bergfex: weather & rain radar app now – the smart weather app for everyone who loves being outdoors!
PRECISE WEATHER DATA FOR ALL OF EUROPE
The bergfex Weather App delivers accurate forecasts for more than 350,000 locations across Europe. Thanks to multiple updates per hour, you’ll always stay well-informed.
YOUR FAVORITE LOCATIONS AT A GLANCE
In our Weather & Rain Radar App, you can add cities, places, and even mountains as favorites, making it even easier to keep an eye on the weather. With the favorites view, you’ll always know how the weather is developing in your key spots.
COMPREHENSIVE FORECASTS FOR YOUR LOCATION
Get 9-day forecasts with all the details: temperature, wind, chance of precipitation, snow levels, sunshine duration, moon phases, as well as sunrise and sunset times. You’ll always be up to date on local weather conditions.
WEATHER WIDGET FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
The customizable widget gives you a daily or hourly forecast for your location – perfect for checking the current weather at a glance, without even opening the app.
PRECIPITATION MAPS & WEBCAMS
Use up-to-date precipitation maps for all of Europe to spot approaching weather fronts early. Over 9,500 webcams provide live insights into weather and snow conditions at around 6,000 locations across Europe.
MOUNTAIN & VALLEY WEATHER
With separate forecasts for mountain and valley, you get exactly the information you need – whether you’re planning a summit climb, a hut tour, or a drive through the mountains. Plan more reliably and weatherproof.
_____________________
TRY ALL PRO FEATURES FREE FOR 3 DAYS, NO STRINGS ATTACHED
• Detailed short-term forecasts
• Animated weather radar with preview function
• Webcam archive with 14-day history, including time-lapse
• Forecast and lightning activity maps
• Precise weather data from over 1,600 weather stations
• Regional text forecasts for Austria and Germany
• Ad-free experience
_____________________
ANY QUESTIONS?
If you have any questions or feedback about our app, send us an email at: app@bergfex.at

Privacy Policy: bergfex.com/c/datenschutz/

Welcome to Garden Dream Life!!
Let's make the happiest garden the world has ever known!
How to Play
Collect the flower piece scattered throughout the levels.
Match 3 flowers of the same color to make them disappear.
If you match 4 or more of a kind, a special item appears! You can clear loads of flowers with it.

Use the Settings menu to turn notifications on or off!

If you don't save the game in the settings menu, you won't be able to restore your game data if you delete the app.
If the game is deleted, the data will be reset. Save your game before you delete the app.
If you change phones, your data will be reset. Save your game before changing phones.
This game includes interstitial, banner, and reward advertisements.
Features
Free-to-play
You can play offline, no internet access required
Many levels to play though
Easy to use controls

Book accommodation, check in online, open your room door – your app for everything!
With over 40 hostels in more than 30 cities, a&o is Europe’s largest hostel provider, offering affordable and centrally located accommodations in the most popular cities. Available room categories include single, double, family, and dorm rooms. Backpackers, business travelers, couples, families, and larger groups such as school classes or clubs will find the right bed or room here—equipped with a private bathroom with shower/toilet, hairdryer, and toiletries. There’s also free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the building, as well as 24/7 service and a snack bar that’s open at all times.

a&o – everyone can travel

Booking: Whether a bed or a room – select your desired city and easily book your affordable and centrally located accommodation on the go at the best a&o price!
Check-in: Skip the trip to the front desk! You can check in on your own—no waiting, just a few clicks, starting 24 hours in advance.
Open the door: Say goodbye to room keys. With the app, you can open your room door. Turn on Bluetooth, hold your smartphone up to the lock, tap, and you’re done!

bluejetty:00096807:ios.description:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.
Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.
Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.
Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

bluejetty:00178231:ios.description:
With 121tribe, you’ll enjoy a variety of expertly curated weekly meal plans, each designed to help you achieve specific wellness goals – from boosting energy and reducing inflammation to improving sleep and mental clarity. 
Whether you’re just starting your plant-based journey or looking to deepen your commitment, our app is your trusted partner in embracing a healthier, more vibrant way of living.
Each week, we launch a fresh, themed meal plan packed with easy-to-follow, no-waste recipes. From your personalized grocery list to step-by-step meal prep videos, we make it effortless to stay organized, save time, and enjoy delicious, wholesome meals throughout the week. 
Beyond food, our app connects you with a thriving community of like-minded individuals for support, motivation, and shared growth. Plus, our expert-led online camps provide the extra boost you need to stay inspired and focused on your goals.

VARIETY OF PLANT-BASED MEAL PLANS.
Explore new weekly plans tailored to specific health benefits, ensuring variety and balanced nutrition.
EFFORTLESS MEAL PREP. 
Follow guided video sessions to prepare meals for the week, saving time and staying organized.
SMART GROCERY LIST GENERATOR. 
Quickly create a grocery list based on your chosen plan and number of days.
NO-WASTE PHILOSOPHY. 
Minimize food waste while saving money and supporting the planet.
ENRICHING ACTIVITIES. 
Enjoy theme-based extras like mindfulness practices or challenges to complement your plan.
COMMUNITY SUPPORT. 
Join a vibrant chat space to connect with others, share experiences, and stay motivated.
EXPERT-LED ONLINE CAMPS. 
Periodic team-based programs with focused themes to supercharge your plant-based journey.
FREE TRIAL.
Find a meal plan that resonates with you and try it for free. See for yourself how just one week of plant-based living can be truly life-changing.
Start your free trial today!

bluejetty:00073936:ios.name: Boondocking at Walmart Stores
bluejetty:00073936:ios.summary:
This app shows Walmart locations throughout the US. and Canada, with over 2,800 specifically designated as Overnight Permitted. 
Bonus! Also included along with Walmart locations are Sam’s Clubs, Cabela’s Stores, and RV-Friendly casinos f
bluejetty:00073936:ios.description:
This app shows Walmart locations throughout the US. and Canada, with over 2,800 specifically designated as Overnight Permitted. 
Bonus! Also included along with Walmart locations are Sam’s Clubs, Cabela’s Stores, and RV-Friendly casinos for a total of over 6,000 locations!
The data is crowdsourced, including comments on many locations, and whether or not the a location allows overnight boondocking. This will make it easier for you to find a location that allows free overnight camping and boondocking.
Features:
- No subscription! Just a one-time purchase.
- Location database is included with the app, so all locations are visible when offline.
- Database is updated monthly, subject to user submissions.
- Filter what type of locations to display. For example, either Overnight allowed, No Overnight Allowed, or all locations.
- Show a route between your location and the selected location.
- View the locations in list view; easily search the list.
- Get the local weather for the location.
- A Google street view of each location is provided.
- Set a location as a Favorite for later reference.
- Internet searches and more for each location.
- Import routes from GPX files. This makes it much easier to find locations along a route you've created in another app such as Road Trip Planner.
- Send a location to our app Road Trip Planner. This helps in routing your travels (requires separate purchase of the Road Trip Planner app).
We want to improve our database as much as possible, so we have made it easy for you to submit a new location - simply tap the + button below the map. To correct or update a location, tap “Location Comment” in the detail view. We will be updating the database often.
Due to the nature of the locations changing their status it's recommended you contact the establishment prior to arriving to ensure overnight boondocking is allowed.
Modesitt Software, the app developer, is not affiliated with or sponsored by in any way with Walmart or any other establishment.

bluejetty:00183025:ios.name: Classic Spades Card Game
bluejetty:00183025:ios.summary:
Classic Spades Card Game — play Spades offline against computer players.
No internet required. No sign-up. Enjoy a clean, classic Spades card game with partnership or solo play, flexible rules, adjustable difficulty, stats, hand review and
bluejetty:00183025:ios.description:
Classic Spades Card Game — play Spades offline against computer players.
No internet required. No sign-up. Enjoy a clean, classic Spades card game with partnership or solo play, flexible rules, adjustable difficulty, stats, hand review and replays.
Whether you are learning Spades or already know the game well, Classic Spades gives you a focused offline card game built for quick games, repeated play and steady improvement.
Why you’ll like Classic Spades
• Play Spades offline
• No account or sign-up required
• Partnership or Solo Spades
• Easy, Medium and Hard computer players
• Nil and Blind Nil options
• Optional Blind Nil card passing
• Optional Jokers
• Bag / sandbag rules
• 10 for 200 option
• Mercy Rule option
• Multiple win targets
• Stats tracking
• Review and replay completed hands
• Show starting hands option
• Optional four-color deck
• Deck and card back choices
• Portrait and landscape support
Choose your rules
Set up Spades your way with flexible options:
• Game type: Partnership or Solo
• Blind Nil: off, on, or with card passing
• Jokers: on or off
• Bag penalty: on or off
• 10 for 200: on or off
• Mercy Rule: on or off
• Win target: 300, 500, 750 or 1000
• Show starting hands: never, from review, or always 
• Replay hands after each round
Classic Spades gameplay
Each hand starts with players bidding the number of tricks they expect to win. Follow suit if you can, play a trump card when you cannot, and try to make your bid while managing bags and avoiding penalties.
Spades cannot be led until they are broken. Nil and Blind Nil bids add extra risk and reward, while optional Jokers, bag rules and scoring options let you play the way you prefer.
Built for comfortable play
Classic Spades is designed to be easy to read and quick to play, with clear cards, smooth controls, adjustable speed, optional four-color suits, deck choices, portrait and landscape support, and completed-hand replays.
Play offline anytime — no internet, no sign-up, just Spades.

bluejetty:00062195:ios.description:
Listening and Speaking are the most important skills in English. English Listening - Daily is a useful and practical app that helps you to build your listening and speaking skill by practicing English daily. 
Besides, in every lesson, there is accompany script, vocabulary sheet as well as quizzes for you to take so that you can remember well the new words.
FEATURES:
• Learn English everyday with daily listening lesson
• Learn English by levels, topics, or hear short English audio with "English in one minute" program
• Record yourself speaking English & listen to your recordings
• Take Vocabulary & Comprehension quiz to understand and remember well the new words in each lesson
• English conversation with the voices of speakers from around the world
• Huge amount of audio content on various topics like Work, Leisure, Shopping, Food, etc. that is update daily
• Commonly-used English phrases & vocabularies
• Easy to store and manage your favorite items
• Daily reminder to develop and keep a daily listening habit
• Pretty UI, simple and user-friendly
* Easy to use, easy to understand, easy to practice!
* Improve quickly listening skills, gain more useful and practical English
On top of this, the app is free for you to download, and the content is all free also.
Let's download the app and practice English listening daily. You will see your listening skill improve significantly in a short time.
Feel free to send us any feedbacks, remarks to cs.tksoft@gmail.com so that the app can support you better in next versions :)
Happy learning English!
support@tksoft.com
====================================================
Speaking is the hardest skill for English learners to improve because you need to find someone who can correct your mistakes and tell you how to improve.
From version 2.0, you can start recording yourself speaking English and listening to the recording. This will help you to hear your mistake and correct them. Be your own teacher and improve your speaking skill daily!
Love hearing your feedbacks to continuously make the app better!

Earn rewards by completing simple tasks! Share an opinion or take photos in and around your city to help your community and earn rewards in your spare time!
Premise is a task marketplace app that helps you earn rewards for simple tasks. Take surveys, share local information like construction zones or the price of milk, and share pictures of your city to earn top rewards. Making rewards with Premise really is that simple.
Premise’s tasks feature local questions and surveys relevant to your city. Get rewards for sharing information important to you and the people in your neighborhood – it’s like getting rewarded for doing a public service!
Premise’s task marketplace is always growing, which means there are tasks for everyone. Earn rewards every day by sharing your local knowledge as a Premise Contributor.
Take surveys, share local information and earn rewards with Premise – download now!
PREMISE FEATURES
MAP YOUR COMMUNITY
- Get rewards while you capture what’s happening in your community.
- Earn rewards for sharing insights that reflect your reality, your thoughts and your community.
- Make real rewards for sharing information relevant to your city, from traffic jams to local events to supermarket sales.
EARN REAL REWARDS
- Earn rewards from tasks and photos.
- Choose tasks that fit your lifestyle based on how much time you have.
- Earn more when you do more!
SHARE YOUR OPINION
- Get rewarded for your insights - your opinion matters.
- Surveys for organizations and community leaders that value your feedback.
- Premise makes it easy to capture and share your thoughts.
MAKE AN IMPACT
- Earn real rewards by sharing real data to drive real change.
- Join Premise’s growing network of thousands of Contributors around the world.
- Complete tasks every day to help make policies, products or services better for everyone.
Earn rewards by sharing local information, your opinions and survey answers with Premise today!
Task availability is based on the needs of organizations we are working with and can change frequently.
Thank you for being a Premise Contributor!
Need help? E-mail support@premise.com
Learn more about being a Premise Contributor: www.premise.com/contributors

bluejetty:00100037:ios.description:
Career decisions are hard when teens haven’t had enough exposure to what different careers are actually like.
Ambition gives high school students a low-pressure way to explore careers before they’re expected to choose a major, training program, or career path. Instead of reading long career guides or taking another personality test, teens get to try short, interactive virtual internships right from their phone.
-- See What Careers Are Really Like
Each internship is broken into bite-sized days with videos, real-world scenarios, quizzes, reflections, and hands-on activities. Teens learn how people in different careers think, solve problems, and approach their work.
-- Explore Without the Pressure to Choose
The goal isn’t to make teens pick a career. It’s to give them enough exposure to start forming opinions: That sounds interesting. That definitely isn’t for me. I want to learn more about this.
Ambition includes paths across healthcare, business, technology, engineering, education, creative fields, and more.
-- Designed to Keep Teens Engaged
Internship days are short enough to fit into their day, interactive instead of lecture-heavy, and built around progress they can see. Teens can complete one day and stop or keep going when something catches their interest.
Parents can also create agreements that let teens work toward rewards they actually care about — from extra freedom or time off chores to tickets, purchases, or other family-decided rewards.
-- Give Parents a Window Into What They’re Exploring
Parents and other trusted adults can see which careers their teen has tried, follow their internship activity, and track progress toward goals without having to constantly ask what they’re doing.
-- Turn Exploration Into Real Conversations
Ambition also provides guided conversations that go beyond “What do you want to be?” Families can talk through things like income, lifestyle, work-life balance, education, priorities, independence, and what the teen actually wants adulthood to look like.
Your teen doesn’t need to have their future figured out. They just need opportunities to start exploring it.
Ambition is built for high school students and the adults helping them prepare for life after high school.
Stay ambitious!
Questions or feedback? Contact us at info@theambitionapp.com

bluejetty:00130826:ios.description:
Heart Rate Monitor, the most accurate app to measure your heart rate and pulse. Just put your fingertip on camera to get your heartbeat within a few seconds. No medical heart rate monitors required! Get Heart Rate Monitor now to embrace a healthy heart!
· Just use your phone - no dedicated device needed!
· In-depth analysis with waveform graphs
· CSV export available to print 
· Health knowledge and insights by experts
· Protect your privacy safely: Locally / iCloud / Apple Health
· Sync data with Apple Health
- How to use it?
Gently cover the back camera lens with one fingertip and stay still, you will get your heart rate after several seconds. For accurate measurement, stay in a bright place or turn on the flashlight.
- Is it accurate?
Our App uses the camera of your phone to capture the image and uses algorithms to recognize the heartbeat. The accuracy is ensured by comprehensive and professional experiments.
- How often to use it?
For accurate measurement, use it several times a day especially when you wake up in the morning, go to bed and finish workouts.
- What is a normal heart rate?
According to American Heart Association and the Mayo Clinic, a normal resting heartbeat for adults ranges from 60 to 100 bpm. But it can be affected by many factors such as stress, fitness level, medication use, etc. 
DISCLAIMER
· Heart Rate Monitor - Pulse App should not be used as a medical device in the diagnose of heart diseases.
· Heart Rate Monitor - Pulse App is not intended for a medical emergency. Consult your primary care physician if you need any help.
· In some devices, Heart Rate Monitor - Pulse App may make the LED flash very hot.
Subscription Terms and Details
- The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Privacy Policy: https://heartrate.akrura.ltd/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://heartrate.akrura.ltd/terms.html

bluejetty:00016999:ios.description:
Psychic Question instantly connects you to an available, live psychic and spiritual advisor. You can get answers on questions regarding your love life, relationships, career, future, and anything else that might be calling for your attention. Our advisors specialize in intuitive psychic readings, tarot readings, fortune telling, astrology, medium-ship, spiritual advice, coaching and more...
App Features:
- Live psychic readings anytime you need – connect with a real, live fortune teller or spiritual advisor with the option of 3-FREE psychic reading chat minutes with 3 new psychics.
- Willing, patient, compassionate readers who’ll answer any question
- Tarot, astrology, past life, medium ship and spirituality experts offering answers and wisdom about your current situation
- Array of world-class psychic readers who’ll meet your changing needs
- Reader bios with unedited client reviews and ratings, so you can choose the right one for you.
Live Personal Advice:
* Psychic and spiritual experts are available anytime you need guidance. Get live, personal readings straight on your phone.
* Psychic advisors offer advice on your love life & relationships, career & finances, dream analysis, paranormal occurrences and more.
* Free Psychic Readings: Your first question is always completely free of charge. You get the first 3 minutes for free with 3 new psychics. If you like your advisor, you can choose to continue your session on a paid basis.
Why using our app?
- Online spiritual advisors offering numerous specialties
- Unedited ratings and reviews by clients
- 3 million+ clients, 95% satisfaction rate
- Detailed psychic readers profiles listing expertise areas
- Free Psychic Readings - You get the first 3 minutes for free with 3 new psychics
- Satisfaction guaranteed

bluejetty:00127129:ios.summary:
Discover your body’s rhythm with a scientifically based fertility tracker designed to help you plan or avoid pregnancy naturally.
Simply enter the first day of your last period, and the app predicts your next period, ovulation day, and the
bluejetty:00127129:ios.description:
Discover your body’s rhythm with a scientifically based fertility tracker designed to help you plan or avoid pregnancy naturally.
Simply enter the first day of your last period, and the app predicts your next period, ovulation day, and the most fertile and least fertile days of your cycle.
With Apple Health sync, your data stays automatically updated across all your Apple devices — so your fertility insights are always with you.
* Scientifically Backed Methods *
Our app includes two baby gender prediction methods:
 • Popular Method – a theoretical approach based on the well-known theory by Landrum Shettles, which suggests that the timing within the fertile window may influence the baby’s gender.
 • Scientific Method – a statistical, research-based approach developed by Rodrigo Guerrero, grounded in large-scale data from thousands of women.
You can switch between them anytime in Settings.
Please note: both methods provide probabilistic insights, not guaranteed results.
* Full Version Features *
Unlock deeper insights with the full version:
 • Daily pregnancy probability for any selected date.
 • Gender prediction probabilities for each fertile day.
 • Overall fertility chances during your current cycle.
 • Automatic Apple Health sync between devices.
* How It Works *
To create your personal fertility calendar, simply provide:
 • The first day of your last period.
 • Your average cycle length.
 • Your luteal phase length (default works for most users).
Ideal for women with regular cycles — but also reliable for estimating ovulation using your average cycle length.
* Empower Your Reproductive Journey *
Whether you’re trying to conceive or prefer natural birth control, this app provides clarity, accuracy, and peace of mind — backed by science and made even smarter with Apple Health integration.
Disclaimer: This app is intended for informational and educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making decisions related to contraception, fertility, or pregnancy. Accuracy may vary depending on individual factors.

bluejetty:00155941:ios.description:
The Citizens Bank Now is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with The Citizens Bank Now:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the The Citizens Bank Now app, you must be enrolled as a Citizens Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Turn Venice into a playlist of must-do moments—powered by AI.

Pin must-see attractions and rearrange on the fly. Need a last-minute tweak? Ask the AI to reshuffle around tide charts, crowd levels, or sunset photo ops—no spreadsheets required.
-----
Whether you’re a first-timer or a seasoned visitor, our AI-enhanced guide turns Venice into a personalized adventure—no restaurant listings, no hotel clutter, just pure must-do magic. Download now and build the trip that’s 100 % you!

bluejetty:00041398:ios.description:
No complicated steps. No hassle.
Quick to log, easy to keep going — even if you usually give up.
Fuel Record is a super simple car log app to track fuel, mileage, and cost — effortlessly.
● Key Features
- Dead simple logging. Faster than scanning receipts, with no complicated steps.
- Clear, easy-to-read charts that show changes in fuel economy, mileage, and fuel costs at a glance.
- Yearly, quarterly, and monthly summaries to easily see seasonal trends.
- Unlimited vehicles. Manage as many cars or motorcycles as you like.
● Perfect for You If You…
- Couldn’t keep up with car logs in the past.
- End up abandoning tracking apps halfway through.
- Want something simple, without unnecessary features.
- Just want an easy way to log — nothing more.
- Don’t want to deal with detailed settings or manual calculations.
● Additional Features
- Supports fuel economy units: mpg, mi/L, km/L, L/100km
- Notes feature for maintenance records like oil changes or tire replacements
● Why I Built Fuel Record
I wanted an app that’s easy to enter data into, automatically turns it into clean, readable charts, and lets you see what you need instantly. If you’re looking for a car log app that’s simple, clear, and easy to stick with, Fuel Record is made for you.
■■ Paid Upgrades: Backup Version
- Enables cloud backup
- Removes all ads
■■ Paid Upgrades: Ad-Free Version

Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
● Manage or Cancel Your Subscription
You can manage or cancel your subscription from:
- The “Manage Subscription” option in the app, or
- Your Apple ID account settings in the App Store
● Important Notes
- Subscriptions cannot be canceled by any other means.
- No refunds are provided for unused portions of the subscription period.
- Turning off auto-renew allows access until the end of the current billing period.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.

bluejetty:00126850:ios.name: Minha Estácio
bluejetty:00126850:ios.summary: Sabe aquele App que te ajuda na sua jornada acadêmica do começo ao fim? Pois é, o App Minha Estácio é assim! Ele é tipo um portal mágico que te conecta com os principais assuntos da faculdade de um jeito super prático, além de ser levinho e
bluejetty:00126850:ios.description:
Sabe aquele App que te ajuda na sua jornada acadêmica do começo ao fim? Pois é, o App Minha Estácio é assim! Ele é tipo um portal mágico que te conecta com os principais assuntos da faculdade de um jeito super prático, além de ser levinho e quase não ocupar espaço no celular.
Saca só tudo o que você pode fazer:
· Estude de qualquer lugar!
Pelo App você pode acessar a Sala de Aula Virtual (SAVA) para estudar todo o conteúdo digital das suas disciplinas e continuar de onde parou, só com um clique. Além disso, você também acessa conteúdos complementares, trabalhos, avaliações e exercícios. Incrível, né?
· Controle suas mensalidades ($)
É isso mesmo: pelo App você também pode gerir e controlar todas as mensalidades do seu curso, sem burocracias!
· Quer mais? O App tem!
Além de tudo isso que você acabou de descobrir, no App você também acessa informações acadêmicas como calendário, histórico escolar, notas de provas e manuais, e também pode renovar sua matrícula, abrir requerimentos, agendar atendimentos presenciais, atualizar seus dados e acessar sua tão querida carteirinha de estudante! Uau!
O mais importante de tudo? A segurança é total! Pra acessar o App é só usar seu login de estudante da Estácio, o mesmo que você usa para entrar na Sala de Aula Virtual. Assim, ninguém mexe nas suas coisas sem autorização!
Curtiu? Então bora!
Se você já estuda na Estácio, baixe o App agora mesmo, comece a aproveitar tudo que ele tem a oferecer e fique por dentro de todas as atualizações!
Ah, e se você ainda não estuda na Estácio, acesse nosso site (https://estacio.br/) e confira todos os cursos incríveis de Graduação e Pós-Graduação que a gente oferece! #vempraEstácio

• GREEN LANTERN: a compassionate peacemaker who has incredible energy superpowers!

This intriguing mystery game gives you the choice of finding objects or matching gems in a row to advance in a storyline full of twists and turns set amidst the atmos
bluejetty:00129450:ios.description:
FIND HIDDEN OBJECTS OR MATCH GEMS TO SOLVE THE MYSTERY OF THE CARIBBEAN!
This intriguing mystery game gives you the choice of finding objects or matching gems in a row to advance in a storyline full of twists and turns set amidst the atmospheric backdrop of the Caribbean. Choose how to play on a whim: either hidden object or match-3 to please your tastes and interests. Start your mind-boggling sea journey right now!
Brave Captain Aimee, a bird named Virgil and a ragtag crew of flamboyant characters take a swashbuckling voyage through the Caribbean islands to solve Aimee's family mystery. Help them find hidden treasures by blasting through match-3 puzzles or unraveling hidden object scenes, and complete thrilling quests while disrupting the plans of nefarious pirates. They’re after something valuable, but apparently, they need a piece of the mysterious map that Aimee unwittingly has in her family locket – the only thing she has left from her mother. Keep Aimee out of danger, explore port cities and find out the truth about what really happened to Aimee’s parents!
What awaits you in The Hidden Treasures:
Play through gem-matching combinations if you like match-3, or enjoy searching tasks if you are into find and seek games. Change your game mode at any time!
If you’re a hidden object fan:
● Lively scenes to search from top to bottom for hidden objects
● Stunning graphics, charismatic characters and picturesque locations
If you’re a match-3 fan:
● Hundreds of unique match-3 puzzles
● Incredible boosters and power-up combos
You will also enjoy:
● Gripping storyline that always keeps you guessing
● Picturesque locations, charismatic characters and stunning graphics
● Numerous charming collections to piece together
● Absorbing quests to keep you entertained for months
● Your own unique ship to decorate and captain
● Free updates: new quests, remarkable locations and unique bonuses await you every month!
While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
You can play this game even if you’re offline!
Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish.

bluejetty:00086956:ios.summary:
Boost your vocabulary and improve your understanding of te reo Māori with the Ka Piki app!
Sentence structure and grammar can be challenging for learners. Sentences are displayed with visual aids to reinforce correct word order and help co
bluejetty:00086956:ios.description:
Boost your vocabulary and improve your understanding of te reo Māori with the Ka Piki app!
Sentence structure and grammar can be challenging for learners. Sentences are displayed with visual aids to reinforce correct word order and help comprehension.
Daily practice is quick and easy; you can even do a lesson while watching TV—way more fun than flipping through a dictionary, plus it effortlessly fits into your day!
The Ka Piki app's design is inspired by the "input hypothesis" of language acquisition and aims to expose learners to a volume of words and phrases at a rapid pace. The more you hear and understand, the more you will learn!
Designed and built by te reo teachers based in Wellington dedicated to making te reo learning easy and accessible. We are working to continually improve learning content, so watch out for more content and lessons in upcoming releases!

bluejetty:00180089:ios.description:
Use of this app requires an active account for Lexia® English Language Development™. If you do not have a username and password, please contact your school for more information.
About Lexia English Language Development:
Designed specifically for Emergent Bilingual students, also known as ELLs, in grades K–6, Lexia English helps learners acquire higher language proficiency levels of English and supports English language development through academic conversations. Founded on the leading-edge expertise of Lexia, the program blends language learning with subject knowledge to improve academic achievement. From Newcomers to Long-Term English Learners, Lexia English meets all students where they are and targets oral language and grammar skills at a level appropriate for each student’s proficiency. Students progress linguistically and academically at their own pace, thanks to the program’s embedded Speech Recognition Technology that provides immediate, guided, corrective feedback against the backdrop of an encouraging and nonjudgmental environment with respect for heritage culture and language.
Lexia English’s curriculum is aligned with rigorous language proficiency standards including WIDA, CA ELD, TX ELPS, ELPA 21, and NY ESL. Real-time actionable data empower educators to transform instruction, personalize learning for each student, and make data-informed instructional decisions. The program offers additional instructional resources that reinforce students’ online learnings, target individual needs, support and extend lessons, and provide additional opportunities for practice, including writing activities that focus on the same language frames and grammatical conventions that learners are being taught in the program. Continuous progress monitoring offers visibility into student and teacher success and ongoing needs.
About Lexia:
Lexia®, a Cambium Learning Group company, is the Structured Literacy expert. For nearly 40 years, the company has focused solely on literacy, and today provides science-of-reading-based solutions for both students and educators. With robust offerings for differentiated instruction, personalized learning, assessment, and professional learning, Lexia helps more learners read, write, and speak with confidence.

bluejetty:00024724:ios.description:
Does your child love helping in the kitchen? Join dino boy and his animal friends in a colorful cooking adventure filled with fun mini-games, tasty recipes, and creative challenges. 
Children can learn how to prepare four kinds of treats, discover ingredients and kitchen tools, and develop basic cooking skills through play. They can then practice what they have learned in a real kitchen with help from an adult. No third-party advertising.
• Make different kinds of pizza;
• Prepare homemade ice cream;
• Bake tasty cupcakes;
• Learn the names of ingredients and spices;
• Discover different kitchen tools;
• Have fun while learning basic cooking skills.
~~~ Main Features ~~~
~~~ Italian chef ~~~
Play a fun cooking mini-game and prepare a delicious pizza. Feel like a real Italian chef! Choose all the necessary ingredients (vegetables, spices, sauces) and start creating a masterpiece following a special recipe.
~~~ Cupcakes and muffins ~~~
Almost every child has a sweet tooth. In this cooking game, we provide an opportunity for kids to learn how to make their own interesting mini-cakes and colorful cupcakes. Mix the batter, pour it into special molds, bake the cupcakes, and decorate them with cream, berries, and fruit to create your own colorful dessert collection.
~~~ Juices and smoothies ~~~
Nothing is more refreshing on a hot day than a sip of a delicious cold smoothie! Follow the recipe, use the necessary cooking tools and prepare colorful and refreshing drinks. In our application, children will learn how to prepare various juices and milkshakes, and then recreate their favorite drinks at home with help from an adult.
~~~ Ice-cream cones ~~~
Prepare a variety of tasty treats, including pizza, cupcakes, … and even ice cream! Create your own unique taste of ice cream in a glass. Mix different ingredients, add syrups and berries, and create a delicious dessert for anyone who loves sweets.
~~~ Lots of fun and learning ~~~
Play fun cooking games and learn at the same time. Develop your child’s creative skills, encourage their imagination and experiment with colors, ingredients, and decorations!
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. Mini-game "Cupcakes"
2. Mini-game "Cocktails"
3. Mini-game "Ice-cream"
Make your life easier with premium access:
- Try it free for three days. After 3 days, the trial will automatically turn into a weekly paid subscription.
- The paid subscription is available in three plans: weekly, monthly, and yearly.
- A weekly paid subscription costs $9.99. Monthly: $19.99. Yearly: $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy and terms of use:
https://jmhdevelopers.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00167137:ios.name: Phototag: Caption & Hashtag AI
bluejetty:00167137:ios.summary:
Phototag turns a photo, a video or a few words into a ready-to-post caption and hashtags that fit what your post is really about. Copy them and paste into Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook or LinkedIn.
People find posts by their word
bluejetty:00167137:ios.description:
Phototag turns a photo, a video or a few words into a ready-to-post caption and hashtags that fit what your post is really about. Copy them and paste into Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook or LinkedIn.
People find posts by their words. A caption that says what the post is about, plus a handful of specific hashtags, reaches the people looking for that content better than a long list of generic tags. That is what Phototag writes for you.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Get a caption and hashtags from a photo or a video
• Describe a post in a few words and get a caption and hashtags from text
• The 5 most relevant hashtags come preselected, ready to copy
• Pick your platform, and the hashtags are tailored to it
• 22 languages, set separately for the caption and the hashtags
• Choose the caption length, how many hashtags to keep and emoji in the caption
• Not quite right? Regenerate a photo or video result in one tap
• Add your own text before the hashtags, such as a call to action or brand tags
• Clean output: no duplicate, banned or spammy tags
• Send a photo or video to Phototag from the share sheet
• Find past results in History: your last 100, with search, stored on your device
• Open Instagram, TikTok or X right from the result
WHO IT'S FOR
• Creators and small businesses who post every day
• Social media managers running several accounts
• Anyone tired of staring at an empty caption box
FREE AND PRO
Free: 2 photo or video generations and 3 text generations every day. No account needed.
Phototag Pro adds:
• Unlimited generations
• Batch: captions and hashtags for up to 10 photos at once
• Extra context for the AI, such as names, places or the occasion
Phototag Pro is available as a weekly, monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
Photos are processed by AI to write the text and are not stored on our servers. Questions or ideas? Write to us from Settings. We read everything.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pictorai.app/phototag/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00074898:ios.description:
Picadelic effects transform photos and digital art into moving moments of fun.
Your favorite images sparkle with dazzling light effects, colorful particles, and artistic transformations into watercolors, oils, and inks. With a few quick taps, you can refresh a memory to spark a new chat or energize an old one.
Each effect brings its own style and charm. From flowers to fireworks, from smoke to smileys, connected overlays make any image burst with uniqueness and creativity. 
Even your oldest photos will suddenly feel new again. It’s creativity without pressure and a fun way to bring motion back into images you already love.
Create in 3 Easy Steps
Picadelic keeps everything simple.
 1. Pick an effect: Choose from a wide assortment of artistic styles.
 2. Select a photo or artwork: Use your own images, AI art, or digital sketches.
 3. Save or Play: Save instantly, or adjust masks, filters, and reveals until the look feels right.
You can send your creation as a quick message, or save it as a GIF, loop, or video to share anywhere online.
That’s it. No learning curve, no rules. Just a creative break you can enjoy anytime.
Made for Quick Creative Moments
Picadelic fits naturally into your day.
Turn a favorite memory into a moving GIF for a friend. Add motion to an AI artwork before sharing it. Make a quick loop for a moodboard. Drop something fun into a group chat to brighten the conversation.
These aren’t big projects. They’re small creative moments that make you smile.
Instant Creativity
Try different styles, filters, and reveals instantly. There’s no waiting for changes to appear. You see your results as you go, making it easy to explore ideas and find the look that matches your mood.
Save or Share Anywhere
Save your creation as a GIF, Loop, or Live Photo. Share on iMessage, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, or anywhere you like. Each moving moment is yours, made in seconds.
Picadelic VIP
Picadelic VIP unlocks the full collection of motion effects, filters, and styles. Explore new looks, try new ideas, and enjoy updates added regularly. Whether you create for fun, for aesthetic posts, or simply to unwind, VIP gives you the full playground.

bluejetty:00145630:ios.name: RYFT: A Timely Manor
bluejetty:00145630:ios.summary: Welcome to the Nexus Manor. A place that exists outside of time — and in between your ears. RYFT is an audio-based adventure game played with speech commands. Featuring a full voice cast, challenging puzzles, and a compelling narrative, thi
bluejetty:00145630:ios.description:
Welcome to the Nexus Manor. A place that exists outside of time — and in between your ears. RYFT is an audio-based adventure game played with speech commands. Featuring a full voice cast, challenging puzzles, and a compelling narrative, this mystery game is powered by the world's greatest graphics engine: your imagination.
HANDS-FREE TO EXPLORE
- Play any time you'd listen to a podcast: while cooking, cleaning, or commuting!
- Navigate freely using “north,” “east,” “south” and “west” to get around
- Explore rooms and interact with objects
- Pick-up and combine items to solve puzzles
- Chat with a fully voiced cast of eccentric characters as you attempt to solve the mystery of the manor without lifting a finger
- Supports Bluetooth game play
____________________________________________________________________________________
You awake in a strange mansion that exists outside of time. You can’t remember how you got here. In your pocket is a curious stone tablet covered in mysterious symbols. 
As you explore the manor, you encounter its eclectic staff— all of whom seem to be as trapped as you are, working in the service of “The Master.” 
You unearth a series of tapes from a voice you recognize. A girl in trouble. She’s discovered that the Master has a sinister plan she needs to stop, but in order to help her, you must first puzzle your way out of the mansion and back through the doors of time. 
____________________________________________________________________________________
RYFT: A Timely Manor is the first part of the RYFT series. 
For more information visit ryftgame.com 
Find us on Instagram @RYFTgame and on TikTok @RYFTgame

Happy 1ST Anniversary！Jump into the event and score up to 365 pulls packed with excitement!
Welcome to Elias, home of the Squeezy Cheeks!
A place where even if the kingdom explodes tomorrow, people will still be happily munching sweets like, "Eh, whatever."

Dive into a hilariously goofy story and experience the wacky daily life of the Squeezy Cheeks, all in a chill, feel-good vibe.

Deck out your Order with cozy furniture, cute figures, and little maids.
Can't face another day at work? Escape into the world you built and play to your heart's content!

A full Japanese voiceover lineup featuring fan-favorite VAs!
Fully voiced episodes and over-the-top performances that pull you right into this absurd adventure. Let the show begin!

bluejetty:00037665:ios.summary:

Note cards have a front and back for questions and answe
bluejetty:00037665:ios.description:
WinkNotes is an app for making flashcards and planning reviews. Use it for class notes, vocabulary, and practice questions, or import existing materials from PDF, Anki, or CSV files.
Note cards have a front and back for questions and answers. Add text and images, or hide key text and parts of an image to test your recall before revealing the answer. You can also make vocabulary and multiple-choice cards and organize cards into categories.
Sign in to WinkNotes AI with your Apple Account to use AI features. When creating a card, take or pick a photo (on Mac, choose an image from Photos or Files), and AI generates note cards automatically, with the original image attached to the back. On iPhone and iPad running iOS or iPadOS 26 or later, you can also use Shortcuts to turn screenshots or images into cards. If your iPhone has an Action button, you can set it up to start card creation.
Premium Voice reads Chinese and English cards aloud in more natural voices, with several voices to choose from. More languages and voices are on the way.
AI card creation and Premium Voice use credits, which you can buy in the app. PRO members can claim gift credits.
On a Mac running macOS 15 or later, you can connect an AI assistant that supports MCP to help create and organize cards.
The app schedules new cards and reviews using a review plan. Mark whether you remembered or forgot, and it uses that feedback to schedule later reviews. Choose a category or filter your cards when you want to review just part of a deck.
Each deck has statistics showing new, studying, and memorized cards, review streaks, and upcoming reviews. PRO stats also show overdue and often-forgotten cards, retention, and recent review records.
WinkNotes has previously appeared in App Store editorial selections for new apps and weekly editor recommendations. It was also included in features explaining what flashcards are and how to use them, and in a collection of study tools for Mac. bluejetty:00091136:ios.summary:

Wor
bluejetty:00091136:ios.description:
Are you looking for a word puzzle game that feels fresh and different? Get ready for WordNuts, a brand-new take on word games that blends word spelling with screw games, creating an experience that is as strategic as it is satisfying. 
WordNuts offers over 5,000 levels, each more challenging than the last, designed to sharpen your mind & brain, test your logic, and deliver a unique gaming experience. Unlike traditional word games, here you must carefully select letters and unscrew them while freeing up panels and unlocking new power-ups and level elements. It’s a fresh hybrid that combines classic wood nut (or wood screw) games with traditional word puzzles! Why not check it out now?
 How to Play 
- Tap letter nuts on the board to form words. 
- Letters that are not available for use will be put into the limited holders, requiring careful planning. 
- Watch the board shift dynamically as letters are removed, creating a constantly evolving puzzle. 
Every level presents a new strategic challenge—will you be able to clear the board and spell the correct words before running out of space? 
 Exciting Power-Ups to Help You Progress 
- Magic Wand – Reveal the complete word when you're stuck. 
- Chisel – Expand the holder area to store more letters. 
- Hammer – Break through boards blocking your moves. 
 Unique Challenges to Keep You Engaged 
Frozen Letters:
- After multiple interactions with a pin in the same layer, it becomes unlockable.
Iron Chain:
- Two letters move together and must be placed correctly.
Switching Box:
- Pins alternate between being operable and inoperable after each action.
Each of these challenges adds difficulty and variety, ensuring the difference between each level.
 A Completely Original Word Puzzle Experience 
- Innovative and never seen before – A first-of-its-kind word game combining classic spelling with interactive screw games. 
- Deeply satisfying gameplay – The tactile feel of letters falling, the smooth animations, and the carefully designed challenges make this game incredibly engaging. 
- Perfect for word game lovers – If you enjoy crosswords, word searches, anagrams, or other word puzzles, this is a must-try. 
Are you ready to test your vocabulary, strategy, and puzzle-solving skills in the most unique word game ever? 
Download WordNuts now and start your word adventure today!

bluejetty:00145151:ios.description:
Moodpress enables you to track your stress, real-time emotion, mood, activity, and sleep.
Moodpress analyzes HRV (heart rate variability) data from your Apple Watch to help indicate your current stress level. With Moodpress, you can gain valuable insights into your mood swings, stress triggers, and overall mental well-being to live a more balanced and fulfilling life.
What can Moodpress help you?
• Monitor stress level through Apple Watch, always remind you to pay attention to stress and help you relieve stress.
• Emotion index by AI：Use heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen data combining with AI analysis to calculate your real-time emotional.
• Insightful information about the body's energy value through sleep status, current steps, daylight hours and your own activities.
• Mood tracker: Track your daily moods and choose from a range of emotions to help you express how you feel throughout the day.
• Explore more: stress-relieving music, self-care activities, inspirational comics.
After you've used Moodpress for a while, get feedback on what's affecting your mood, stress, and health through data analysis:
- Check your stress data on heat-map calendar. It's easy to see the stressful times of the day, and stressful days of the week and month.
- Mood and activity analysis will show you which activities affect you positively and which make you feel bad.
- Get the relationship between stress, mood and sleep. Help you improve your sleep.
Privacy protection and security:
You turn on the PIN lock to ensure information security, and we do not store or collect your data. Your data will be stored locally on your phone. You can choose to back up your data in your private cloud storage or carry the backup file with you. Your data is always under your complete control.
Start using Moodpress right now! Recommended by over millions to anyone looking for a mood journal app to discover and record your feelings of the day!
Follow us for more updates
Twitter: @MoodpressApp
Instagram: @moodpressapp

- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
- Auto-renewal can be turned off at any time within the user’s Apple ID Account Settings > Manage Subscriptions

bluejetty:00065476:ios.description:
------- The Most Secure Wallet – Zengo -------
Zengo is the self-custodial wallet with no seed phrase vulnerability.
Protect and manage all of your cryptocurrencies with the crypto wallet that’s secure by default.
Buy, sell, trade, earn, and send over 380+ crypto and Web3 assets, all with the power of MPC security, a secure recovery model and unparalleled 24/7 customer support.
Since its launch in 2018, Zengo has not had a single security incident.
Whether you’re an experienced crypto user, or just getting started, over 1,000,000 customers trust Zengo.
Unlock even more security features such as multiple wallets, theft protection, self-custodial inheritance-like system, and an advanced Web3 Firewall all with Zengo Pro - our premium subscription service.
------- A Feature-Packed Wallet -------
Safe and secure crypto wallet – Never worry about losing your seed phrase again.
With Zengo's advanced cryptography, there is no seed phrase for you to manage. Instead, the responsibility of signing blockchain transactions is divided between us and our customers, so that neither party sees the other's secret information.
Welcome to the only non-custodial wallet where you don’t have to worry about losing your seed phrase!
Easily buy and exchange - Purchase and swap with your preferred payment method, including PayPal, Apple Pay, bank wire, and credit or debit cards.
Just tap on “Buy” or “Swap” and see the coins in your wallet within minutes.
Your Wallet Is Recoverable – Our 3FA recovery model ensures that you can restore your wallet on any phone or tablet.
Never lose access to your crypto again.
Legendary 24/7 Support – We make it super easy to chat with us whenever you need it.
Just send us a message from within the app 24/7.
Support 6 different blockchains: Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, Doge, Tron, Tezos.
Supports 4 Layer 2s: Polygon, Arbitrum One, Optimism, and Base.
Supporting hundreds crypto tokens, such as: Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH), Tether (USDT), BNB (BNB), Dogecoin (DOGE), Pepe (PEPE), Shiba Inu coin (SHIB), USD Coin (USDC), Tron (TRX), Polygon (MATIC), Uniswap (UNI), Maker (MKR), Kyber Network (KNC), Paxos Standard (PAX), and many others.
Desktop accessible - Securely manage and purchase assets from either your mobile device, or from the convenience of your desktop, both powered by Zengo's bulletproof security record.
Earn crypto - stake ETH directly through the wallet to earn rewards.
Multiple Wallets (Pro feature) - Organize and protect your assets by creating up to 5 segregated wallets. Separate high-value assets, payments, minting wallets, and public-facing wallets for ultimate security and privacy. 
Legacy Transfer (Pro feature) - Grant a beneficiary access to your digital assets in case of death or prolonged absence with a feature inspired by traditional inheritance systems but done the self-custodial way.
Theft Protection (Pro feature) - The industry’s 1st approvals process tied to your liveness 3D FaceLock biometrics.
Web3 Firewall (Pro feature) – With our revolutionary Web3 firewall, ClearSign™, we alert you to any unusual Web3 approvals or requests, protecting you from scams and hacks and “accidental approvals.”
Web3 Compatible – Connect with Dapps, use DeFi, and explore the new world of Web3 with our WalletConnect integration.
You can also view your NFTs directly within the app and safely store Polygon assets and use Polygon Web3 apps.
-Please note: ZK rollup-based apps are not currently supported
Use Zengo to transact with anyone in the world from the convenience of your mobile phone or desktop.
Receive real-time notifications when your transaction is confirmed.
Fiat Withdrawals – Cash out to your national currency anytime with just a few simple taps.
–––– Terms ––––
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
User agreement: https://zengo.com/user-agreement/
Privacy policy: https://zengo.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00041256:ios.description:
ADEX: Taxi Libya / address express 24/7
We operate in Tripoli, Misrata and Benghazi.
ADEX: Taxi Libya / address express 24/7 an application used to book taxi via a smartphone in Tripoli, Misrata, Gharyan, Benghazi. It allows users to book taxi easily and conveniently, and displays information about the driver and the taxi service. The application is a convenient and easy way to find a car and move around the city quickly and safely. An application works on the basis of Global Positioning System (GPS) to determine the user's location and send him the nearest taxi.
Why ADEX: Taxi Libya / address express 24/7
1. Get a comfortable taxi service for a low price.
2. Know the price before ordering
3. Short waiting times
4. VIP car provision
5. Always stay safe and share the details of your journey with your friends and family.
6. Pay however you want: both cashless and cash payments are accepted.
ADEX: Taxi Libya / address express 24/7 app is very easy to operate:
1. Download the application on your smartphone.
2. Create a new account in the service application by entering the required information such as name, phone number, and payment method.
3. Determine your location: Use GPS to determine your current location or enter an address to start from.
4. Book taxi: Select your desired destination, select your preferred vehicle type (if available), then tap the "Request a trip" button.
5. Confirm your taxi booking: You will see information about the driver and the dispatched vehicle.
6. Track your trip: You can follow the driver's movements on the map and know his estimated time of arrival.
7. Payment: You can pay the trip fees through the payment methods available in the application, such as cash or card
8. Trip Rating: After the taxi trip is over, you can rate the driver and provide additional feedback if you wish about taxi service.
If you have any questions about the ADEX: Taxi Libya / address express 24/7 app, contact us by e-mail Adex.Tripoli@gmail.com or visit our website ussco.ly
ADEX: Taxi Libya / address express 24/7 app's mission is to get you around Tripoli, Misrata, Gharyan, Benghazi in the fastest, safest, and most convenient way possible. Book taxi and never be late again.
Enjoy our safe and cosy taxi service with ADEX: Taxi Libya 24/7 app in Tripoli, Misrata, Gharyan, Benghazi - Libya.
Install the taxi service app and book taxi straight away!

bluejetty:00072855:ios.description:
AI Phone Translator is your all-in-one real-time translation app for phone calls, video calls, face-to-face conversations, and more — across 150+ languages and accents. Talk freely over the phone or across 20+ social apps like WhatsApp. 
Ideal for global professionals, travelers, immigrants, international couples, multilingual families, international students, and anyone living and working across languages.
Live Phone Call Translation - Call Freely across Languages
• Two-Way Voice Translation: Speak in your native language and the other person hears it in theirs instantly, and vice versa.
• Call Captioning: Bilingual subtitles on screen during the call.
• Type-to-Speak: Type names, addresses, or numbers to have them translated and spoken aloud.
• Key Point Highlighting: Automatically highlights important information.
• AI Call Summary: Get a concise summary after every call.
• Call Transcripts: Save and share complete conversation records.
Video Call Translation — Works with WhatsApp & More
• Voice-to-Voice Translation: Both sides speak naturally in their own language and hear instant translations during video calls.
• Live Bilingual Subtitles: Real-time captions for both sides.
• Works with 20+ Apps: WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, and more.
• Easy to Use: Just share a link — no download needed for the other person.
• Perfect for international dating, multilingual family communication, international business meetings, and more.
Real-Time Voice Translation - Speak Naturally Like a Native
• Voice-to-Voice Translation: Speak and hear translations instantly in real time.
• Talk Mode: Translate face-to-face conversations in real time. Great for travel, shopping, hospital visits, and everyday chats.
• Listening Mode: Transcribe and translate what you hear for classes, presentations, and meetings.
• Custom Voice Output: Use your own voice or choose from natural-sounding AI voices.
• Translation History: Review past conversations anytime.
Camera, Screen & Text Translation — Understand What You See
• Camera & Photo Translation: Take or upload photos to translate menus, signs, labels, posters, slides, and more.
• Document-Friendly: Translate pictures of documents, resumes, medical records, manuals, contracts, and forms.
• Screen Translation: Instantly translate text on apps, websites, chats, screenshots, and more.
• Smart OCR: Scans and extracts text from images with high accuracy.
• Auto Detection: Recognizes language automatically.
• Text Translation: Paste or type text for quick translation.
Audio/Streaming Translation — Enjoy Global Media in Any Language
• Translate any video or audio playing on your phone.
• Perfect for live streaming, online learning, podcasts, and international media.
Powerful AI Speech Recognition — Accurate for 150+ Languages & Accents
• Supports 150+ languages and dialects, including English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Vietnamese, and more.
• Accurately recognizes regional accents, slang, dialects, mixed-language speech, homophones, and informal phrases.
• Continuously trained to adapt to real-world speech and evolving language.
• Powered by advanced AI speech recognition and multilingual models.
Join 4M+ users worldwide — download AI Phone Translator and connect with the world without limits.
Subscription payments are charged to your iTunes account upon purchase and renewal. Free trials auto-renew to paid subscriptions unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Cancellation takes effect after the current period, downgrading you to the free service. 
Please note that all subscriptions are processed and managed through your Apple ID, including cancellations, refunds, and changes. 
Privacy Policy: https://www.aiphone.ai/pp
Terms of Use: https://www.aiphone.ai/tos
Have questions? Contact AI Phone support team: support@aiphone.ai

bluejetty:00033444:ios.summary:
